entries.name: Msn_ConditionFilterGate
entries.description: msn_gen.cpp. (condition, count) -> 1 when the condition is -1 or names one of the first count surviving row-1 records, else 0. Every .MSN record passes through it; the row-1 comparisons themselves are MsnGen_ParseMsnFile's.

entries.name: Msn_ClearPatchedFlags
entries.description: Zeroes every campaign flag the row-2 clear list at DAT_0048545a names.

entries.name: Msn_LoadEngText
entries.description: Loads the mission's .eng (.fre/.ger by Shell_Language) between rows 2 and 3: condition-filtered, a repeated id replacing the text. DAT_00470664 is the count kept.

entries.name: MissionStr_Write
entries.description: Writes data\mission.str from the loaded .ENG records: size, count, then length/text/NUL/attribute-count 0 per line. Opened without O_TRUNC.

entries.name: MsnGen_ParseMsnFile
entries.description: The raw .MSN byte parser (msn_gen.cpp). Revision-field check, scratch/patch pass, then 17 record-array rows with a condition-filter/template-inheritance system. Macro-structure confirmed byte-exact against 61/62 real retail .MSN files.

entries.name: WriteScriptDatFile
entries.description: Fully traced: the WRITER of data\script.dat. Serializes directly from the same in-memory .msn row-array globals MsnGen_ParseMsnFile populates (DAT_0047064e/0x16=row6, DAT_00470650/10=row7, DAT_00470656=row8, DAT_0047065e/0xc=row9, DAT_00470660/0x52=row10, DAT_00470662/0x1e=row11, DAT_00470652/0x90=row12, DAT_00470654/0x66=row13, DAT_0047065c/0x3e=row14, DAT_00470658/0x16=row15, DAT_0047065a/0xa4=row16, DAT_0047064a/0x3a=row17, DAT_00470640=row4), filtering out GUID==-1 (deleted/inactive) records per row and exporting only a field subset of each. See docs/retail/formats/script-dat.md for the full block table.

entries.name: MsnGen_HercArrayIndex
entries.description: (exported) -> the row-12 array index of the exported-th record whose GUID is set; a negative argument gives the first. Its return is in AX, which the decompiler drops.

entries.name: MsnGen_FreeRows
entries.description: Frees the mission loader's row arrays (conditions, .ENG strings and their texts, row 4, row 5, and the rest) and nulls each pointer. Msn_LoadDebrief calls it after handing row 5 on.

entries.name: MsnGen_BuildPlayerHerc
entries.description: Training: the player's machine into bay 0 -- group 0's first member while the practice row is below 4 or InstantAction_Active is set, else gam\ini_*.dat for prefs option 0x28.

entries.name: MsnGen_LoadMission
entries.description: msn_gen.cpp. Calls MsnGen_ParseMsnFile (00417b67) first with the .msn path, then WriteScriptDatFile (0041ac54) -- confirmed to be data\script.dat's writer, serializing a GUID-filtered field-subset re-export of the same in-memory row arrays MsnGen_ParseMsnFile just populated. See docs/retail/formats/script-dat.md.

entries.name: Msn_LoadDebriefRows
entries.description: The debrief's reload of the mission just flown: row 1 against the flags (drawing ShellRandom for type-1 conditions, as the main load does), row 2 skipped so no flag is cleared, the .ENG text, row 3, row 4 skipped, and row 5 kept -- the debrief text records MsnGen_ParseMsnFile skips. Writes data\mission.str. Called only from Msn_LoadDebrief.

entries.name: Msn_LoadDebrief
entries.description: (missionPath) Msn_LoadDebriefRows, then row 5's first slot handed by value to Career_SetDebriefLines -- its thirty mission.str lines and its row-3 value, the debrief movie -- and the load's arrays freed (MsnGen_FreeRows (0041c28f)). Called only from Career_Advance, for the mission at the career position before it advances.

entries.name: Herc_Dtor
entries.description: Herc's destructor, the dtor its class record (0x7a bytes, at 0041d349) names: (herc, flags): decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr; when herc is not null, HercRecord_ClearMounts(herc), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: PtrVector_Ctor
entries.description: (vector, growBy): zeroes the count (+0), +4 and the data pointer (+10), stores the int16 grow step at +8 and counts the object live (*Rtl_DtorCountPtr). EventQueue_Ctor builds its queue (+0x11) with a step of 5.

entries.name: PtrArray_Dtor
entries.description: PtrArray's destructor, the dtor its class record (RTTI 'PtrArray', 0xe bytes, at 004687d9) names: (array, flags) decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, frees the buffer at +0xa with _free, then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set. Shell_MonoPrintFps and Display_HopTo run it on their locals.
entries.source: es2_classes.scan: the Borland class record's +0x28 destructor; VSHELL decompile

entries.name: PtrVector_Append
entries.description: (vector, value): PtrVector_Grow, then stores value in the new last slot of the dword array at +10; returns 0 when the grow fails.

entries.name: PtrVector_RemoveAt
entries.description: (vector, index): returns 0 for an index outside 0..count-1; otherwise shifts the later elements of the dword array at +10 down one and PtrVector_DropLast's. PtrVector_PopFront calls it with 0.

entries.name: PtrVector_OpenSlot
entries.description: (vector, index): when 0 <= index < count (+0) and PtrVector_Grow succeeds, shifts the dword elements from index up one place in the data at +0xa (last to first), leaving slot index holding its old value for the caller to overwrite. Returns 0 on every path (XOR EAX,EAX at 0041d4ba), success included. Dispatcher_PushFilter calls it with index 0 (read).

entries.name: PtrVector_IndexOf
entries.description: (vector, value): the index of the first dword equal to value among the count (+0) elements of the data at +0xa, or -1. No caller or stored pointer found by es2_xref.

entries.name: PtrVector_Grow
entries.description: (vector): adds one to the count at +0, in place when the data pointer at +10 is set and the capacity at +4 allows it, otherwise through PtrVector_Resize with the new count. Returns whether it succeeded.

entries.name: PtrVector_DropLast
entries.description: (vector): decrements the count (+0) when it is positive. Returns 1.

entries.name: PtrVector_Resize
entries.description: PtrArray::resize (assert 'PtrArray:resize: Could not allocate memory' in wsrc\ptrarray.cpp line 0x94): (vector, count). A count below 1 frees the data (+10) and zeroes count (+0), capacity (+4) and data; otherwise rounds the capacity up to a multiple of the int16 grow step (+8), Mem_HeapAlloc's or reallocs the data to it, and stores count and capacity. Returns 1. PtrVector_Grow calls it when the capacity is exhausted.

entries.name: EventConsumer_Ctor
entries.description: EventConsumer constructor (vtable 00470c58 at +4, RTTI name 'EventConsumer', 0x10 bytes): (this, owner) EventProducer_Ctor's shape, appending this to the owner's consumer list with Dispatcher_AddConsumer. WinConsumer_Ctor runs it first.

entries.name: EventConsumer_Dtor
entries.description: EventConsumer destructor (vtable 00470c58 at +4, RTTI name 'EventConsumer', 0x10 bytes): (obj, flags) reinstalls the vtable, calls 0041dd79(+8, obj) when +8 is non-null, then Mem_Delete(obj) when flags bit 0 is set.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0041d644; RTTI at vtable-0xc

entries.name: EventProducer_Ctor
entries.description: EventProducer constructor (vtable 00470c44 at +4, RTTI name 'EventProducer', 0x10 bytes): (this, owner) SListNode_Init(this), installs the vtable, clears the int16s +0xc and +0xe, appends this to the owner's producer list with Dispatcher_AddProducer when owner is non-null, and stores owner at +8. WinKeyboardProducer_Ctor and WinMouseProducer_Ctor run it first.

entries.name: EventProducer_Dtor
entries.description: EventProducer destructor: (this, flags) reinstalls vtable 00470c44, EventProducer_UnlinkFromOwner(+8, this) when +8 is non-null, then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set. WinKeyboardProducer_Dtor and WinMouseProducer_Dtor end with it.

entries.name: EventBase_Ctor
entries.description: EventBase constructor (vtable 00470c18, RTTI name 'EventBase', 0xc bytes, over ClassItem): clears the word at +6. WinEvent_Ctor runs it first.

entries.name: EventBase_Dtor
entries.description: EventBase vtable 00470c18 slot +0x18 (event, flags): decrements the live-object counter at *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, restores the vtable, then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set. The event handlers delete every event they consume through this slot.

entries.name: EventBase_Clone
entries.description: EventBase vtable 00470c18 slot +0x1c (event): Mem_New's a 0xc-byte EventBase (EventBase_Ctor), copies +4, +6 and +8 into it and returns it. Each event class overrides it with a copy of its own size and fields.

entries.name: EventBase_Construct
entries.description: The ClassItem registry's load function for an EventBase (bucket entry {0x500000, this, 'EventBase'} at EventBase_ClassItems (00470d40), count 1 at 00470d4c, registered by EventHandler_Ctor): Arena_Alloc's 0xc bytes from the arena at ArenaStack_Current (00481244), EventBase_Ctor, then calls the object's vtable +0xc (EventBase_ReadFromStream) with its two arguments, as WinEvent_Construct does for its class. The stored pointer es2_xref finds is that entry's dword at 00470d44.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0041d7c2; bytes at 00470d40 read from VSHELL.EXE

entries.name: EventBase_GetClassTag
entries.description: EventBase vtable 00470c18 slot 0: returns 0x500000.

entries.name: EventBase_GetStreamSize
entries.description: EventBase slot +4: returns 8, what EventBase_ReadFromStream reads. WinEvent_GetStreamSize adds to it.

entries.name: EventBase_GetMemorySize
entries.description: EventBase slot +8: returns 0xc, the object's size.

entries.name: EventBase_ReadFromStream
entries.description: EventBase slot +0xc (event, stream): reads the int16 +4, the int16 +6 (through a local) and the int32 time +8 through the stream's read slot. The labels are EventBase_DebugPrint's: Event, Attr, Time.

entries.name: EventBase_WriteToStream
entries.description: EventBase slot +0x10 (event, stream): writes +4, +6 and +8 as EventBase_ReadFromStream reads them.

entries.name: EventBase_DebugPrint
entries.description: EventBase slot +0x14 (event, verbose, indent): prints '%sEvent: %u Attr: %X Time: %d' with +4, +6 and +8 to stdout, indented by indent spaces (at most 99).

entries.name: EventHandler_Ctor
entries.description: EventHandler constructor (class record 0x2c bytes at 00401f38, dtor EventHandler_Dtor): (handler) PtrVector_Ctor(+0, 5) for the event queue and PtrVector_Ctor(+0xe, 5) for the filter list, SListNode_Init on the producer list head +0x1c and the consumer list head +0x20, ClassItem_RegisterBucket(EventBase_ClassItems (00470d40), [00470d4c]) for EventBase_Construct's bucket, clears the cursors +0x28 and +0x24, and adds 1 to *Rtl_DtorCountPtr three times itself (each PtrVector_Ctor adds its own). The vshell.cpp static initialiser Shell_StaticInit (00401e4c) builds Shell_Dispatcher (004810f4) with it (read).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0041da18; caller 00401e4c; es2_naming classes

entries.name: PtrVector_Append_Thunk
entries.description: Forwards (vector, value) to PtrVector_Append. Keyboard_PostEvents and WinMouseProducer_PostEvents append each event to the vector at the input object's +8 through it.

entries.name: Dispatcher_RunQueue
entries.description: (dispatcher, typeMask, subMask): calls slot +4 of every idle handler on the list at +0x1c whose masks (+0xc, +0xe) match; then pops each queued item (PtrArray at +0, asserting 'PtrArray::operator[]: Index out of range'), passes it through the filter functions at +0x18 (count +0xe), delivers it to every listener on the list at +0x20 whose masks match the item's type words (+4, +6), and deletes it.

entries.name: Dispatcher_PushFilter
entries.description: (dispatcher, filter): puts filter at the front of the filter list (PtrArray at +0xe, data at +0x18) that Dispatcher_RunQueue passes each event through: PtrVector_Append when the list is empty, otherwise PtrVector_OpenSlot(list, 0), an assert that the count is positive (d:\include\ptrarray.h line 0x60, PtrArray::operator[]), and a store to slot 0. No caller or stored pointer found by es2_xref.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile and disassembly at 0041dc57; Dispatcher_RunQueue decompile

entries.name: Dispatcher_PopFilter
entries.description: (dispatcher): 0 when the filter list (+0xe) is empty; otherwise asserts its count positive (ptrarray.h line 0x60), takes slot 0, removes it with PtrVector_RemoveAt(list, 0) and returns it. Dispatcher_PushFilter's inverse. No caller or stored pointer found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Dispatcher_AddProducer
entries.description: (dispatcher, producer): SList_Append(dispatcher+0x1c, producer), the producer list.

entries.name: Dispatcher_AddConsumer
entries.description: (dispatcher, consumer): SList_Append(dispatcher+0x20, consumer), the consumer list.

entries.name: EventProducer_UnlinkFromOwner
entries.description: (owner, producer): EventConsumer_UnlinkFromOwner's twin for the producer list: when the owner's cursor +0x28 is producer, steps it to producer's next (+0); then SList_Remove(owner+0x1c, producer).

entries.name: EventConsumer_UnlinkFromOwner
entries.description: (owner, consumer): when the owner's cursor +0x24 is consumer, steps it to consumer's next (+0); then SList_Remove(owner+0x20, consumer). EventConsumer_Dtor runs it on its +8 owner.

entries.name: Dispatcher_SortQueueByTime
entries.description: (dispatcher): bubble-sorts the event queue (PtrArray at +0, data at +0xa) ascending by each event's int32 at +8, the time EventBase_DebugPrint labels Time, swapping a pair when the later one is strictly earlier, so equal times keep their order. Dispatcher_RunQueue calls it once per run before draining a non-empty queue (read).

entries.name: SListNode_Init
entries.description: (node): clears the next link at +0.

entries.name: SList_LinkAfter
entries.description: (link, node): node->next = *link; *link = node.

entries.name: SList_Append
entries.description: (head, node): follows the next links (+0) from head to the last one and SList_LinkAfter's node there.

entries.name: SList_Remove
entries.description: (head, node): follows the next links (+0) from head to the one holding node, links around it and clears node's next; returns 1, or 0 when node is not on the list.

entries.name: Avi_BuildPalette
entries.description: CreatePalette of 236 entries from entries 10-245 of the palette installed, into Avi_PaletteHandle, which Avi_Play hands the movie with 'setvideo mov palette handle to %d'.

entries.name: maybe_Avi_BuildIndexPalette
entries.description: Frameless routine, between Avi_BuildPalette and Avi_OpenDevice: LocalAlloc(0x40, 0x3b8) for a LOGPALETTE, version 0x300, 0xec entries, entry i = {red 10 + i, green 0, blue 0, flags 4 (PC_NOCOLLAPSE)}; CreatePalette into Avi_PaletteHandle (00485664), then LocalFree. Avi_BuildPalette builds the same-sized palette from the installed colours instead; the red ramp 10-245 reads like palette indices 10-245, which is the role the maybe_ name records. No caller or stored pointer found by es2_xref.
entries.source: VSHELL capstone disassembly at 0041dea8 (es2_naming body -d); Avi_BuildPalette decompile

entries.name: Avi_OpenDevice
entries.description: Opens MCI's avivideo device for one movie; with its argument 1 first builds the movie palette (Avi_BuildPalette). Movie_PlayQueue passes its own argument through.

entries.name: Avi_CloseMovie
entries.description: 'close mov', with a message box on an MCI error. Called by Avi_Play as playback ends.

entries.name: Avi_CloseDevice
entries.description: 'close avivideo', with a message box on an MCI error. Called by Movie_PlayQueue after each movie.

entries.name: Avi_MoveWindow
entries.description: Moves the MCI movie window to a {left, top, width, height} rect through MoveWindow; Avi_Play's only use of it.

entries.name: Avi_Play
entries.description: Plays one AVI through MCI ('open %s alias mov style child', 'play mov window notify'; src\avi.cpp). Sets the palette, SetCapture on the main window and Avi_Playing = 1, then loops until Avi_StopRequested is set -- a mouse button down in the window procedure, or Esc or Space (scan codes 1 and 0x39) -- then ReleaseCapture and Avi_Playing = 0. Returns 1, or 0 when the open fails. Its one caller is Movie_PlayQueue.

entries.name: MovieQueueEntry_ElementCtor
entries.description: (entry): sets a 0x1c-byte MovieQueue_Entries entry to id -1 (int16 +0), the rect +2..+0x11 copied from MovieQueue_EmptyRect (00470fcc), palette index -1 (int16 +0x12), the location-tab flag +0x14 = 0 and the callback +0x18 = 0; EAX is left as the entry pointer it loaded. Avi_StaticInit hands it to Rtl_VectorNew; the stored pointer es2_xref finds is that PUSH at 0041eacb.
entries.source: VSHELL disassembly at 0041e224; vector-new site at 0041eac4

entries.name: MovieQueue_Contains
entries.description: Whether any of the ten MovieQueue_Entries carries the id; Movie_Enqueue adds nothing when it does.

entries.name: Movie_Enqueue
entries.description: Adds a movie to the ten-entry ring at 00485668 at write index MovieQueue_WriteIndex, when movies are on (Shell_MoviesEnabled) and the id is not already queued: the id, a rect, a palette index (0xffff for none), a flag that ends the run on the campaign map's location tab, and a callback run after it. Movie_PlayQueue plays the ring.

entries.name: Movie_PlayQueue
entries.description: Plays every queued movie from read index MovieQueue_ReadIndex, each through Avi_Play with its palette and rect, lighting the MISSION tab around it while the frame is up, then runs the entry's callback and frees it. Sets MovieQueue_Running = 1 for the whole run and clears it only when it finds the ring empty -- the shell's main loop (Shell_Main) calls it with 1 once a pass -- or while it waits on the insert-CD panel (InsertCdPanel). Also called directly after enqueuing by the startup (Shell_BuildScreensAndStart), Game_ProcessMissionResults and MainMenu_OnCredits.

entries.name: Avi_StaticInit
entries.description: Borland static initialiser at the end of the avi.cpp block, _INIT_ entry 00480fec (priority 0x20): Rtl_VectorNew(MovieQueue_Entries 00485668, 0x1c, 10, 1, MovieQueueEntry_ElementCtor), then MovieQueue_EmptyRect (00470fcc-00470fd8) from an inlined rectangle constructor that orders the corners of (0, 0, 0, 0), writing all four ints 0. The element constructor runs first, so it copies the rect while it still holds its image value, also 0.
entries.source: VSHELL disassembly at 0041eac4; init_vshell.txt; image bytes at 00470fcc

entries.name: Window_SetRect
entries.description: Stores a constructor's rect verbatim into +0x25/+0x29/+0x2d/+0x31 -- left, top, right, bottom, parent-relative -- has Window_ResolveRect derive the absolute rect into +0x15/+0x19/+0x1d/+0x21, attaches to the parent with Window_AttachChild (0041f134), ORs 0x1f into the event mask +0x39, and stores its 4th argument, the click handler, at +0x3d.

entries.name: Window_MoveRect
entries.description: Moves a widget after construction: rewrites the parent-relative rect at +0x25, rederives the absolute one and repaints. Called on one widget (0048d7dc). Window_SetPosition (0041ee1d) also moves widgets (the repair diagrams and bay pictures), and Window_SetWidth resizes them.

entries.name: Window_SetWidth
entries.description: (widget, width): sets the right edge +0x2d to left + width - 1 and the screen right +0x1d to match, when width is positive, the widget has a parent, the new width fits inside the parent, and no child's screen right edge (+0x1d) would fall outside. Moves the pointer off and back on (Pointer_Leave, Pointer_Enter) when it is over this widget and now past its edge.

entries.name: Window_SetHeight
entries.description: (widget, height): Window_SetWidth's vertical twin: sets the bottom edge +0x31 and the screen bottom +0x21 under the same conditions, with the children's screen bottoms (+0x21) checked.

entries.name: Window_RepaintRecursive
entries.description: Posts a repaint event (type 4 at event+0xc, target widget at +0x20; a 0x24-byte event from the global operator new at 00408107) to a widget, then recurses over its children (first child +0xd, next sibling +5). A hidden widget (+0x11 bit 2) and its whole subtree are skipped. The shell's usual 'redraw this panel' call.
entries.source: docs/retail/shell/screen-layout.md#showing-and-hiding-a-widget (the +0x11 hidden bit and child links); WinButton_HandleEvent's type-4 repaint

entries.name: Window_SetPosition
entries.description: Window::setPosition (assert 'Window::setPosition > can't move...' in wsrc\window.cpp when the widget has no parent): (widget, {x, y}). Clamps the position to be non-negative and to keep the widget inside its parent, moves the rect +0x25..+0x31 there keeping its size, then Window_ResolveRect and Window_RepaintRecursive. Repair_BuildDiagrams and Squad_BuildBayPictures place their pictures with it.

entries.name: Window_ResolveRect
entries.description: (widget, parent): derives the absolute rect (+0x15..+0x21) from the parent-relative one (+0x25..+0x31) by adding the parent's absolute left/top (the widget's own parent when none is passed; the relative rect as is at the root), then recurses over the children (first child +0xd, next sibling +5). Window_SetRect and Window_MoveRect call it.

entries.name: Window_AssertFit
entries.description: Window::fit's checks (src: wsrc\window.cpp lines 199, 0xcd, 0xd3, 0xd9, severity 4, each after Mono_Printf'ing four values at 0,0): (window, parent). Asserts the window's screen rect (min +0x15/+0x19, max +0x1d/+0x21) and parent-relative rect (min +0x25/+0x29, max +0x2d/+0x31) are not inverted, that its screen min is not below its parent min, and that the parent's screen max (+0x1d/+0x21) is not below the window's parent max. Window_SetRect runs it when a parent is given, between Window_ResolveRect and Window_AttachChild.

entries.name: Window_AttachChild
entries.description: Window_AttachChild(parent, child): pushes the child onto the HEAD of the parent's child list (+0xd head, +5 next sibling, +9 previous sibling or, on the head with +0x11 bit 1 set, the parent). Only caller Window_SetRect, so every child list runs newest first -- which is why the later-built of two overlapping siblings wins a click.

entries.name: Window_LastSibling
entries.description: (unused, widget): follows the next-sibling link at +5 (a parent's children run from its +0xd through +5) until it is null and returns the last widget of the chain, in EAX (the decompile drops it); 0 for a null widget. Window_Detach and Window_ShowRecursive call it.

entries.name: Window_Detach
entries.description: Unlinks a widget from its parent's child list and clears its links. Called by two teardowns (0040ce2b, 0043c7ea) that delete what they unlink; nothing re-attaches, so no child list is reordered.

entries.name: Window_Parent
entries.description: Returns a widget's parent: walks +9 (previous sibling) while +0x11 bit 1 is clear, then returns +9 of the list head, which is the parent.

entries.name: Window_GetRoot
entries.description: Follows a widget's parent link (+9) to the top and returns that widget in EAX (the decompile drops the return).

entries.name: Window_ContainsPoint
entries.description: Window_ContainsPoint(widget, point): 1 when the point is inside the widget's absolute rect +0x15..+0x21, edges included.

entries.name: Window_ShowRecursive
entries.description: Shows a widget subtree: clears bits 2 and 4 of the +0x11 flags word, refusing to run while the effective parent is still hidden, posts type=1 (self) and type=4 (parent-directed) events, then walks the +9 chain. Type 4 is what reaches ESMessage_Paint. VSHELL_FULL.txt names this Window_HideRecursive; the two are swapped there. Mirror of Window_HideRecursive (0041f469).

entries.name: Window_HideRecursive
entries.description: Hides a widget subtree: sets bit 2 of the +0x11 flags word, which is a HIDDEN bit, sets bit 4 when the effective parent is hidden too, recurses into every child that is not already hidden (+0xd child-list head, +5 sibling-next), then posts a type=2 event via Event_Post. VSHELL_FULL.txt names this Window_ShowRecursive; the two are swapped there. ESMessage_Paint (0040b439) draws only when bit 2 is clear, and the repair tab's entry (004332ec) calls the other one on its own panels while its teardown (004333eb) calls this. Mirror of Window_ShowRecursive (0041f2e6).

entries.name: Window_BeginPaint
entries.description: The first call in all five widget paints: binds the drawing context to the widget and clips to it. The paints depend on that clip rather than measuring -- the titled panel's hatch is drawn over 700 pixels wide whatever the widget's size.

entries.name: Window_DispatchCallback
entries.description: Calls the widget's own handler at +0x3d if it has one. This is what a click actually reaches, and what the palette scope's on-shown hook goes through.

entries.name: ShellCursor_Ctor
entries.description: Cursor object: vtable 00471844, the HCURSOR at +4. Built twice at startup around GetCursor() into Shell_RootCursor and Shell_HotspotCursor.
WinWin95Cursor vtable 00471844 slot 0, the class's only virtual: returns at once. WinCursor's own slot is Rtl_PureError. What calls the slot is Open.

entries.name: WinWin95Display_Ctor
entries.description: WinWin95Display constructor (vtable 004717ec at +1, RTTI 'WinWin95Display', 0x65d bytes): installs the WinDisplay vtable 00471818 and registers the display with WinBase_AddDisplay, then its own vtable; builds the 100-entry {left, top, right, bottom} rect array at +0x19 (RectI_Ctor); a root Window (0x45 bytes, vtable 004717dc) at +5 sized to the display (GLDisplay_GetAttribute 0 and 1 of DAT_0048e17c); a GLViewport at +0x15; shows the root; +9 = +0xd = 0x100; zeroes the rects and the rect count +0x659.

entries.name: DirtyList_PresentOne
entries.description: Display_PresentRect(rect, rect) and decrements the dirty count at +0x659.

entries.name: DirtyList_Flush
entries.description: Presents every dirty rectangle queued on a screen object (16-byte rects from +0x19, count at +0x659) with DirtyList_PresentOne and zeroes the count.

entries.name: WinWin95Display_BeginPaint
entries.description: WinWin95Display vtable 004717ec slot 0 (display, widget), what Window_BeginPaint calls: sets the viewport +0x15's clip rect (+0x210..+0x21c) to the widget's absolute rect (+0x15..+0x21), clip mode +0x20c and translation flag +0x208 to 1, makes the viewport current, then records the rect in the dirty list (+0x19, count +0x659): drops every listed rect strictly inside it and appends it unless a listed rect already contains it, asserting (winwin95.cpp line 99) fewer than 100.

entries.name: WinWin95Display_BeginPaintRect
entries.description: WinWin95Display vtable 004717ec slot +4 (display, rect): WinWin95Display_BeginPaint for a bare rect: the viewport's clip rect is the rect and its clip mode +0x20c 1 (the translation flag is left alone), and the rect is appended to the dirty list without the containment test (assert at winwin95.cpp line 0x6d).

entries.name: WinWin95Display_GetCursor
entries.description: WinWin95Display vtable 004717ec slot +8: returns the cursor Display_SetCursor caches at +0x11.

entries.name: Display_SetCursor
entries.description: Slot 3 of the shell display's vtable 004717ec: SetCursor(arg) unless it equals the one cached at display +0x11. Pointer_Enter passes a widget's +0x35, a cursor object's address rather than its handle.

entries.name: WinWin95Display_SetCursorPos
entries.description: WinWin95Display vtable 004717ec slot +0x10 (display, point): ClientToScreen on the main window (MainWindow_Handle), then SetCursorPos. Pointer_MoveTo calls it.

entries.name: WinWin95Display_GetCursorPos
entries.description: WinWin95Display vtable 004717ec slot +0x14 (display, point): GetCursorPos, ScreenToClient on the main window (MainWindow_Handle), stored to point. Display_GetCursorPos calls it.

entries.name: WinWin95Display_ShowCursor
entries.description: WinWin95Display vtable 004717ec slot +0x18: ShowCursor(1).

entries.name: WinWin95Display_HideCursor
entries.description: WinWin95Display vtable 004717ec slot +0x1c: ShowCursor(0).

entries.name: Gfx_FrameRectColour
entries.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1, colour), all on the stack by value (colour an int16): installs a {4, colour} brush at +0x22c of the current drawing context (pointer 0048e184), calls Gfx_FillRect on the rect, and restores the previous brush. es2_naming diff: the twin of DBSIM 004536f4. No caller or stored pointer found by es2_xref.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0041fc5c; es2_naming diff against DBSIM 004536f4

entries.name: Gfx_FillFrameRectColours
entries.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1, fill, frame), all on the stack by value (the colours int16): first calls Shell_Display's vtable +4 (WinWin95Display_BeginPaintRect) on the rect, then Gfx_FillRect with a {0, fill} brush and again with a {4, frame} brush at +0x22c of the current drawing context (0048e184), and restores the previous brush. DBSIM 00453738 is the same body without the BeginPaintRect call (es2_naming diff). The one caller found by es2_xref, Shell_DrawPaletteGrid (00407688), draws a 16 x 16 grid of 11-pixel cells, the cell at (x, y) filled and framed in colour index x * 16 + y.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile and disassembly at 0041fc9d; caller 00407688 disassembly; es2_naming diff against DBSIM 00453738

entries.name: Gfx_DrawLineColour
entries.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1, colour), all on the stack by value (colour an int16): installs a {0, colour} pen at +0x228 of the current drawing context (0048e184), Gfx_DrawLine from (x0, y0) to (x1, y1), and restores the previous pen. es2_naming diff: the twin of DBSIM 00453798. No caller or stored pointer found by es2_xref.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0041fd11; es2_naming diff against DBSIM 00453798

entries.name: Gfx_DrawCircleColour
entries.description: (x, y, radius, colour), radius and colour int16: installs a {4, colour} brush at +0x22c of the current drawing context (0048e184), calls Gfx_FillEllipse on the box (x - radius, y - radius, x + radius, y + radius), and restores the previous brush. No caller or stored pointer found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Map_Ctor
entries.description: Constructor of RTTI class Map (vtable 0047195e, 0x4e bytes), the base ShellMap (004721b0) derives from: rect width/height at +0x46/+0x4a, own drawing context at +4 centred on the rect, 3Space camera at +0xc (focal shift 7 at +0x10, orientation the triple at 0047189c, which Map_StaticInit (004201e5) sets to {0xc000, 0, 0}), position +0x12/+0x16, altitude +0x1a = 200000 (DAT_00471870), pan +0x3a/+0x3e zeroed, pan step via Map_PanStepFor.

entries.name: Map_Dtor
entries.description: Map destructor (camera, flags): decrements the live-object counter at *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, restores the Map vtable 0047195e, deletes the drawing context at +4 through its vtable +0x18 and the 3Space camera at +0xc through its slot 0 (each when set), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set. ShellMap_Dtor ends with it.

entries.name: Map_Project
entries.description: World point to canvas through the map camera: Raster_ModelToView, Raster_Project ((view << 7) / depth) and Raster_ToScreen (centre offset, y flipped) -- a plan view about the viewport centre.

entries.name: Map_PushContext
entries.description: (camera): saves the current drawing context (0048e184) at +8 and makes the camera's own context at +4 current (Gfx_SetCurrentContext); returns it. ShellMap_Paint brackets its drawing with this and Map_PopContext.

entries.name: Map_PopContext
entries.description: (camera): makes the drawing context Map_PushContext saved at +8 current again and returns it.

entries.name: ShellMap_InstallCamera
entries.description: (map): places the map's view (+0xc) at x = +0x12 + +0x3a, y = +0x16 + +0x3e and +0xc = +0x1a, installs it (Raster_InstallViewProjection) and clears the model transform (Raster_SetModelTransform(0)). ShellMap_Paint calls it.

entries.name: Map_ZoomOut
entries.description: Map vtable 0047195e slot +8: altitude +0x1a += 50000 (DAT_00471864) while the result stays at or below 1000000 (DAT_0047186c), then Map_PanStepFor. ShellMap overrides it with ShellMap_ZoomOut.

entries.name: Map_ZoomIn
entries.description: Map vtable +4: altitude -= 50000 while the result stays >= 50000, then Map_PanStepFor.

entries.name: Map_PanWest
entries.description: Map vtable 0047195e slot +0x14: pan x +0x3a -= the step +0x42 when position x +0x12 less the step stays at or above -5000000. ShellMap overrides it with ShellMap_PanWest.

entries.name: Map_PanEast
entries.description: Map vtable 0047195e slot +0x18: pan x +0x3a += the step +0x42 when position x +0x12 plus the step stays at or below 5000000. ShellMap overrides it with ShellMap_PanEast.

entries.name: Map_PanNorth
entries.description: Map vtable 0047195e slot +0xc: pan y +0x3e += the step +0x42 when position y +0x16 plus the step stays at or below 5000000 (DAT_00471860). ShellMap overrides it with ShellMap_PanNorth.

entries.name: Map_PanSouth
entries.description: Map vtable 0047195e slot +0x10: pan y +0x3e -= the step +0x42 when position y +0x16 less the step stays at or above -5000000. ShellMap overrides it with ShellMap_PanSouth.

entries.name: Map_ResetPan
entries.description: Map vtable +0x1c: zeroes the pan +0x3a/+0x3e.

entries.name: Map_StaticInit
entries.description: Borland static initialiser at the end of the Map block, _INIT_ entry 00480ff4 (priority 0x20): writes Map_CameraOrientation (0047189c) = {0xc000, 0, 0} as three int16s, the orientation Map_Ctor passes TSCamera_Ctor (and through it TSContext_CtorWithFrame's orientation triple). Frameless.
entries.source: VSHELL disassembly at 004201e5; Map_Ctor and TSContext_CtorWithFrame decompiles; init_vshell.txt

entries.name: Raster_SetShadeRampDimensions
entries.description: (shadeLevels, depthSlices): stores them in Raster_ShadeLevels (00485780) and Raster_DepthSlices (00485784) and fills Raster_ReciprocalTable (00485788) entries 1-0x289 with FixedDivQ16(1, n). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_SetShadeRampDimensions (00467f9c; es2_naming diff). No caller or stored pointer found by es2_xref; a grep of VSHELL_disasm_full.txt for the three addresses finds stores at 0042023b, 00420243 and 00420259 and reads elsewhere.
entries.source: VSHELL disassembly at 00420234; es2_naming diff against DBSIM 00467f9c; grep of VSHELL_disasm_full.txt

entries.name: Raster_SetVisibilityRange
entries.description: (range): stores Raster_VisibilityRange (g_RasterVisibilityRange (0047198c)), the far limit Raster_SetDepthFadeFromDistance (00420279) measures its depth fade against. Identical after normalisation to DBSIM's Raster_SetVisibilityRange (00467fdc). Callers found by es2_xref: Terrain_DrawCellRowRun (00429dac), per terrain cell, passing grid[+0x108] << grid[+0x104] (read).
entries.source: VSHELL disassembly at 0042026c; es2_naming diff against DBSIM 00467fdc; 00429dac decompile

entries.name: Raster_SetDepthFadeFromDistance
entries.description: (depth): clamps depth to g_RasterVisibilityRange (0047198c, 100000 in the image) and writes g_RasterDepthFadeOffset (00471990): 0 when depth is at most half the range, else FixedMulQ16(FixedDivQ16((depth - range/2) * 2, range), depthSlices Raster_DepthSlices (00485784) - 1) * shadeLevels Raster_ShadeLevels (00485780) * 256. TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA, TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB and TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeEdgePerspective add it to each ramp row (shade * (shadeLevels - 1) + offset, << 8). Terrain_DrawCellRowRun calls it (es2_xref: one CALL, at 0042a9cb) with the nearest corner's view depth, after Raster_SetVisibilityRange (0042026c) installs the range grid+0x108 << cellShift. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_SetDepthFadeFromDistance (00467fec), which clamps the Q16 fraction to 0x10000 where this clamps the depth.

entries.name: TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA
entries.description: (positions, uvCorners, count, atlasPage, shadePtr, mode, preTransformed): VSHELL's affine textured-polygon fill, one function doing what DBSIM splits into Raster_SetupTexturedSpan and Raster_DrawPolygon. Per vertex: model-to-view unless preTransformed, project, u and v << 8, the view depth into +8 when maybe_g_DepthBufferEnabled is set, and in mode 2 a ramp row from shadePtr[i]; near-plane clip; Raster_ClipPolygonX, Raster_ClipPolygonY and Raster_BuildEdgeTables with flags 1 (|4 in mode 2, |8 with the depth buffer). Then per row u and v are stepped linearly across the span by the span routine the mode selects: 0 Raster_SpanTextured, 1 Raster_SpanTexturedShaded (with *shadePtr turned into one ramp row in place), 2 Raster_SpanTexturedGouraud, or their ...Clipped twins when the clip-span table DAT_0047e92c is set and the context clip mode is 2 or the depth buffer is on. TSTexture4Poly_Render dispatches between it and TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB on g_TexturedPolyPerspective.

entries.name: TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB
entries.description: (positions, uvCorners, count, atlasPage, shadePtr, mode, preTransformed): the perspective-correct twin of TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA, and VSHELL's copy of DBSIM's Raster_DrawTexturedPolyNear. Per vertex it stores 1/z (1 << DAT_005d7fd4 over the view depth) at +0x14, u and v << 16 times 1/z, and the view depth at +8; clips and builds edges with flags 0xb (0xf in mode 2). Each row is drawn in runs of 2^k pixels: k = 10 when the row's ends have equal 1/z, else 4, 5, 6 or 7 as |delta 1/z| >> 12 is over DAT_00471980, over DAT_00471984, over DAT_00471988 or none. At each run's end u and v are recovered with Int64Pair_Q16Divide (per-run steps from Raster_ScaleRunStep) and the run is filled affinely by Raster_SpanTexturedShaded, or Raster_SpanTexturedShadedClipped under RasterizeA's conditions. With g_PerspectiveUseQuadraticFit set, the row's start and its last partial run's end take Raster_BuildEdgeTables' quadratic fit instead of a divide. Every mode draws with the shaded span: mode 1 sets its ramp row from *shadePtr, and mode 2 interpolates a per-vertex row along the edges that no span reads.

entries.name: TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeEdgePerspective
entries.description: (positions, uvCorners, count, atlasPage, shadePtr, mode, preTransformed): a third textured-polygon fill beside TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA and TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB. Fills Raster_VertexBuffer as they do (Raster_ModelToView unless preTransformed; Raster_Project and Raster_ToScreen for a vertex at or beyond the near plane DAT_005d7fd8; mode 2's ramp row from shadePtr) and stores (1 << (DAT_005d7fd4 + 16)) / depth at +0x14. The near-plane pass copies seven dwords of each kept vertex to 004861b0 and multiplies its u and v by +0x14; a crossing vertex gets +0x14 = 0x10000 and u, v interpolated and shifted left 16. Then Raster_ClipPolygonX, Raster_ClipPolygonY and Raster_BuildEdgeTables with flags 3 (7 in mode 2, |8 with maybe_g_DepthBufferEnabled), so each row's ends carry the edge tables' quadratic fit of u/w and v/w (+0x18/+0x1c). Mode 1 turns *shadePtr into one ramp row (shade * (Raster_ShadeLevels (00485780) - 1) + g_RasterDepthFadeOffset) << 8. Each row is filled by the mode's affine span routine (Raster_SpanTextured, Raster_SpanTexturedShaded, Raster_SpanTexturedGouraud, or their Clipped variants when the depth buffer is on or the context's +0x208 is 2 and the clip-span table DAT_0047e92c is set), u and v stepped linearly between the row's two ends: perspective-correct at the edges, affine along each row. No caller found by es2_xref. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's maybe_Raster_DrawTexturedPolyW (WinScrollEvent_Clone (00468fec)), without its eighth (transparency) argument.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00421292; diff against DBSIM 00468fec

entries.name: RasterVertexBuffer_StaticInit
entries.description: Static initialiser (_INIT_ entry at 00480ff8, pointer at 00480ffa), frameless: Rtl_VectorNew(Raster_VertexBuffer (00486840), 0x28, 10, 1, RasterVertex_ElementCtor). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's RasterVertexBuffer_StaticInit (0046976c).

entries.name: RasterVertex_ElementCtor
entries.description: (vertex): returns vertex; the LEA EDX,[EAX+0x1c] is left over from an inlined empty member constructor at +0x1c, the view-space position. Raster_StaticInit's per-element constructor (the pointer at 00421a34). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's RasterVertex_ElementCtor (00469785).

entries.name: ShapeRender_BindNodeTransforms
entries.description: (shape, worldTransforms): stores worldTransforms at 004869d0, the array ShapeNode_InstallTransform indexes by transform id (stride 0x20); the first argument is not read. When it is not null, clears the 50 per-node composed flags at 0048a118, runs Raster_SaveState on 004869d8, marks flag 0 and clears the current id 0048a14c. TSShape_Render and TSShapeInstance_Render pass the shape's +0x18 before drawing.

entries.name: TSGroup_BindNodeTransform
entries.description: One-line forwarder: ShapeNode_InstallTransform(group, out, (short)*(group + 4)), +4 being the part's transform id. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's TSGroup_BindNodeTransform.

entries.name: ShapeNode_InstallTransform
entries.description: (part, out, transformId), assert file src\ts_part.cpp. A negative id returns to the base state: when a node is current it restores slot 0 (0045f528 on 004869d8), records that node's id in out+0x20 and clears the current id 0048a14c; with none current it sets out+0x20 to -1. The id that is already current sets out+0x20 to -1 and nothing else. Otherwise it pushes: saves the previous id in out+0x20, sets 0048a14c = id + 1 (asserting it stays under 0x32), and the first time an id is seen since the flags at 0048a118 were cleared composes the node's world transform (id * 0x20 into the array at [004869d0]) with the model-transform pointer saved in slot 0 at bind ([004869f8], slot 0 +0x20) into out (Transform_Concat), installs it with Raster_SetModelTransform and saves the resulting state in the 0x110-byte slot 004869d8 + id*0x110 (Raster_SaveState); a repeat restores that slot. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeNode_InstallTransform.

entries.name: TSRender_NoOp
entries.description: Empty function (a bare RET). The four shape and poly renderers that call it get no effect from the call.

entries.name: TSPartBase_FindPart
entries.description: TSPartBase vtable 0047f0f8 slot +0x20 (part, id): returns the part when its id (+6) is id, else 0. TSGroup, TSBSPGroup and TSBitmapPart inherit it; TSPartList_FindPart overrides it to search children. DBSIM's copy is 00476120.

entries.name: TSPartBase_FindPartSlot
entries.description: TSPartBase vtable 0047f0f8 slot +0x24 (part, id): returns 0; a leaf part holds no child slots. TSPartList_FindPartSlot overrides it.

entries.name: TSBounds_ScreenVisibility
entries.description: (bounds{+8 radius, +0xa/+0xc/+0xe centre int16}): Raster_ModelToView on the centre; 0 when the sphere lies wholly nearer than 005d7fd8. Otherwise projects the centre (Raster_Project, Raster_ToScreen), scales the radius to screen by a cached factor built from the view's width (Math_Atan2Bam, 004509c4, FixedMulQ10), and tests a box of that half-size plus 3 around the screen centre against the drawing context's rect +0x210..+0x21c: 0 when they do not overlap, 2 when the box is wholly inside when the clip mode +0x208 is 1, else 1. TSShape_Render and TSShapeInstance_Render call it.

entries.name: TSBitmapPart_Render
entries.description: Contains the 'TSBase::getBitmapPtr() : index out of range' assert. Reads poly+0x10 (the part's bitmap tag) as a frame index, bounds-checks against g_ActiveBitmapArray's count, looks up g_ActiveBitmapArray.Frames[frameIndex], and if non-null draws a textured quad using poly+0x12/+0x13 (the x and y offset bytes) for placement. This is the bitmap-tag-to-bitmap resolution path. See docs/retail/formats/dts-texture-binding.md.

entries.name: TSPartList_Ctor
entries.description: TSPartList constructor (vtable 00471ab8, RTTI 'TSPartList', 0x16 bytes): stamps ClassItem, TSBase, TSPartBase and its own vtable in turn, counting each level at *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, and clears the child count +0x10 and the child array +0x12. TSPartList_Construct, TSCellAnimPart_Construct, TSShape_Ctor, TSDetailPart_Ctor and TSBSPPart_Ctor run it. DBSIM's is TSPartList_Ctor (00476604).

entries.name: TSPartList_Dtor
entries.description: TSPartList vtable 00471ab8 slot +0x18 (list, flags): decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, restores the vtable, deletes each child of the array +0x12 (count +0x10) through its vtable +0x18 with 3, frees the array, decrements once more for TSPartBase, TSBase_Dtor(list, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set. The derived parts' destructors chain to it.

entries.name: TSPartList_Render
entries.description: TSPartList vtable 00471ab8 slot +0x1c (list): TSGroup_BindNodeTransform into a local, then each child of the array +0x12 (count +0x10) in order through its own vtable +0x1c, then TSRender_NoOp. TSShape inherits it, and TSShape_Render and TSShapeInstance_Render call it with g_ActiveBitmapArray bound to the shape's DBA.

entries.name: TSPartList_FindPart
entries.description: TSPartList vtable 00471ab8 slot +0x20 (list, id): returns the list itself when its id (+6) is id; otherwise asks each child of the array +0x12 (count +0x10) through its own slot +0x20, in order, and returns the first non-null answer. TSShape, TSDetailPart, TSBSPPart, TSCellAnimPart and ANShape inherit it. Identical after normalisation to DBSIM 00476744.

entries.name: TSPartList_FindPartSlot
entries.description: TSPartList vtable 00471ab8 slot +0x24 (list, id): returns the address of the entry of the child array +0x12 (count +0x10) whose part's id (+6) is id; when no direct child matches, asks each child through its own slot +0x24 and returns the first non-null answer. The address of the slot, not the part, is what lets a caller replace the part; see docs/retail/formats/mech-shape-drawing.md. DBSIM's copy is 00476784.

entries.name: TSCellAnimPart_Render
entries.description: TSCellAnimPart vtable 0047f12c slot +0x1c: TSGroup_BindNodeTransform into a local, then renders child [frame % count] through its vtable +0x1c, frame being the entry for its sequence +0x16 in the cell-frame array ShapeRender_BindCellFrames bound at 004869d4; then TSRender_NoOp. DBSIM's is TSCellAnimPart_Render (004767e4).

entries.name: TSDetailPart_Ctor
entries.description: TSDetailPart constructor (vtable 00471a84, RTTI 'TSDetailPart', 0x1a bytes): TSPartList_Ctor, its own vtable, and clears the size list +0x16. TSDetailPart_Construct runs it.

entries.name: TSDetailPart_Dtor
entries.description: TSDetailPart vtable 00471a84 slot +0x18 (part, flags): decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, restores the vtable, frees the size list +0x16, TSPartList_Dtor(part, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSDetailPart_SetSizeScale
entries.description: (scale): writes g_TSDetailPartSizeScaleQ10 (004719c8), the Q10 factor TSDetailPart_Render applies to a part's projected size before comparing it with the part's thresholds; the image holds 1024. No caller found by es2_xref. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's TSDetailPart_SetSizeScale (0047689c).

entries.name: TSDetailPart_SetBias
entries.description: (bias): writes g_TSDetailPartBias (004719cc), the level index TSDetailPart_Render starts its walk from and subtracts again when indexing the parts; the image holds 0. No caller found by es2_xref. The VSHELL counterpart of DBSIM's TSDetailPart_SetBias (004768ac).

entries.name: TSDetailPart_Render
entries.description: TSDetailPart vtable 00471a84 slot +0x1c, the LOD selection: size = (radius +8 << the focal shift 005d7fd4) / max(Math_FastMagnitude3D(eye) - radius, 1), at least 1; t = FixedMulQ10(004719c8, size); i starts at the bias 004719cc and advances while the threshold [i] of +0x16 is below t and i is below the last; renders child [min(i - bias, count - 1)] through its vtable +0x1c, then TSRender_NoOp. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's TSDetailPart_Render (004768bc); 004719c8 is 1024 (Q10 one) and 004719cc 0 in the image, as DBSIM's g_TSDetailPartSizeScaleQ10 and g_TSDetailPartBias are.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 004221e7; es2_naming.py diff VSHELL 004221e7 DBSIM 004768bc

entries.name: TSBSPPart_Ctor
entries.description: TSBSPPart constructor (vtable 00471a50, RTTI 'TSBSPPart', 0x20 bytes): TSPartList_Ctor, its own vtable, and clears the node count +0x16, the nodes +0x18 and the per-node transform ids +0x1c. TSBSPPart_Construct runs it.

entries.name: TSBSPPart_Dtor
entries.description: TSBSPPart vtable 00471a50 slot +0x18 (part, flags): decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, restores the vtable, frees +0x18 and +0x1c, TSPartList_Dtor(part, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSBSPPart_RenderNode
entries.description: The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's TSBSPPart_RenderNode (00476a1c): (part, node) walks the part's BSP tree back to front from one node, testing the eye against the node plane (through the node's transform when its id at +0x1c is not -1) and drawing children through their vtable +0x1c. It has a block DBSIM's lacks, ahead of the walk: while the byte 0047e9a4 is set it composes the node's view transform and draws the node's plane as a gizmo, three lines in colour 0x77 and one in 0x7f, through Gfx_DrawLine. 0047e9a4 is 0 in the image, and es2_xref.py finds this read as its only absolute reference (Open).

entries.name: TSBSPPart_Render
entries.description: TSBSPPart vtable 00471a50 slot +0x1c: TSGroup_BindNodeTransform into a local, copies the eye position (g_EyeInModelSpace, 005d7fcc, 005d7fd0) to 0048a150..0048a158, TSBSPPart_RenderNode(part, 0), then TSRender_NoOp. Matches DBSIM's 00476b0c.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 0042286d; es2_naming.py diff VSHELL 0042286d DBSIM 00476b0c

entries.name: TSTransformState_StaticInit
entries.description: Static initialiser (_INIT_ entry at 00480ffe, pointer at 00481000), in an Eh_InitExceptBlock frame (004719e0): Rtl_VectorNew(&g_TSTransformStates (004869d8), 0x110, 0x34, 1, TSTransformState_Ctor), 52 TSTransformStates, the count its debug string 'TSTransformState[52]' (00422963) names. TSTransformState_StaticDtor deletes them. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's TSTransformState_StaticInit (00476b64).

entries.name: TSTransformState_StaticDtor
entries.description: Exit routine (_EXIT_ entry at 0048104c, pointer at 0048104e), frameless: Rtl_VectorDelete(&g_TSTransformStates (004869d8), 0x110, 0x34, 1, TSTransformState_Dtor). Identical after normalisation to DBSIM's TSTransformState_StaticDtor (00476ba4).

entries.name: TSTransformState_Ctor
entries.description: TSTransformState constructor, and the element constructor TSTransformState_StaticInit passes Rtl_VectorNew (stored pointer at 004228d4): (state) Rtl_VectorNew of ten 0x16-byte TSContexts at +0x34 with TSContext_Ctor, increments *Rtl_DtorCountPtr and returns state. The LEAs of +0x14 and +0x28 are left over from inlined empty member constructors. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's TSTransformState_Ctor (00476bc0).

entries.name: TSTransformState_Dtor
entries.description: TSTransformState's destructor, the dtor its class record (RTTI 'TSTransformState', 0x110 bytes, at 004229b1) names: (state, flags) for a non-null state decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, Rtl_VectorDelete over the ten 0x16-byte TSContexts at +0x34 with TSContext_Dtor, then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.
entries.source: es2_classes.scan: the Borland class record's +0x28 destructor; VSHELL decompile

entries.name: TSNullObj_Render
entries.description: TSNullObj slot +0x1c: does nothing.

entries.name: TSPoly_Render
entries.description: TSPoly vtable 0047ee90 slot +0x1c: does nothing. The derived polys override it (TSSolidPoly_Render and its siblings).

entries.name: TSSolidPoly_Render
entries.description: TSSolidPoly's real vtable-slot-0x1c render method (see g_TSSolidPolyVtable). Resolves the surface record via (surfaceField*4 + g_ActiveSurfaceRecords) -- the same *4 stride as TSTexture4Poly_Render, consistent with the poly's surface field holding surfaceIndex*4. Runs TSPoly_FrontBackVisibilityTest against poly+4/+6 (normal/centre point indices, each *6 into the three-short point array) to pick front (piVar3[0]/[1] = Front/FrontLine) or back (piVar3[2]/[3] = Back/BackLine) color pair -- confirms the surface entry's 4-slot Front/FrontLine/Back/BackLine layout applies to flat polys too, not just textured ones. Skips drawing if both resolved color dwords have top byte 0x18-shift == 0x14 (looks like an uninitialized/sentinel guard, not chased further). Otherwise projects and clips via Poly_ProjectShapeVertices/Poly_ClipRingToNearPlane and fills via PolyFill_FillThenOutline -- the chain TSTexture4Poly_Render's g_TexturedPolyUseBitmapBrush branch also uses, there with a bitmap brush installed in place of the default colour brush. No dithering/lighting-ramp math visible anywhere in this chain -- VSHELL (a shell/viewer app) passes the front/back colours straight through to the fill routines, unlike DBSIM's in-mission renderer.

entries.name: TSTexture4Poly_Render
entries.description: TSTexture4Poly's vtable-slot-0x1c render method (see g_TSTexture4PolyVtable). Reads poly+0xc (the surface field) as MOVZX (unsigned short), SHL 2 (x4) to a byte offset into g_ActiveSurfaceRecords (g_ActiveSurfaceRecords), then reads front=*(int32*)(base+offset) and back=*(int32*)(base+offset+8), i.e. two int32 slots on -- read from ES2DumpAsm raw disassembly, not just the decompiler. A TSGroup's on-disk surface count is stored as surfaceCount*4 and each surface entry is four slots (Front, FrontLine, Back, BackLine), so the surface field holds surfaceIndex*4: the front value is surface[field/4].Front and the back value surface[field/4].Back. Front/back is chosen by TSPoly_FrontBackVisibilityTest against poly+4/+6; when the ramp row count DAT_0047e9ac is non-zero the face's shade comes from Light_ComputeShadeForFace, with the normal negated for a back face. g_TexturedPolyUseBitmapBrush (00471890) chooses between two textured fills: this descriptor-and-rasterizer path (flag == 0) and a 2D bitmap-brush fill of the frame's bitmap (flag != 0; see the flag's entry). Only the flag == 0 path reaches TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA/B. In that path the resolved frame index indexes the 20-byte-stride per-frame descriptor table at g_ActiveBitmapArray[1] (a pointer distinct from the DBA object itself): int32 fields F0..F3 (bytes 0-15) and F4 at byte 16, passed to the rasterizer as param_4 (a pixel-data handle). The quad's UV corners are [V0=(F0,F1), V1=(F2,F1), V2=(F2,F3), V3=(F0,F3)] (decompiled assignment sequence _DAT_0048a190.._0048a1ac = F0,F1,F2,F1,F2,F3,F0,F3): an axis-aligned rect, top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, with F0/F1 the frame's texture-space left/top and F2/F3 its right/bottom. The function that builds that descriptor table, which decides whether F0/F1 can be nonzero, is open. See docs/retail/formats/dts-texture-binding.md.

entries.name: TSShadedPoly_Render
entries.description: TSShadedPoly vtable 0047ede0 slot +0x1c: TSSolidPoly_Render's front/back surface-pair selection (g_ActiveSurfaceRecords + colour*4, TSPoly_FrontBackVisibilityTest on the normal +4 and centre +6) and its skip when both colours carry 0x14 in the top byte; then shade = Light_ComputeShadeForFace(normal, centre), the normal negated for a back face, and the shade's low byte ORed into bits 16-23 of both the fill (PolyFill_FillColour) and line (PolyFill_LineColour) colour words; then projects the +8 vertices from list +0xa (Poly_ProjectShapeVertices), clips to the near plane when that returns 1, and PolyFill_FillThenOutline(backFacing). DBSIM's TSShadedPoly_Render (0047542c) differs at the shade step: it resolves the final palette bytes itself through Palette_ShadeRampLookup and Raster_ShadeRampRow(0x80) instead of packing the shade into the words.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 00423024; es2_naming.py diff VSHELL 00423024 DBSIM 0047542c

entries.name: TSGouraudPoly_Render
entries.description: TSGouraudPoly vtable 0047edb4 slot +0x1c: the surface-pair selection and skip of TSSolidPoly_Render, then one shade per vertex: Light_ComputeShadeForFace(the vertex's normal from the list +0xe, the vertex from the list +0xa), the normal negated for a back face, low byte into a local array; then projects the +8 vertices. When the projection reports 1 (a near-plane crossing) Poly_ClipRingToNearPlaneWithShade builds the clipped ring's shade array from it and the fill uses that one; either way PolyFill_FillBrush's mode = 1, the shade array goes to 005d800c and PolyFill_FillThenOutline(backFacing) draws. Matches DBSIM's 004755c8.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 00423193; es2_naming.py diff VSHELL 00423193 DBSIM 004755c8

entries.name: TSGroup_Ctor
entries.description: TSGroup constructor (vtable 00471bf4, RTTI 'TSGroup', 0x28 bytes): stamps ClassItem, TSBase, TSPartBase and its own vtable, counting each level at *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, and clears the index list +0x10, the point list +0x14, the colour list +0x18 and the item list +0x1c. TSGroup_Construct and TSBSPGroup_Ctor run it.

entries.name: TSGroup_Dtor
entries.description: TSGroup vtable 00471bf4 slot +0x18 (group, flags): decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, restores the vtable, frees the index, point and colour lists, deletes each item of +0x1c (count +0x26) through its vtable +0x18 with 3, frees that list, decrements for TSPartBase, TSBase_Dtor(group, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSGroup_RenderPolys
entries.description: TSGroup's render method: slot +0x1c of the vtable at 00471bf4, whose RTTI names TSGroup (0x28 bytes). Calls TSGroup_BindNodeTransform into a local transform, saves the render context's (0048e184) +0x228, +0x22c and +0x20c, installs the default brushes PolyFill_LineBrush and PolyFill_FillBrush at +0x228 and +0x22c and clears +0x20c. Publishes the group's colour list (+0x18) as g_ActiveSurfaceRecords, its points (+0x14, three int16 each) at 005d8894 and its indexes (+0x10, or Poly_SequentialIndices when null) at Poly_RingIndices. Copies the point count +0x22 to 005d889c, asserts it is at most 1000 (severity 4, ts_base.h line 0x2e7) and zeroes that many bytes of the per-point scratch at Poly_VertexState. Then draws the +0x26 items of the +0x1c pointer array in order, each through its own vtable slot +0x1c, restores the three context fields and calls TSRender_NoOp. TSBSPGroup_Render is the TSBSPGroup counterpart, drawing the polys in BSP order instead. Field names from TSGroup_DebugPrint; see docs/retail/formats/dts-texture-binding.md.
entries.source: VSHELL disassembly at 00423497; tools/scripts/es2_naming.py rtti VSHELL 00471bf4; VSHELL_vtables_full.txt

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_Ctor
entries.description: TSBSPGroup constructor (vtable 00471bc0, RTTI 'TSBSPGroup', 0x2e bytes): TSGroup_Ctor, its own vtable, and clears the node count +0x28 and node array +0x2a. TSBSPGroup_Construct runs it.

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_Dtor
entries.description: TSBSPGroup vtable 00471bc0 slot +0x18 (group, flags): decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, restores the vtable, frees the nodes +0x2a, TSGroup_Dtor(group, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_RenderNode
entries.description: (group, node): draws a TSBSPGroup's polys by its BSP tree from one node. Nodes are 10 bytes at group+0x2a: int32 plane constant, uint16 poly index (into the polys at +0x1c), and two int16 children at +6 and +8. The plane is the node poly's own stored normal (poly+4, a point index into +0x14): d = dot(normal, g_EyeInModelSpace) - constant. For d < 0 it draws the +6 child, then the node's poly, then the +8 child; otherwise the +8 child first. A child below zero is nothing, one with bit 0x4000 the poly [value & 0x3fff], and anything else a node to recurse into; polys draw through their vtable slot +0x1c. TSBSPGroup_Render starts it at node 0.

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_Render
entries.description: TSBSPGroup's render method: slot +0x1c of the vtable at 00471bc0, whose RTTI names TSBSPGroup (0x2e bytes). Sets up like TSGroup's render: TSGroup_BindNodeTransform, the default brushes PolyFill_LineBrush and PolyFill_FillBrush installed at the context's +0x228 and +0x22c with +0x20c cleared, the group's surfaces (+0x18), points (+0x14) and indexes (+0x10, defaulted when null), and a zeroed scratch of +0x22 bytes, asserting that count is at most 1000. Then draws the polys by the group's BSP tree through TSBSPGroup_RenderNode from node 0 rather than in order, and restores the three context fields. See docs/retail/formats/dts-texture-binding.md.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00423709; tools/scripts/es2_naming.py rtti VSHELL 00471bc0; VSHELL_vtables_full.txt

entries.name: TSAliasSolidPoly_Render
entries.description: TSAliasSolidPoly vtable 0047ed88 slot +0x1c: the surface-pair selection, skip, projection and near-plane clip of the solid poly, then PolyFill_FillBrush's mode = 0 and the fill PolyFill_FillThenOutline_Thunk(backFacing) where the non-alias polys call PolyFill_FillThenOutline. Matches DBSIM's 00475bc4.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 00423816; es2_naming.py diff VSHELL 00423816 DBSIM 00475bc4

entries.name: TSAliasShadedPoly_Render
entries.description: TSAliasShadedPoly vtable 0047ed5c slot +0x1c: TSShadedPoly_Render with the fill PolyFill_FillThenOutline_Thunk in place of PolyFill_FillThenOutline, the shade packed into bits 16-23 of both colour words. Matches DBSIM's 00475c80, which packs the shade the same way.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 004238d9; es2_naming.py diff VSHELL 004238d9 DBSIM 00475c80

entries.name: TSAliasGouraudPoly_Render
entries.description: TSAliasGouraudPoly vtable 0047ed30 slot +0x1c: TSGouraudPoly_Render with the fill PolyFill_FillThenOutline_Thunk in place of PolyFill_FillThenOutline. Matches DBSIM's 00475de0.
