entries.name: Repair_OnRepair
entries.description: The repair screen's REPAIR handler: Repair_SelectionCost off CareerSalvage, then HercStatus_Set of the selection to Repair_TargetForLevel(Repair_DamageLevel(condition)); refills the row and Repair_RefreshDetail.

entries.name: Repair_OnRepairAll
entries.description: The repair screen's REPAIR ALL handler: Repair_HercCost(herc, 100) off CareerSalvage, Repair_Apply(herc, 100), Repair_FillAllRows.

entries.name: Repair_OnScrap
entries.description: The repair screen's SCRAP handler: ScrapDialog_Show.

entries.name: Repair_OnCancel
entries.description: The repair screen's CANCEL handler: CareerSalvage back from RepairSnapshotSalvage and the status block at RepairSnapshotStatus copied over the selected machine, Repair_FillAllRows. Does not leave the screen.

entries.name: Repair_StaticInit
entries.description: Borland static initialiser, _INIT_ entry 00481010 (priority 0x20): HercStatus_InitAll(RepairSnapshotStatus, RepairSnapshotStatus (0048d260)), so the snapshot block Repair_OnCancel copies back holds 100 in every condition until Repair_Snapshot first fills it. Frameless: PUSH; CALL; POP ECX; RET.

entries.name: HercList_CopySelectedStatus
entries.description: Copies the status block (+0x08, 0x42 bytes) of the machine in the bay list's selected slot (list +0x22) into the caller's buffer; with the slot empty it writes nothing.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_Build
entries.description: Builds VSHELL's PREFERENCES screen (estext.bin 0x103): the Music and Sound Effects checkboxes (prefs options 0 and 1), Repair Options three ways (option 44), Weapons Building two (45), Game Resolution two (4) and Display Mode two (6). It is the one screen that edits the half of prefs.cfg DBSIM shares.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_Enter
entries.description: Seeds the PREFERENCES screen from the option array: options 0 and 1 into the two checkboxes, then 44, 45, 4 and 6 through their setters, each of which writes the option back and relights its radio group.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_Hide
entries.description: Window_HideRecursive on PreferencesScreen_Root and PreferencesScreen_Panel, PreferencesScreen_Enter's inverse. The Cancel (00436b90) and Accept (00436c51) handlers end in it.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_SyncSoundChecks
entries.description: Sets the tick (+0x69) of the Music checkbox 0048d30c from option 0 (ShellOptions) and of the Sound Effects checkbox 0048d310 from option 1 (ShellOption_Sounds), repainting each through its vtable slot +4. PreferencesScreen_Enter calls it.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_SyncDisplayModeRadios
entries.description: Lights one of the pair 0048d2d0 / 0048d2d4 from ShellOption_DisplayMode (0 or 1), clearing the other's tick (+0x69) and repainting both. Any other value changes nothing. PreferencesScreen_SetDisplayMode calls it.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_ToggleAudioOption
entries.description: (which): 0 toggles MUSIC (option 0) with a fade -- on, ShellOptions_ToggleOption then ShellSound_FadeIn; off, ShellSound_FadeOut then the toggle; 1 toggles SOUNDS (option 1); 2 sets ShellOption_PilotMessage to 2 from 0 and to 0 from 1 or 2; 3 sets it to 1 from 0, 2 from 1 and 1 from 2. Then PreferencesScreen_SyncSoundChecks. The Music (00436cc1) and Sound Effects (00436d22) checkboxes pass 0 and 1.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_SyncRepairModeRadios
entries.description: Lights one of the Repair Mode three from ShellOption_RepairMode: 0048d324 for 0, 0048d328 for 1, 0048d32c for 2, clearing the other two's tick (+0x69) and repainting all three (vtable +4). Any other value changes nothing. PreferencesScreen_Enter and PreferencesScreen_SetRepairMode call it.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_SyncResolutionRadios
entries.description: Lights one of the pair 0048d304 / 0048d308 from ShellOption_GameResolution (0 or 1), clearing the other's tick (+0x69) and repainting both. Any other value changes nothing.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_SetRepairMode
entries.description: (value): stores the value at 00474cc4, sets option 0x2c (ShellOption_RepairMode) with its handler, and refreshes the row's buttons (PreferencesScreen_SyncRepairModeRadios).

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_SetGameResolution
entries.description: (value): stores the value at 00474cc6, sets option 4 (ShellOption_GameResolution) with its handler, and refreshes the row's buttons (PreferencesScreen_SyncResolutionRadios).

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_SyncBuildModeRadios
entries.description: Lights one of the Weapons Building pair from ShellOption_WeaponsBuildMode: 0048d33c for 0 (AutoBuild), 0048d340 for 1 (Manually Build), clearing the other's tick (+0x69) and repainting both. Any other value changes nothing.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_SetWeaponsBuildMode
entries.description: (value): stores the value at 00474cc8, sets option 0x2d (ShellOption_WeaponsBuildMode) with its handler, and refreshes the row with PreferencesScreen_SyncBuildModeRadios.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_SetDisplayMode
entries.description: (value): stores the value at 00474cca, sets option 6 (ShellOption_DisplayMode) with its handler, and refreshes the row's buttons (PreferencesScreen_SyncDisplayModeRadios).

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_OnCancel
entries.description: (event): the preferences screen's Cancel handler: ShellOptions_RevertAll(0), which puts every option that differs from ShellOptionsShadow back without running its handler; Display_ToggleFullScreen when ShellOption_DisplayMode and Display_FullScreen disagree; then with MUSIC (option 0) off, ShellOptions_ToggleOption(0, 1), ShellSound_FadeOut, ShellOptions_ToggleOption(0, 1), and with it on ShellSound_FadeIn; PreferencesScreen_Hide, MainMenu_Show, and deletes the event. Stored pointer at 00435321 in PreferencesScreen_Build (estext 0x10b 'Cancel').

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_OnAccept
entries.description: (event): the preferences screen's Accept handler: ShellOptions_Commit(0), ShellOptions_SaveAll, PreferencesScreen_Hide, MainMenu_Show, and deletes the event. Stored pointer at 004353b3 in PreferencesScreen_Build (estext 0x10c 'Accept').

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_OnMusic
entries.description: (event): PreferencesScreen_ToggleAudioOption(0), then deletes the event. The Music checkbox's handler (stored pointer at 00435e50 in PreferencesScreen_Build).

entries.description: (event): PreferencesScreen_ToggleAudioOption(1), then deletes the event. The Sound Effects checkbox's handler (stored pointer at 00435ee8 in PreferencesScreen_Build).

The display box's 'Full Screen' checkbox handler (stored pointer at 00435877 in PreferencesScreen_Build).

entries.name: SaveScreen_RefreshDetail
entries.description: Rewrites the detail panel's twelve value fields from the selected slot's staging record: name, skill and rank words, six kill counters, salvage in tons, sector word and mission plus one. Writes estext.bin entry 0, the empty string, into all twelve when the slot holds no save.

entries.name: SaveScreen_BeginRename
entries.description: Returns at once when the rename state is 0. Otherwise posts an event at the selected row, moves the pointer onto it (Pointer_SetTarget, 00469cbc) and locks it there (+0x1f of g_EventQueue), sets the row's caret flags +0xbf and +0xb3, rewrites the row as '%2d. ' with the name blanked, lights CANCEL and ACCEPT, and sets the rename state to 2.

entries.name: SaveScreen_SelectSlot
entries.description: Moves the slot selection. Returns early for the slot already selected unless a rename is live, repaints the outgoing row at 0x27 and the incoming at 0x29, regates SAVE and RESTORE, then refreshes the detail panel.

entries.name: SaveScreen_SetRowText
entries.description: Sets one slot row's string: the GAMEFILE.STR label when the second argument is zero, otherwise a formatted '%2d. %s' of the slot number and that argument.

entries.name: SaveScreen_RowText
entries.description: Returns the slot row's own string buffer (+0x45), or an empty string when the row is not built. ACCEPT passes it to Game_SaveSlot as the slot's new label.

entries.name: SaveScreen_OnSave
entries.description: The SAVE button. Writes nothing: sets the rename state to 1, greys SAVE, RESTORE and EXIT, and calls SaveScreen_BeginRename. ACCEPT is what writes the save.

entries.name: SaveScreen_OnRestore
entries.description: The RESTORE button. Game_LoadSlot(selected, 1), Game_SaveSlot(10, NULL) as the current-game autosave, the save screen teardown, clears DAT_004778aa, then Shell_SelectTabPalette(8) and ServiceBay_RefreshTabStrip -- EXIT's tab-strip path whatever SaveScreen_ExitTarget holds.

entries.name: SaveScreen_OnExit
entries.description: The EXIT button. Tears the screen down and then returns to where 0048d344 says: 0 rebuilds the main menu, 8 installs palette case 8 and refreshes the tab strip.

entries.name: SaveScreen_OnCancel
entries.description: The CANCEL button. Restores the row's GAMEFILE.STR label, greys CANCEL and ACCEPT, lights SAVE, RESTORE and EXIT, rename state to 0, then SaveScreen_SelectSlot(10), which deselects the row and regates SAVE and RESTORE off.

entries.name: SaveScreen_OnAccept
entries.description: The ACCEPT button. Game_SaveSlot(selected, the row's typed text), Stats_StageCurrentGame, refreshes the detail panel, greys CANCEL and ACCEPT, lights SAVE, RESTORE and EXIT, rename state to 0.

entries.name: SaveScreen_OnRow0
entries.description: (event): save slot row 0's click handler, entry 0 of SaveScreen_RowHandlers (0048d37c), which SaveScreen_BuildScreen fills and passes to each row's constructor: SaveScreen_SelectSlot(0), then deletes the event (Rtl_GetPolymorphicDtorCount into [Rtl_DtorCountPtr], virtual dtor +0x18 with 3).

entries.name: SaveScreen_OnRow1
entries.description: (event): save slot row 1's click handler, entry 1 of SaveScreen_RowHandlers (0048d37c): SaveScreen_SelectSlot(1), then deletes the event (Rtl_GetPolymorphicDtorCount into [Rtl_DtorCountPtr], virtual dtor +0x18 with 3).

entries.name: SaveScreen_OnRow2

entries.name: SaveScreen_BuildScreen
entries.description: Builds tab 1, SAVED GAMES: the backdrop root, the titled content panel, the slot list frame, ten editable slot rows, five buttons and the detail panel's 22 text fields. Every rect is four immediates on its own stack; opens no file.

entries.name: SaveScreen_Enter
entries.description: Tab 1's entry routine. Sets all ten row texts from the GAMEFILE.STR labels, gates SAVE on 0048260a and RESTORE on the selected slot's in-use byte, highlights the selected row and refreshes the detail panel. Does not build: SaveScreen_BuildScreen does that once.

entries.name: SaveScreen_Teardown
entries.description: Called first by both the EXIT and the RESTORE handlers. SaveScreen_SelectSlot(10), then Window_HideRecursive on the save screen's content panel (0048d34c), root (0048d348) and both detail panels (0048d3b8, 0048d418).

entries.name: Shell_SetPaletteScope
entries.description: Hides PaletteScopeWidget, writes the palette index to its +0x45 and shows it again, which installs that palette.

entries.name: TabStrip_ClearAllLit
entries.description: Clears +0x45 on all nine strip buttons and repaints them. Every tab handler starts here; tabs 2-7 then write their own back to 1 and the main menu's and save's do not, which is why the strip is drawn unlit while either of those is up.

entries.name: Shell_TeardownCurrentTab
entries.description: Tears down whatever tab CurrentTabIndex names, dispatching per tab; the squad panel's hide (Squad_HidePanel) is part of four of the cases.

entries.name: TabHandler_MenuButton
entries.description: The square button's click handler; calls into wmain.cpp at 004317ea.

entries.name: TabHandler_MainMenu
entries.description: Tab 0. Tears down, installs palette 1, autosaves through Game_SaveSlot(10, NULL), then builds the main menu. Does not latch its own plate.

entries.name: TabHandler_Save
entries.description: Tab 1. Tears down, installs palette 1, sets 0048d344 to 8 and builds the save screen. Does not latch its own plate.

entries.name: TabHandler_Weapons
entries.description: Tab 2. Latches its plate, shows the squad panel and builds the arming screen.

entries.name: TabHandler_Repair
entries.description: Tab 3. Latches its plate, shows the squad panel and builds the repair screen.

entries.name: TabHandler_Build
entries.description: Tab 4. Latches its plate, shows the squad panel and builds the build screen.

entries.name: TabHandler_Armory
entries.description: Tab 5. Latches its plate and builds the armory screen; the only latching tab with no squad panel.

entries.name: TabHandler_Crew
entries.description: Tab 6. Latches its plate, shows the squad panel and builds the crew screen.

entries.name: TabHandler_Mission
entries.description: Tab 7. Picks the mission sub-mode -- 0 (campaign map) when 004778aa and CampaignMissionInStage are both zero, else 1 (briefing) -- and calls Mission_ShowView.

entries.name: Mission_ShowView
entries.description: Stores the mission sub-mode in MissionScreenView, installs that view's palette and builds the mission screen. Also called by the campaign layer with the debrief mode.

entries.name: ServiceBay_BuildScreen
entries.description: wsrvbayi.cpp (service/repair bay tab) screen builder, located via __FILE__ assert-string xref. Every widget's {x,y,w,h} rect is a plain immediate literal in this function (e.g. local_5c=0x27f, local_58=0x1df); no fopen/Volume/ClassIO/fread call anywhere in the function. Confirms VSHELL's tab-screen layouts are hardcoded pixel constants compiled into the EXE, not driven by any data file.

entries.name: ServiceBay_RefreshTabStrip
entries.description: The tab gate. Shows the shell panel (and with it the strip), then writes +0x49 on tabs 2-6 from CampaignModeFlag -- REPAIR, BUILD and ARMORY off in training, all five on in the campaign -- and parks CurrentTabIndex at 0xffff.

entries.name: Shell_SelectTabPalette
entries.description: Picks a tab's palette index and hands it to Shell_SetPaletteScope. Tab 3 takes 1, tabs 2 and 4-6 take 2, tab 7 takes stage+4 (briefing), stage+9 (debrief) or 3/4 (map). Case 8 is not a tab: it shows the shell root (ShellRootWidget), undoing ServiceBay_Show.

entries.name: ServiceBay_Show
entries.description: Despite the name, HIDES the shell panel and root -- and with the panel every tab-strip button -- then installs palette 1 (dpl\palette.dpl). Called by tabs 0 and 1, so the main menu and the save screen stand alone with no strip. The name predates the Widget_Show/HideRecursive swap; Shell_SelectTabPalette(8) plus ServiceBay_RefreshTabStrip undo it.

entries.name: SaveRegistration_BuildPanel
entries.description: Builds a second registration panel into the save screen's stub panel DAT_0048d418 at startup (Shell_BuildScreensAndStart at 004012f2): FramedPanel DAT_0048d470, prompt, name box DAT_0048d47c and field DAT_0048d480, Text readout DAT_0048d484, SKILL LEVEL (0043bd15), CANCEL (0043bd90) and ACCEPT (0043bf1b). No show of DAT_0048d418 or DAT_0048d470 found by an absolute-operand search.

entries.name: SaveRegistration_ShowDetailPanel
entries.description: Window_HideRecursive on 0048d470 and 0048d418, then Window_ShowRecursive on the detail panel 0048d3b8. SaveRegistration_OnAccept and 0043bd90 call it.

entries.name: Registration_BuildScreen
entries.description: Builds the registration screen once at startup (Shell_BuildScreensAndStart at 004012f7): the backdrop root DAT_0048d494, the TitledPanel DAT_0048d498 {0xce,0xc6,0x1b2,0x144} (REGISTRATION), the FramedPanel DAT_0048d49c, the prompt, the disabled name box DAT_0048d4a4 and its edit field DAT_0048d4a8 (set 00476169, handler 0043bdee), the skill readout DAT_0048d4ac, SKILL LEVEL (0043c01d), CANCEL (0043c098) and ACCEPT DAT_0048d4b8 (0043c0fb), built greyed. Verified: estext 0x30-0x34 captions, and the three widgets Registration_Show and Registration_Hide name.

entries.name: Registration_Show
entries.description: START NEW GAME's screen up: shows DAT_0048d494, DAT_0048d498 and DAT_0048d49c (Registration_BuildScreen's root, panel and box), posts a left press at the name field DAT_0048d4a8, sets the pointer's target to it (Pointer_SetTarget) and locks it.

entries.name: Registration_Hide
entries.description: Hides the registration screen's root, panel and box (DAT_0048d494, DAT_0048d498, DAT_0048d49c). Called by CANCEL (0043c098) and ACCEPT (0043c0fb).

entries.name: SaveRegistration_ShowSkillText
entries.description: Sets the text widget 0048d484 to the ES text string RegistrationSkillChoice + 0x35 (WeaponsBin_LookupName on EsTextBinHandle), colour 2, 0x29, 1. SaveRegistration_BuildPanel and SaveRegistration_StepSkill call it.

entries.name: SaveRegistration_StepSkill
entries.description: SKILL LEVEL on the save screen's second registration panel (SaveRegistration_BuildPanel): steps RegistrationSkillChoice modulo 4 and rewrites that panel's readout DAT_0048d484 from estext.bin 0x35 + skill (SaveRegistration_ShowSkillText). Not the registration screen's; that is 0043c01d.

entries.name: SaveRegistration_OnCancel
entries.description: (event): the second registration panel's CANCEL handler, which SaveRegistration_BuildPanel pushes (0043b5a6) to the ESButtonFont_Ctor (string 0x33) it parents to 0048d418 and stores at SaveRegistration_CancelButton (0048d48c): SaveRegistration_ShowDetailPanel, then deletes the event (Rtl_GetPolymorphicDtorCount into [Rtl_DtorCountPtr], virtual dtor +0x18 with 3).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile and disassembly at 0043bd90; store site 0043b5a6

entries.name: Registration_OnNameEvent
entries.description: The registration name field's handler (+0x3d, written by Registration_BuildScreen): on an event 0x40 (character) or 0x100 (command) writes the greying trio at ACCEPT (DAT_0048d4b8) from the field's first character -- 0x26/0x26/disabled while empty, 0x29/0x22/enabled otherwise.

entries.name: SaveRegistration_OnAccept
entries.description: ACCEPT on the save screen's second registration panel (SaveRegistration_BuildPanel): Game_NewCareer(DAT_0048d480's string, RegistrationSkillChoice), Stats_StageCurrentGame(10), SaveRegistration_ShowDetailPanel (hides DAT_0048d470 and DAT_0048d418, shows the detail panel DAT_0048d3b8), then lights SAVE (DAT_0048d3ac). Not the registration screen's; that is 0043c0fb.

entries.name: Registration_ShowSkillText
entries.description: Sets the text widget at +0x55 of 0048d4ac to the ES text string RegistrationSkillChoice + 0x35, keeping its colour +0x45 and +0xb5. Registration_BuildScreen and Registration_StepSkill call it.

entries.name: Registration_StepSkill
entries.description: SKILL LEVEL's handler on the registration screen: steps RegistrationSkillChoice modulo 4 and rewrites the readout DAT_0048d4ac from estext.bin 0x35 + skill (Registration_ShowSkillText). Reads no button sub-code, so either button's release steps forward.

entries.name: Registration_OnCancel
entries.description: CANCEL's handler on the registration screen: Registration_Hide, then MainMenu_Show.

entries.name: Registration_OnAccept
entries.description: ACCEPT's handler on the registration screen: LoadHercInfDat, Registration_Hide, DAT_004778aa = 0, Game_NewCareer(name field's string, RegistrationSkillChoice), then MissionScreenView = (CampaignMissionInStage != 0) -- 0, the map view, before the posted Use Default click loads the mission.

entries.name: Hotspots_BuildOverlay
entries.description: wsquadi.cpp. Builds the clickable-region overlay for the arming tab (mode 2, gam\arm_hots.dat) or the repair tab (mode 3, gam\rpr_hots.dat), one Panel per area over each of the eight bay slots' chassis pictures. Not the squad roster list: the name it carried before described the module, not the function.

entries.name: Squad_FreeTabWidgets
entries.description: Frees the nine arrays at 00476328 (Mem_DeleteArray), then for each of the eight squad slots at 00482ac3 that has a chassis (HercList_ChassisAt) and a widget array at 00476308: detaches and deletes that slot's widgets -- the member's +0x4c of them on tab 2, 0048d57c[chassis] plus the member's +0x4e on tab 3, none on any other tab (CurrentTabIndex) -- and frees the array. Squad_FreeTabPictures calls it.

entries.name: Squad_BuildTabPictures
entries.description: Per-tab picture builder the squad panel's show runs: tab 3 builds the repair diagrams and their hotspot overlay, tabs 2, 4 and 6 Squad_BuildBayPictures (00414e5b), tab 2 the arming hotspots as well.

entries.name: Squad_FreeTabPictures
entries.description: The teardown counterpart of Squad_BuildTabPictures, per tab.

entries.name: Squad_BuildRosterList
entries.description: wsquadi.cpp: builds the squad panel -- the eight per-bay picture Grids and the empty one at {5, 0x2b, 0xeb, 0x130}, the Pilot/Skill/Condition label and value Texts, the Squad Inventory TitledPanel and its eight four-column rows on a 14-pixel pitch -- then loads the armory and repair layouts.

entries.name: Squad_ShowPanel
entries.description: Puts up the per-slot panel the WEAPONS, REPAIR, BUILD and CREW tabs share: runs the tab's picture builder (0043c915), refills the readout and the roster, shows the selected bay's picture (or the empty one at 0048d4dc for no bay), the six readout texts and the roster, and colours the eight roster rows -- 0x29 on the selected one, 0x10 on the rest.

entries.name: Squad_HidePanel
entries.description: The mirror of Squad_ShowPanel, run from Shell_TeardownCurrentTab.

entries.name: Squad_RefreshAfterScrap
entries.description: Squad_SetEmptyBayPicture, repaint of the selected bay's picture, the readout, the roster names and crew; on tab 3 the repair salvage figure (004338b3), on tab 4 Build_RefreshSalvage.

entries.name: Squad_ColorSelectedBayPicture
entries.description: (tab): when tab is 3 (the number TabHandler_Repair stores in CurrentTabIndex), writes into the selected bay's picture (SquadSlotPictureWidgets[SelectedBaySlot]) part i's +0x75 word (part stride 0x38, esgrid.h bound 0-0x1d) the Repair_DamageLevelColor of HercStatus_Get(herc+8, 0, i) for parts 0-5, and of HercStatus_Get(herc+8, 2, i) into part 6+i for each mount below the HERC's +0x4c capacity; an empty bay gives condition 100 and no mounts. With any tab, then repaints the picture through its vtable (at +1) slot +4. Unlike Repair_ColorDiagram it maps part i to group i directly, with no chassis part table. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Squad_RefreshSelectedReadout
entries.description: Squad_RefreshReadout(SelectedBaySlot).

entries.name: Squad_RefreshReadout
entries.description: Fills the squad panel's Pilot/Skill/Condition values for one bay: the pilot's name or Unassigned, 0x35 + skill, and the overall condition's band word in its colour or N% Complete in 0x20 while the machine is being built.

entries.name: Squad_SelectBay
entries.description: A squad roster click: returns for the bay already selected, then takes the bay each tab's own way, by CurrentTabIndex. The repair tab refuses an empty or unbuilt bay, swaps the pictures, relights the rows, stores SelectedBaySlot and resets the repair selection to (0, 0). The crew tab accepts -1 or a finished machine, refusing the Razor unless CrewSelectedRow is 0, and first assigns the bay while Squad_RosterClickFlag is set.

entries.name: Repair_DamageLevel
entries.description: Damage level 0-5 of a 0-100 condition: the first index of DamageLevelBands the condition is strictly greater than, or 5 if none. Hand-decoded from the instruction stream -- the counter lives in EAX (xor eax,eax / inc eax) and the comparison is kept in CX/DX, which is what makes the return the level and not the threshold. Bands match Repair_LevelForCondition's exactly.

entries.name: Repair_DamageLevelColor
entries.description: Calls Repair_DamageLevel and returns DamageLevelColors[level].

entries.name: Squad_RefreshRowNames
entries.description: Writes each roster row's machine name (the HERC record's +0x04 string) in the band colour of its overall condition.

entries.name: Squad_RefreshRowCrew
entries.description: Writes each roster row's last column in 0x27: the assigned pilot's name, or N% Complete for a machine still being built.

entries.name: Arming_SelectHardpoint
entries.description: The arming screen's counterpart to Repair_SelectHotspot: one hardpoint index, a no-op when it is already selected, and it reads the fitted weapon id from the mount pointer at herc+0x50+index*4.

entries.name: Arming_FitSelected
entries.description: With a hardpoint selected: calls Herc_FitMount (004114ec)(herc, hardpoint, weapon) while Arming_FitArmed is set, then Arming_MarkHardpoint and repaints the bay picture.

entries.name: Arming_SetMountGuidance
entries.description: Writes a guidance kind into the selected hardpoint's mount record at +0x08, when a hardpoint is selected and the mount is fitted.

entries.name: Arming_NextHardpoint
entries.description: The > stepper: Arming_SelectHardpoint((hardpoint + 1) % mount capacity).

entries.name: Arming_PreviousHardpoint
entries.description: The < stepper: Arming_SelectHardpoint(hardpoint - 1), wrapping from 0 or none to the last mount.

entries.name: Arming_BuildScreen
entries.description: warmingi.cpp: builds the weapon-fitting screen, reading gam\arm_weap.dat against dba\arm_weap.dba. Its 26 weapon panels are the authoritative set of buyable weapon ids; the four trailing panels are the guidance kinds SARH 0, ARH 1, ARM 2, EO 3. Also opens wpn_desc.bin, three lines per weapon id.

entries.name: Arming_Enter
entries.description: Tab 2's entry, called by TabHandler_Weapons before it stores 2 in CurrentTabIndex: shows the content panel, the inventory and the picture box; when SelectedBaySlot is -1, empty or unfinished calls Squad_SelectBay(Herc_FirstBuiltBay) (which therefore takes the previous tab's arm); clears ArmingSelectedHardpoint and runs Arming_SelectRow(0).

entries.name: Arming_Leave
entries.description: The teardown dispatcher's tab-2 arm: hides the content panel, the inventory and the picture box.

entries.name: Arming_ShowGuidanceButtons
entries.description: Shows the ARM/ARH/SARH/EO buttons and the rack-name button, once, on Arming_GuidanceButtonsUp.

entries.name: Arming_HideGuidanceButtons
entries.description: Puts the four guidance buttons' borders back to 0x22 and hides all five buttons, when Arming_GuidanceButtonsUp is set.

entries.name: Arming_RowOfWeapon
entries.description: The inventory row (0-26) listing a weapon id in Arming_RowWeapons, or -1.

entries.name: Arming_SelectRow
entries.description: An inventory row's handler (27 thunks from 00440300, each setting Arming_FitArmed). No-op for the lit row unless a guidance picture is up or a hardpoint is selected. With a hardpoint, refuses a weapon with none in stock unless fitted (testing the mount's +0x08 guidance kind first) and fits through Arming_FitSelected. Refreshes the rows, relights old and new rows, swaps the picture, fills three wpn_desc.bin lines from id*3, and puts the guidance buttons up for ids 0xd-0x10 or takes them down.

entries.name: Arming_RefreshRows
entries.description: Rewrites all 27 inventory rows: the owned count (weapons.dat +0x17) as %d, two spaces for None; a locked weapon (+0x16 clear) disabled in 0x10; an unlocked one 0x27 and live while Arming_RowLive holds, else 0x25 and disabled.

entries.name: Arming_ShowGuidance
entries.description: Arming_ShowGuidance(kind, show): relights the guidance buttons (0x22 old, 0x20 new); with show set swaps the lit row's picture for the kind's and prints wpn_desc.bin 99+kind*3; stores the kind and writes it to the selected mount through Arming_SetMountGuidance. Kinds: SARH 0, ARH 1, ARM 2, EO 3.

entries.name: Arming_OnArm
entries.description: (event): the ARM guidance button's handler, which Arming_BuildScreen pushes (0043ead7) to the ESButtonFont_Ctor for string 0xa1 parented to 0048d59c: Arming_ShowGuidance(2, 1), then deletes the event (Rtl_GetPolymorphicDtorCount into [Rtl_DtorCountPtr], virtual dtor +0x18 with 3).

entries.name: Crew_BuildScreen
entries.description: wcrewi.cpp (crew tab) screen builder. Loads dba\star.dba and dba\c_pilots.dba through TSBase_LoadDba (asserts at wcrewi.cpp lines 0x3d and 0x3f) and builds the three squad portraits from c_pilots.dba's frames; the rest is the hardcoded-rect-literal widget construction the other tab builders use.

entries.name: Crew_ColourRows
entries.description: Colours each crew row by whether it is below 00482a78: body +0x59 0x25/0x10, labels 0x19/0x1a, value backing 0x25/0x10. The value colours it writes (0x16/0x17) are overwritten by Crew_FillRows' ESMessage_SetString.

entries.name: Crew_Enter
entries.description: Tab 6's screen entry, run after the handler has stored 6 in CurrentTabIndex: Crew_ColourRows, Crew_MatchRowPilots, the three squad portraits, Crew_SelectRow 0-3 then 0, Crew_FillRows, then Squad_SelectBay for every occupied bay -- which leaves the last bay holding a finished machine selected.

entries.name: Crew_Leave
entries.description: The crew tab's teardown: hides the crew content panel (DAT_0048d72c). Called from Shell_TeardownCurrentTab (00439ea7) at 00439f21.

entries.name: Crew_MatchRowPilots
entries.description: Fills the row pilot pointers at 004776e0 for rows 1-3 with the squad member at that position (Squad_MemberAtPosition), or null.

entries.name: Crew_SelectRow
entries.description: (row): relights the old and new rows' borders and portraits (0x21/0x29), calls Squad_SelectBay with the row pilot's bay (the player's for row 0, -1 for an empty row), then stores the row in CrewSelectedRow -- so the Razor test inside sees the row being left.

entries.name: Crew_FillRows
entries.description: Fills the four crew rows' portraits and Name/Skill/Herc values: the player from 00482a80, PlayerPilotSkill and bay 00482a9e, each squad row from its pilot record, 0x7e None for a pilot with no machine, estext entry 0 for an empty row.

entries.name: Crew_AssignSquadMember
entries.description: (k), the three squad portraits' action. Returns at once on the player's row (CrewSelectedRow 0). Otherwise frees the selected row's position from whoever holds it (Squad_SetMemberPosition -1), gives it to squad member k, clears any row pointer at 004776e0 holding k and points the selected row at k, then Crew_AssignSelectedBay, Squad_RefreshRowCrew, the readout and Crew_FillRows.

entries.name: Crew_ClearRow
entries.description: CLEAR's action. On a squad row holding a member: Squad_SetMemberBay(k, -1), Squad_SetMemberPosition(k, -1), nulls the row pointer, Crew_FillRows, then Squad_SelectBay with the member's now -1 bay while Squad_RosterClickFlag is set. Nothing on the player's row or an empty one.

entries.name: Crew_AssignSelectedBay
entries.description: Gives SelectedBaySlot to the selected row's pilot when the row is the player's or has a pilot: unassigns the player (Player_SetBay -1) and every squad member (Squad_SetMemberBay -1) whose bay equals it, then writes it to the player through Player_SetBay or to the squad member's +0x22 followed by Squad_UpdateOnStrength(row), and Crew_FillRows. With SelectedBaySlot -1 every bayless squad member counts as its holder. Called from Squad_SelectBay's crew arm while Squad_RosterClickFlag is set, and from Crew_AssignSquadMember.

entries.description: (event): Squad portrait 0's click handler; Crew_BuildScreen passes it to ESBitmap_Ctor for the portrait at {0xbc, 0x19, 0xf7, 0x50} in the crew panel and stores the widget in CrewSquadPortraits (CrewSquadPortraits). Writes border +0x4d 0x29 on portrait 0 and 0x21 on portraits 1 (0048d734) and 2 (0048d738), repainting each with Window_RepaintRecursive, then Crew_AssignSquadMember(0), then deletes the event (Rtl_GetPolymorphicDtorCount into [Rtl_DtorCountPtr], virtual dtor +0x18 with 3).

entries.name: Mission_BuildScreen
entries.description: The mission tab's builder (wmissini.cpp): Telecomm, the map panel and its six miss_arw.dba buttons, the map grid, the Mission Summary panel with its five text boxes and two page buttons, the twenty report texts, and the button bar with Mission Briefing / Mission Objectives / Intelligence Report / Rock & Roll >. Every widget it builds is one Mission_Show (004441e3) shows and Mission_Leave (00444a05) hides; it sits inside the address range that reads as wcrewi.cpp's.

entries.name: Mission_LoadPictures
entries.description: wmissini.cpp's first assert string. Loads dba\terradef.dba into the Telecomm picture (DAT_0048d7e4) and, for the map view (arg 0), dba\th_earth.dba below stage 5 or dba\th_moon.dba as the map grid's part 0.

entries.name: Mission_FreePictures
entries.description: ESGrid_InitAllRows(0048d814), then GLBitmapArray_Dtor(_, 3) on the non-null arrays at 00477fc0 and 00477fc4, clearing each. Mission_Leave calls it.

entries.name: maybe_Mission_UpdateLocationTab
entries.description: At stage 5 enqueues movie 0x55 (the lunar drop), installs palette 2 through the scope and fades the music out and stops it; below it, loads frame 0 of MissionLocationDbaTable[stage - 1] into the location picture (DAT_0048d7e0), shows it and installs the theater palette stage + 0xe. Movie_PlayQueue calls it after an entry with the location flag.

entries.name: Mission_HideLocationPicture
entries.description: Hides the mission tab's location picture (DAT_0048d7e0) and frees its bank.

entries.name: Mission_Show
entries.description: Puts the mission tab up in a view: 0 campaign map, 1 briefing, 4 debrief. Retitles the map panel, moves the summary, fills and shows the text boxes, shows or hides the map buttons, bar and page buttons, and enqueues the view's movie once: the map's while its first-show flag DAT_004778aa is clear (RESTORE and a new career clear it), the briefing's and debrief's once per load.

entries.name: Mission_HideReportTexts
entries.description: Hides the mission screen's twenty report texts (DAT_0048d838-DAT_0048d884); Mission_Show calls it in the map and briefing views.

entries.name: Mission_Leave
entries.description: The teardown dispatcher's mission arm (00439ea7 case 7): frees the pictures, hides the report texts, clears the four career text boxes and hides the screen's panels.

entries.name: Career_ObjectivesText_Thunk
entries.description: Calls Career_ObjectivesText and returns its result (the decompile drops it). Mission_Show calls it.

entries.name: Career_IntelligenceText_Thunk
entries.description: Calls Career_IntelligenceText and returns its result. Mission_Show calls it.

entries.name: Career_BriefingText_Thunk
entries.description: Calls Career_BriefingText and returns its result. Mission_Show calls it.

entries.name: Mission_DebriefText
entries.description: Thunk to Career_DebriefText, which Mission_Show(4) fills text box 4 from.

entries.name: Mission_ResetViewButtonBorders
entries.description: Sets the border colour +0x4d of the three mission buttons 0048d804, 0048d808 and 0048d80c to 0x22 and repaints each with Window_RepaintRecursive. Mission_LightViewButton calls it before lighting one.

entries.name: Mission_NoOp
entries.description: An empty function (PUSH EBP; MOV EBP,ESP; POP EBP; RET) between Mission_ResetViewButtonBorders and Mission_LightViewButton in the wmissini.cpp block. No reference found by es2_xref --binary VSHELL.

entries.name: Mission_LightViewButton
entries.description: Puts the first three mission buttons' borders back to 0x22 and writes 0x20 on Mission Briefing for 1 and 4, Mission Objectives for 2, Intelligence Report for 3.

entries.name: Mission_ShowTextBox
entries.description: Marks the text box in DAT_004780a4 not shown and box n shown (+0x18), runs TextBox_ShowPage on both and stores n. Boxes: 0 map, 1 briefing, 2 objectives, 3 intelligence, 4 debrief.

entries.name: Mission_OnTelecommPicture
entries.description: (event): The Telecomm picture's click handler; Mission_BuildScreen passes it to ESBitmap_Ctor (PUSH at 004426b3) for the picture at {10, 0x14, 0xf9, 0x100} and stores the widget in DAT_0048d7e4. After the prologue it jumps (00444e2f) straight to its epilogue at 00444ee2, so a click does nothing, and it does not delete the event Window_DispatchCallback hands it. The 0xae bytes it jumps over (00444e34-00444ee1, outside Ghidra's 17-byte extent) read Avi_Playing without testing the result and, by MissionScreenView, enqueue Career_BriefingMovie_Thunk() for view 1 or Mission_DebriefMovie() for view 4 through Movie_Enqueue(id, {0x15, 0x56, 0xf0, 0xb4}, CampaignStage + 4 or CampaignStage + 9, 0, 0).

entries.name: Mission_OnMapUp
entries.description: Map button 1: ShellMap vtable +0xc then its paint, 1-4 times by the auto-repeat count +0x65.

entries.name: Mission_OnMapDown
entries.description: Map button 2: vtable +0x10.

entries.name: Mission_OnMapLeft
entries.description: Map button 3: vtable +0x14.

entries.name: Mission_OnMapRight
entries.description: Map button 4: vtable +0x18.

entries.name: Mission_OnMapZoomIn
entries.description: Map button 5 (arrows pointing in): vtable +4.

entries.name: Mission_OnMapZoomOut
entries.description: Map button 6 (arrows pointing out): vtable +8.

entries.name: Mission_OnBriefing
entries.description: Mission Briefing's handler: Mission_LightViewButton and Mission_ShowTextBox with the view (MissionScreenView).

entries.name: Mission_OnObjectives
entries.description: Mission Objectives' handler: Mission_LightViewButton(2), Mission_ShowTextBox(2).

entries.name: Mission_OnIntelligence
entries.description: Intelligence Report's handler: Mission_LightViewButton(3), Mission_ShowTextBox(3).

entries.description: Rock & Roll >'s handler: refuses through the dialog LaunchRefusal_Show with codes 2, 0, 1, 3, otherwise Game_ExportMissionHandoff, Shell_SetExitCode(2) and Shell_QuitFlag = 1.

entries.description: Thunk to Career_DebriefMovie, which Mission_Show(4) enqueues once per load.

entries.name: Build_BuildScreen
entries.description: The BUILD tab's builder: the Herc Construction titled panel (estext 0xba), nine blueprint Grids, the nine-row chassis list (0x6e + i), the stats box and its four figures, and the lower panel with Salvage Available and the Scrap Herc / Build Herc boxes. Every widget it builds is the one Build_Enter (0044690d) shows and Build_Leave (0044694e) hides. Sits after wmissini.cpp's assert anchor in the image, which is why it was once taken for the mission builder.

entries.name: Build_GateRows
entries.description: Per chassis row: disabled with all four columns 0x10 when (&DAT_00483b62)[type*8] is clear, else all four columns 0x27 and enabled. Rewrites the selected row's name colour too.

entries.name: Build_Enter
entries.description: Tab 4's entry: Build_GateRows, Herc_BuildScreenRefresh, Build_GateButtons, Build_FillBlueprints, shows the content panel, the lower panel and blueprint 0, then Build_SelectChassis(0).

entries.name: Build_Leave
entries.description: The teardown dispatcher's tab-4 arm: frees the blueprint banks, hides the content panel, the lower panel and the selected chassis's blueprint.

entries.name: Build_GateButtons
entries.description: Gates SCRAP and BUILD on the selected bay: empty -> SCRAP dead, BUILD live when CareerSalvage - Armory_QueuedTotal() > price*1000; occupied -> BUILD dead, SCRAP dead when Herc_HasSingleDeployable or the bay's chassis is unavailable.

entries.name: Build_SelectChassis
entries.description: Moves DAT_004786e4 (-1 in the image): old row's name 0x27 and border 0x10 and its blueprint hidden, new row's name and border 0x29 and its blueprint shown, then Build_GateButtons and Herc_BuildScreenRefresh. Returns at once for the chassis already selected.

entries.name: Herc_BuildScreenRefresh
entries.description: Refreshes the Herc Construction stat panel from herc_inf.dat: mass as "%d TONS", speed as "%d KPH", hardpoints bare, price as "%d TONS". This is what names those four fields.

entries.name: Build_RefreshSalvage
entries.description: Writes the lower panel's Salvage Available figure: (CareerSalvage - Armory_QueuedTotal()) / 1000 as %ld %s with estext 0xc6 TONS.

entries.name: Build_OnScrap
entries.description: The build screen's SCRAP handler: ScrapDialog_Show.

entries.name: Build_OnBuild
entries.description: The build screen's BUILD handler: Hangar_BuySelected(DAT_004786e4), then the roster names and crew, the readout, Build_RefreshSalvage and Build_GateButtons.

entries.description: (event): Build-screen chassis row 0's click handler; Build_BuildScreen writes it into the row widget's handler field +0x3d (BuildChassisRows[0], BuildChassisRows (0048d8b4) + 0*4) at 00445af7: Build_SelectChassis(0), then deletes the event (Rtl_GetPolymorphicDtorCount into [Rtl_DtorCountPtr], virtual dtor +0x18 with 3).

entries.name: ScrapDialog_Build
entries.description: Builds the herc scrap dialog once at startup: a full-display Window, an ESAlert panel at {0xcb,199,0x1af,0x149} titled estext 0xc9 WARNING, two FramedPanels, caption 0xcc and a figure Text, CANCEL (0xca, 00447c38) and ACCEPT (0xcb, 00447c96).

entries.name: ScrapDialog_Show
entries.description: Writes "%d %s" of Herc_ScrapValueTons(selected bay's machine) and estext 0xcd into the dialog's figure and shows it (Alert_Show). Called by Build_OnScrap and Repair_OnScrap.

entries.name: ScrapDialog_Hide
entries.description: Hides the herc scrap dialog (Alert_Hide).

entries.name: WeaponScrapDialog_Build
entries.description: The armory Scrap dialog's builder: the herc scrap dialog's rects and colours, caption estext 0xce, CANCEL 00447d59, ACCEPT 00447db7.

entries.name: WeaponScrapDialog_Show
entries.description: Stores the weapon id in DAT_0048d970, writes "%d %s" of Armory_ScrapValueTons(id) and estext 0xcd into the figure and shows the dialog.

entries.name: WeaponScrapDialog_Hide
entries.description: Hides the armory's scrap dialog (Alert_Hide).

entries.name: ScrapDialog_OnCancel
entries.description: CANCEL's handler: ScrapDialog_Hide only. The builder passes it as a bare address, so auto-analysis made no function of it; ES2DefineFunctionAt 00447c38 creates it.

entries.name: ScrapDialog_OnAccept
entries.description: ACCEPT's handler: ScrapDialog_Hide, Hangar_ScrapSelected, Squad_RefreshAfterScrap; tab 4 Build_GateButtons; tab 3 Squad_SelectBay(Herc_FirstBuiltBay) and Repair_RefreshDetail; then repaints 0048d13c, 0048d1cc and 0048d4f4.

entries.name: WeaponScrapDialog_OnCancel
entries.description: The weapon scrap dialog's CANCEL: WeaponScrapDialog_Hide only.

entries.name: WeaponScrapDialog_OnAccept
entries.description: The weapon scrap dialog's ACCEPT: WeaponScrapDialog_Hide, Armory_ScrapWeapons(DAT_0048d970), Armory_RefreshQueue, Armory_RefreshRows, Armory_RefreshReadout.

entries.name: Armory_BuildScreen
entries.description: warmoryi.cpp (armory tab) screen builder, the largest function in its TU (5365 bytes). Loads dba\arm_weap.dba (TSBase_LoadDba) and reads gam\arm_weap.dat through a VolRStream; the widgets are built from hardcoded rect literals, as in ServiceBay/Squad/Warning/Crew/Mission_BuildScreen.

entries.name: Armory_RefreshRows
entries.description: For each of the 26 armory rows: a weapon whose unlock flag (weapons.dat +0x16) is clear has the row disabled and all four columns recoloured 0x10; otherwise the row is enabled, column 0 set to "[ %1d ]" of the queued count or "[   ]", column 2 to "%d" of the owned count, and all four recoloured 0x27.

entries.name: Armory_Enter
entries.description: Tab 5's entry. Writes the greying trio at Clear from ShellOption_WeaponsBuildMode (live only when weapons are built by hand), runs Armory_RefreshRows and Armory_RefreshReadout, shows the content panel and the list, and calls Armory_ClickRow(0). Armory_Leave has put the lit row back to -1, so that call always selects.

entries.name: Armory_Leave
entries.description: The teardown dispatcher's armory arm: hides the lit row's picture, the content panel and the list, and sets the lit row Armory_LitRow back to -1.

entries.name: Armory_DequeueLit
entries.description: Clear's action: with a row lit, Armory_Dequeue of its weapon, column 0 back to "[   ]" in 0x29, and Armory_RefreshReadout.

entries.name: Armory_ClickRow
entries.description: A row's left release. On a row other than the lit one, or with weapons built automatically: recolours the old row 0x27 and hides its picture, lights the new one 0x29, shows its picture and fills the five wpn_info.bin lines from Arming_RowOfWeapon(id) * 5, and stores the row. On the lit row with weapons built by hand: with a queue slot free and the queued total + price < the career salvage, Armory_Enqueue and the row's queued count and the readout refreshed.

entries.name: Armory_RightClickRow
entries.description: A row's right release. Selects exactly as Armory_ClickRow; on the lit row with weapons built by hand, removes one queued unit by dequeuing every one (Armory_DequeueLit) and enqueuing count - 1 again through Armory_ClickRow.

entries.name: Armory_RefreshReadout
entries.description: Writes the armory's four figures, all centred in 0x29: "%ld kg" of CareerSalvage - Armory_QueuedTotal, "%d kg" of Armory_QueuedTotal, the free queue slots and 5 minus them; then the lit row's owned count in 0x29.

entries.name: Armory_DiscardEvent1
entries.description: (event): Deletes the event (Rtl_GetPolymorphicDtorCount into [Rtl_DtorCountPtr], virtual dtor +0x18 with 3) and does nothing else: a click handler's shape, between Armory_RefreshReadout and Armory_OnScrap in the warmoryi.cpp block. No reference found by es2_xref --binary VSHELL.

entries.name: Armory_OnScrap
entries.description: Scrap's click handler: WeaponScrapDialog_Show with the lit row's weapon id, when a row is lit.

entries.name: Armory_OnClear
entries.description: Clear's click handler: Armory_DequeueLit.

entries.name: Armory_DiscardEvent2
entries.description: (event): Deletes the event (Rtl_GetPolymorphicDtorCount into [Rtl_DtorCountPtr], virtual dtor +0x18 with 3) and does nothing else: a click handler's shape, between Armory_OnClear and Armory_OnSalvageBox in the warmoryi.cpp block. No reference found by es2_xref --binary VSHELL.

entries.name: Armory_OnSalvageBox
entries.description: (event): The armory readout's salvage box's click handler; Armory_BuildScreen passes it to ESButtonFont_Ctor (PUSH at 00448457) for the box at {0x31, 0x3d, 0x93, 0x4e} in the readout panel DAT_0048d9ec, stores the box in DAT_0048d9fc and clears its +0x49. Deletes the event (Rtl_GetPolymorphicDtorCount into [Rtl_DtorCountPtr], virtual dtor +0x18 with 3) and does nothing else.

entries.name: Armory_OnAllocatedBox
entries.description: (event): the click handler Armory_BuildScreen passes to ESButtonFont_Ctor (pointer at 004484f7) for the armory readout panel's Allocated box (Armory_AllocatedBox 0048da00, rect {0xaf, 0x3d, 0x111, 0x4e}, blank caption 00479131, border 0x13): deletes the event (Rtl_GetPolymorphicDtorCount into [Rtl_DtorCountPtr], virtual destructor +0x18 with 3) and returns. The builder clears the box's enable flag +0x49 straight after constructing it, so the base class's event handler drops mouse events before they reach this handler. Armory_RefreshReadout writes the box's caption. The twin of Armory_OnSalvageBox (00449fab).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0044a004; Armory_BuildScreen decompile (store at 004484f6)

entries.name: Armory_DiscardEventSpareB
entries.description: (event): deletes the event (Rtl_GetPolymorphicDtorCount into [Rtl_DtorCountPtr], virtual destructor +0x18 with 3), the same body as Armory_OnAllocatedBox. No reference found by es2_xref. It sits between Armory_OnAllocatedBox and Armory_OnRow00; Armory_DiscardEvent2 (00449f52), before Armory_OnSalvageBox, has the same body and is also unreferenced by es2_xref.

entries.name: PracticeScreen_Build
entries.description: Builds the PRACTICE MISSIONS screen once at startup: backdrop root, TitledPanel {0x4d,0xa2,0x232,0x170} (estext 0xf0), mission list {6,0x1a,0xcf,0xad} with eight ESQuad rows (0xf2-0xf9), parameter box {0xd4,0x1a,0x1df,0xad} with five label buttons (0xfb-0xff), colons and readouts, and Main Menu / Begin Mission.

entries.name: PracticeScreen_Show
entries.description: Shows the practice screen's root and panel and calls PracticeScreen_SelectRow(0). PRACTICE MISSIONS' handler calls it.

entries.name: PracticeScreen_Hide
entries.description: Hides the practice screen's root and panel.

entries.name: PracticeScreen_SelectRow
entries.description: Practice row handler, called by PracticeScreen_OnRow0..PracticeScreen_OnRow7, with row 0 by PracticeScreen_Show, and with rows 8-10 by InstantAction_SelectDemo. No-op for the lit row (PracticeScreen_SelectedRow). Relights the rows through PracticeScreen_Rows, greys Herc Type for rows 0-3, writes the row's chassis from PracticeScreen_RowChassis into prefs option 0x28, refreshes the Herc Type readout, stores the row.

entries.name: InstantAction_SelectDemo
entries.description: INSTANT ACTION's pick: PracticeScreen_SelectRow(8 + option 0x2e), i.e. stage 0's DEMO/DEMO_01/DEMO_02 with the table's chassis, then steps option 0x2e mod 3, commits and saves the options.

entries.name: PracticeScreen_OnDamage
entries.description: (event): the practice screen's Damage label handler, which PracticeScreen_Build passes to ESButtonFont_Ctor (pointer at 0044af5d): ShellOptions_StepOption(0x26, 2, 0) when the event's button byte +0x24 is 1 (left), otherwise ShellOptions_StepOptionBack(0x26, 2, 0); then ESMessage_SetString on PracticeScreen_DamageReadout's caption (+0x55) with estext.bin entry 0x128 + option 0x26 (byte 004824de), passing the caption's own +0x45 and +0xb5 back; then deletes the event.

entries.name: PracticeScreen_OnAmmo
entries.description: (event): the practice screen's Ammo label handler (pointer at 0044afe9 in PracticeScreen_Build): ShellOptions_StepOption(0x25, 2, 0) on a left release (event byte +0x24 == 1), otherwise ShellOptions_StepOptionBack(0x25, 2, 0); then ESMessage_SetString on PracticeScreen_AmmoReadout's caption (+0x55) with estext.bin entry 0x12a + option 0x25 (byte 004824dd), keeping the caption's +0x45 and +0xb5; then deletes the event.

entries.name: PracticeScreen_OnDifficulty
entries.description: (event): the practice screen's Mission Difficulty label handler (pointer at 0044b074 in PracticeScreen_Build): ShellOptions_StepOption(0x27, 4, 0) on a left release (event byte +0x24 == 1), otherwise ShellOptions_StepOptionBack(0x27, 4, 0); then ESMessage_SetString on PracticeScreen_DifficultyReadout's caption (+0x55) with estext.bin entry 0x35 + option 0x27 (byte 004824df), keeping the caption's +0x45 and +0xb5; then deletes the event.

entries.name: PracticeScreen_OnTimeOfDay
entries.description: (event): the practice screen's Time of Day label handler (pointer at 0044b100 in PracticeScreen_Build): ShellOptions_StepOption(0x29, 2, 0) on a left release (event byte +0x24 == 1), otherwise ShellOptions_StepOptionBack(0x29, 2, 0); then ESMessage_SetString on PracticeScreen_TimeOfDayReadout's caption (+0x55) with estext.bin entry 0x12c + option 0x29 (byte 004824e1), keeping the caption's +0x45 and +0xb5; then deletes the event.

entries.name: PracticeScreen_OnHercType
entries.description: (event): the practice screen's Herc Type label handler (pointer at 0044b18b in PracticeScreen_Build): ShellOptions_StepOption(0x28, 9, 0) on a left release (event byte +0x24 == 1), otherwise ShellOptions_StepOptionBack(0x28, 9, 0); then ESMessage_SetString on PracticeScreen_HercTypeReadout's caption (+0x55) with estext.bin entry 0x6e + option 0x28 (byte 004824e0), keeping the caption's +0x45 and +0xb5; then deletes the event.

entries.name: PracticeScreen_OnMainMenu
entries.description: Main Menu button: PracticeScreen_Hide, MainMenu_Show.

entries.name: ReplayDialog_Build
entries.description: Builds REPLAY MISSION?: a full-display ImagePanel of the shell backdrop (DAT_0048dbbc, no border), a TitledPanel {0xce,199,0x1b2,0x145} titled 0x134 (DAT_0048dbc0; face 0x25, dithered body in 0x10, plate 0x37-0xad), two centred lines (DAT_0048dbc4/dbc8) and Yes (0x139, ReplayDialog_OnYes) and No (0x13a, ReplayDialog_OnNo).

entries.name: ReplayDialog_Show
entries.description: (state) Writes the two lines -- 0 0x137/0x138 'The war is lost. Do you / want to replay the mission?', 3 0x135/0x136 'You were killed. ...' -- and shows the backdrop and the panel. Game_ProcessMissionResults calls it for game states 0 and 3.

entries.name: ReplayDialog_Hide
entries.description: Hides REPLAY MISSION?'s backdrop and panel.

entries.name: ReplayDialog_OnYes
entries.description: Yes: ReplayDialog_Hide, Game_LoadSlot(10), Shell_SetExitCode(2) and the quit flag, so the launcher flies data\ as the load left it. Its entry sits in bytes Ghidra left undefined; ESButtonFont_Ctor is passed it as a label.

entries.name: ReplayDialog_OnNo
entries.description: No: Game_SaveSlot(10), ReplayDialog_Hide, MainMenu_Show.

entries.name: EndOfGame_Build
entries.description: Builds CONTINUE GAME's END OF GAME ESAlert {0xcf,0xcb,0x1b4,0x12a} (DAT_0048dbd8), its two text lines and OKAY.

entries.name: EndOfGame_Show
entries.description: (state): first line from the game state (0 0x130, 1 0x131, 3 0x12f; any other left as it was), then Alert_Show.

entries.name: EndOfGame_Hide
entries.description: Alert_Hide on the END OF GAME alert.

entries.name: EndOfGame_OnOkay
entries.description: OKAY's handler: EndOfGame_Hide.

entries.name: LaunchRefusal_Build
entries.description: Builds Rock & Roll's WARNING! ESAlert {0xb1,0x67,0x1d2,0xc6}, its two text lines and OKAY.

entries.name: LaunchRefusal_Show
entries.description: Writes estext 0x13c+2*code and the next into the two lines and shows the alert.

entries.name: LaunchRefusal_HideAlert
entries.description: Alert_Hide(0048dbec). LaunchRefusal_OnOkay calls it.

entries.name: LaunchRefusal_OnOkay
entries.description: OKAY's handler: hides the alert.

entries.name: Career_LoadCurrentMission
entries.description: Loads the career's current mission (MsnGen_LoadMission); in campaign mode rebuilds the map and the briefing text and reshows the mission tab in the view it holds, in training exports the handoff and launches at once.

entries.name: MissionNameDialog_OnUseDefault
entries.description: Use Default: hides the dialog and calls Career_LoadCurrentMission.

entries.name: MissionNameDialog_OnLoad
entries.description: (event): the mission-name dialog's estext 0x34 button handler, which MissionNameDialog_Build passes to ESButtonFont_Ctor: MissionNameDialog_Hide, sprintf('msn\\%s.msn') of MissionNameDialog_NameField +0x45 with its first '^' replaced by '_' (_strchr), MsnGen_LoadMission; then in campaign mode ShellMap_Build, Career_BuildBriefingText, Stats_StageCurrentGame(10), Shell_SelectTabPalette(8), ServiceBay_RefreshTabStrip and Mission_ShowView(MissionScreenView, 1), otherwise Game_ExportMissionHandoff, Shell_SetExitCode(2) and Shell_QuitFlag = 1; then deletes the event.

entries.name: MissionNameDialog_Build
entries.description: Builds the developer's mission-name dialog; Shell_BuildScreensAndStart calls it (es2_xref: CALL at 004012ca). A backdrop image panel over Shell_TopWindow's rect (ESBitmap_Ctor with ShellBackdropBitmap, +0x51 = 0) into MissionNameDialog_Root; an ESTitle {0xce, 199, 0x1b2, 0x145} captioned 'DEBUG' with +0x55 = 0x25, +0x5d = 0x10, +0x59 = 0, +0x6d = 0x3f, +0x71 = 0xa6 into MissionNameDialog_Panel; in the panel the text 'Enter Mission File Name' {0x26, 0x1d, 0xb9, 0x26}; a button {10, 0x2b, 0xda, 0x3d} captioned ' ' with border 0x22 and enable flag +0x49 cleared (MissionNameDialog_NameBox) holding an ESDialog edit field one pixel inside it (MissionNameDialog_NameField) whose accepted-character string +0x9f is '^', the digits, the letters of both cases and space; the text 'Default:' {10, 0x46, 0x42, 0x58}; an empty text {0x46, 0x46, 0xda, 0x58} (MissionNameDialog_DefaultName); 'Use Default' {0x76, 0x66, 0xd8, 0x75} with MissionNameDialog_OnUseDefault (MissionNameDialog_UseDefaultButton); and the estext.bin entry 0x34 button {10, 0x66, 0x6c, 0x75} with MissionNameDialog_OnLoad as its handler (DAT_0048dc20).

entries.name: MissionNameDialog_Show
entries.description: Writes the career position's mission name as the default and shows the dialog.

entries.name: MissionNameDialog_Hide
entries.description: Hides the mission-name dialog.

entries.name: MemRWStream_SetPosition
entries.description: MemRWStream slot +8 (stream, pos): clears an end-of-data status (2); with status 0 and pos within 0..end - start, moves the cursor to start + pos and returns 1; otherwise hands off to 0044edac(stream, 0). Returns 0 when the status was an error.

entries.name: MemRWStream_Flush
entries.description: MemRWStream slot +0x10: returns 1.

entries.name: MemRWStream_Write
entries.description: MemRWStream slot +0x14 (stream, count, src): with status 0, copies count bytes to the cursor and advances it; when fewer than count remain before the end +0xc, copies what fits and hands off to 0044edac(stream, 1). Returns 0 when the status is non-zero.

entries.name: MemRWStream_Read
entries.description: MemRWStream slot +0x18 (stream, count, dst): MemRWStream_Write's mirror, copying from the cursor, with 0044edac(stream, 0) when the data runs out.

entries.name: RLERStream_Ctor
entries.description: RLERStream constructor (vtable 0047a70c, RTTI name 'RLERStream', 0x92 bytes): Stream_BaseCtor, RLERStream_Init, status 6 (not attached). VolRStream_Open builds one for compression type 7.

entries.name: RLERStream_CtorOnSource
entries.description: RLERStream constructor attached to a source stream: StreamIO base, vtable 0047a70c, RLERStream_Init, RLERStream_Open(source).

entries.name: RLERStream_Init
entries.description: Clears an RLERStream's source pointer at +8, its state bytes +0xc..+0xe and the dword at +0x8e.

entries.name: RLERStream_Open
entries.description: (rle, source): RLERStream_Close, attach the source stream at +8 at its current position, reset the decoder state, and copy the source's status (Stream_GetStatus) as its own.

entries.name: RLERStream_Close
entries.description: When a source is attached: calls the stream's own vtable slot +0x10, clears the source at +8 and sets status 6. VolRStream_Close, VolRStream_SetPosition and VolRStream_Dtor release the +0x27 filter with it.

entries.name: RLERStream_GetCapabilities
entries.description: RLERStream slot +0xc (stream, query): query 0 answers 7, the compression type VolRStream_Open builds an RLERStream for; 1 answers 0; 2 to 4 answer 1; anything else 0.

entries.name: RLERStream_GetPosition
entries.description: RLERStream vtable 0047a70c slot +4: the decoded byte count +0x8e while a source is attached (status not 6), else 0.

entries.name: RLERStream_SetPosition
entries.description: RLERStream slot +8 (stream, pos), with status 0: a position behind the decoded count +0x8e seeks the source back to 0 (its vtable +8) and restarts the count, copying the source's status and returning 0 when that fails; then decodes and discards up to pos in 500-byte reads (0044f22c) into a stack buffer.

entries.name: RLERStream_Flush
entries.description: RLERStream slot +0x10: returns whether a source is attached (status other than 6). RLERStream_Close calls it before detaching.

entries.name: RLERStream_Write
entries.description: RLERStream slot +0x14: sets status 4 (write to a read-only stream) and returns 0.

entries.name: RLERStream_Read
entries.description: RLERStream slot +0x18 (stream, count, dst), with status 0: run-length decodes count bytes from the source +8. A control byte with bit 7 set is a run of (control & 0x7f) copies of the byte after it (state: the byte +0xc, the remaining run +0xd); one with bit 7 clear is that many literal bytes copied from the source (remaining +0xe). Each byte out advances the decoded count +0x8e. A failed source read copies the source's status and returns 0.

entries.name: Stream_ReadCopy
entries.description: (stream, count, buffer): calls the stream's read slot (vtable +0x18); a copy of Stream_Read in the RLERStream unit. RLERStream_SetPosition reads through it.

entries.name: LZHRStream_Ctor
entries.description: LZHRStream constructor (vtable 0047a764, RTTI name 'LZHRStream', 0x28 bytes): Stream_BaseCtor, LZHRStream_Init, status 6 (not attached). VolRStream_Open builds one for compression type 9. The decoder is LZHUF-shaped: a 4036-byte (4096 - 60) window initialised to spaces and an adaptive Huffman coder, LZHuffman.

entries.name: LZHRStream_CtorOnSource
entries.description: LZHRStream constructor attached to a source stream: StreamIO base, vtable 0047a764, LZHRStream_Init, LZHRStream_Open(source).

entries.name: LZHRStream_Init
entries.description: Allocates an LZHRStream's LZHuffman coder (0x16 bytes, LZHuffman_Ctor) at +0xc and a 0x103b-byte window buffer (Mem_NewArray) at +0x10; source pointer +8 cleared.

entries.name: LZHRStream_Dtor
entries.description: LZHRStream destructor: LZHRStream_Close, destroys the LZHuffman at +0xc (LZHuffman_Dtor, flag 3), frees the window at +0x10 (Mem_DeleteArray), Stream_BaseDtor, frees itself when flag & 1.

entries.name: LZHRStream_Open
entries.description: (lzh, source): LZHRStream_Close, attach the source at +8, start the Huffman coder on it (LZHuffman_Start), fill the first 0xfc4 bytes of the window with spaces, set the window position to 0xfc4 and clear the run state (+0x18, +0x1c, +0x24), and copy the source's status (Stream_GetStatus).

entries.name: LZHRStream_Close
entries.description: When a source is attached: calls the stream's own vtable slot +0x10, clears the source at +8 and sets status 6. VolRStream_Close, VolRStream_SetPosition and VolRStream_Dtor release the +0x2b filter with it.

entries.name: LZHRStream_GetCapabilities
entries.description: LZHRStream slot +0xc (stream, query): query 0 answers 9, the compression type VolRStream_Open builds an LZHRStream for; 1 answers 0; 2 to 4 answer 1; anything else 0.

entries.name: LZHRStream_SetPosition
entries.description: LZHRStream slot +8 (stream, pos), while attached: RLERStream_SetPosition's shape: a position behind the decoded count +0x24 seeks the source back to 0 and restarts the count, then it decodes and discards up to pos in 500-byte reads (0044f641).

entries.name: LZHRStream_Read
entries.description: LZHRStream slot +0x18 (stream, count, dst), with status 0: LZSS-decodes count bytes through the 4K window +0x10 (write position +0x20, masked to 0xfff). The LZHuffman coder at +0xc yields a symbol (0044f824): below 0x100 a literal, output and stored in the window; otherwise a match of symbol - 0xfd bytes (+0x18) starting at the window position less the decoded distance (0044f874) less 1 (+0x14), copied out byte by byte through the window (progress +0x1c). Each byte advances the decoded count +0x24.

entries.name: LZHRStream_Flush
entries.description: LZHRStream slot +0x10: returns whether a source is attached (status other than 6). LZHRStream_Close calls it before detaching.

entries.name: LZHRStream_GetPosition
entries.description: LZHRStream vtable 0047a764 slot +4: the decoded byte count +0x24 while a source is attached (status not 6), else 0.

entries.name: LZHRStream_Write
entries.description: LZHRStream slot +0x14: sets status 4 and returns 0.

entries.name: Stream_ReadCopy2
entries.description: (stream, count, buffer): calls the stream's read slot (vtable +0x18); a copy of Stream_Read in the LZHRStream unit. LZHRStream_SetPosition reads through it.

entries.name: LZHuffman_Ctor
entries.description: LZHuffman constructor (Borland type string 'LZHuffman' in the image): allocates the adaptive Huffman tables with Mem_NewArray: +4 frequencies (0x4e8 bytes = 628 words), +8 parent links (0x75a = 941 words), +0xc child links (0x4e6 = 627 words), the LZHUF sizes for 314 symbols and a 627-node tree.

entries.name: LZHuffman_Dtor
entries.description: LZHuffman destructor: frees the three tables at +4, +8, +0xc with Mem_DeleteArray, then the object with Mem_Delete when flag & 1.

entries.name: LZHuffman_Start
entries.description: (coder, source): stores the source stream at +0, clears the bit-buffer state (+0x10..+0x15) and builds the initial adaptive Huffman tree: 314 leaves (0x13a) of frequency 1 and 627 nodes (0x273), root frequency sentinel 0xffff. LZHUF's StartHuff.

entries.name: LZHuffman_EncodeChar
entries.description: (coder, c): walks the parent links (+8) from leaf c up to the root (0x272) collecting the code bits, writes them with LZHuffman_PutCode, then LZHuffman_Update(c). Okumura's LZHUF EncodeChar. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 0047bc80.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0044f78c; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0047bc80

entries.name: LZHuffman_EncodePosition
entries.description: (coder, pos): LZHuffman_PutCode with the top six bits' length and code from the encode tables, then the low six bits in 6 bits. LZHUF's EncodePosition. The tables are 0047a780/0047a7c0 (encode) and 0047a800/0047a900 (decode). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 0047bcd4.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0044f7e0; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0047bcd4

entries.name: LZHuffman_DecodeChar
entries.description: (coder): walks the child links (+0xc) from the root (+0x4e4) one LZHuffman_GetBit at a time until a leaf (>= 0x273), LZHuffman_Update's it and returns leaf - 0x273. LZHUF's DecodeChar; LZHRStream_Read calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 0047bd18.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0044f824; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0047bd18

entries.name: LZHuffman_DecodePosition
entries.description: (coder): reads a byte with LZHuffman_GetByte, takes the upper six bits and the extra bit count from the decode tables, reads those bits with LZHuffman_GetBit and returns the 12-bit position. LZHUF's DecodePosition; LZHRStream_Read calls it. The tables are 0047a780/0047a7c0 (encode) and 0047a800/0047a900 (decode). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 0047bd68.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0044f874; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0047bd68

entries.name: LZHuffman_EncodeEnd
entries.description: (coder): writes the top byte of the bit buffer (+0x13) when bits are pending (+0x15), then a zero byte. LZHUF's EncodeEnd with a trailing 0. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 0047bdbc.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0044f8c8; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0047bdbc

entries.name: LZHuffman_GetBit
entries.description: (coder): refills the 16-bit input buffer (+0x10, bit count +0x12) a byte at a time with Stream_ReadByte from the source (+0) while it holds fewer than 9 bits (0 at end of data), then shifts out and returns the top bit. LZHUF's GetBit. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 0047bdec.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0044f8f8; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0047bdec

entries.name: LZHuffman_GetByte
entries.description: (coder): LZHuffman_GetBit's refill, then shifts out and returns the top 8 bits. LZHUF's GetByte. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 0047be4c.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0044f954; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0047be4c

entries.name: LZHuffman_PutCode
entries.description: (coder, len, code): ORs the code's top len bits into the output buffer (+0x13, count +0x15) and writes each completed byte to the stream. LZHUF's Putcode. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 0047beac.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0044f9b0; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0047beac

entries.name: LZHuffman_Reconstruct
entries.description: (coder): rebuilds the adaptive Huffman tree: halves the leaf frequencies (+4), rebuilds the internal nodes in frequency order and relinks the parents (+8). LZHUF's reconst; LZHuffman_Update calls it when the root frequency reaches 0x8000. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 0047bf20.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0044fa24; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0047bf20

entries.name: LZHuffman_Update
entries.description: (coder, c): LZHuffman_Reconstruct when the root frequency is 0x8000, then increments the frequencies from leaf c to the root, swapping a node past its lower-frequency successors to keep the order. LZHUF's update. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 0047c054.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0044fb58; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0047c054

entries.name: BuffWStream_Ctor
entries.description: BuffWStream constructor (vtable 0047aa0c, RTTI 'BuffWStream', 0x1e bytes): (this, size, buffer) Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable, 0044fcb8(this, size, buffer) to set up the buffer, and status 6 (no target attached).

entries.name: BuffWStream_CtorOnTarget
entries.description: BuffWStream constructor attached to a target stream: (this, target, size, buffer) Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable, 0044fcb8(this, size, buffer), then 0044fd54(this, target). ClassItem_StoreItem wraps a stream in one on its stack.

entries.name: BuffWStream_InitBuffer
entries.description: (stream, size, buffer): clears the target +8; size 0 means a growable 100-byte buffer (+0xc = 1), else size at +0xe with +0xc = 0; +0xd records whether the stream owns the buffer (buffer null), which it then Mem_HeapAlloc's; the buffer goes to +0x12. BuffWStream_Ctor and BuffWStream_CtorOnTarget call it.

entries.name: BuffWStream_Dtor
entries.description: BuffWStream vtable 0047aa0c slot 0 (stream, flags): decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, restores the vtable, BuffWStream_Close, frees the buffer +0x12 when the stream owns it (+0xd), Stream_BaseDtor(stream, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: BuffWStream_SetTarget
entries.description: (stream, target): BuffWStream_Close, stores target at +8, zeroes +0x16 and the buffered count +0x1a, then BuffWStream_SyncStatus. BuffWStream_CtorOnTarget calls it.

entries.name: BuffWStream_Close
entries.description: (stream): when a target is attached (+8), flushes through the stream's own vtable +0x10 (BuffWStream_Flush), clears the target and sets status 6. RLERStream_Close's counterpart for the write side.

entries.name: BuffWStream_GetCapabilities
entries.description: BuffWStream slot +0xc (stream, query): query 0 answers 0xe (the stream type), 1 and 3 answer 1, 2 and 4 answer 0.

entries.name: BuffWStream_GetPosition
entries.description: BuffWStream slot +4: the target's position (its vtable +4) plus the bytes buffered +0x1a; 0 when unattached (status 6).

entries.name: BuffWStream_SetPosition
entries.description: BuffWStream slot +8 (stream, pos), with status 0: moves the buffer cursor +0x1a to pos less the target's position when that lies between 0 and the buffer's high-water mark +0x16; otherwise returns 0.

entries.name: BuffWStream_Flush
entries.description: BuffWStream slot +0x10 (stream), with status 0: writes the buffered bytes (+0x1a of them, from the buffer +0x12) to the target +8 through 0044ffe8 and empties the buffer, returning 1; a failed write goes to 0044ff6c.

entries.name: BuffWStream_Write
entries.description: BuffWStream slot +0x14 (stream, count, src), with status 0: when count does not fit the space left in the buffer (+0xe less +0x1a), a stream whose grow flag +0xc is clear flushes (vtable +0x10) and writes src straight to the target (its vtable +0x14, a failure going to 0044ff6c), and one whose flag is set grows the buffer by the shortfall (0044ff1c) and carries on; otherwise copies src into the buffer at +0x1a, advances it and raises the high-water mark +0x16.

entries.name: BuffWStream_Read
entries.description: BuffWStream slot +0x18: sets status 4 and returns 0; the stream is write-only.

entries.name: BuffWStream_GrowBuffer
entries.description: (stream, extra): adds extra to the buffer size +0xe, rounds it up to a multiple of 100 and reallocs the buffer +0x12. BuffWStream_Write calls it for a growable buffer. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 0047c414.

entries.name: BuffWStream_SyncStatus
entries.description: (stream): status 6 (no target) when +8 is null, else the target's Stream_GetStatus. Returns 0. BuffRStream_SyncStatus's write-side twin. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 0047c464.

entries.name: Stream_WriteCopy
entries.description: (stream, count, buffer): calls the stream's write slot (vtable +0x14); a copy of Stream_Write in the BuffWStream unit. BuffWStream_Flush writes through it.

entries.name: BuffRStream_CtorNoSource
entries.description: BuffRStream constructor without a source: (this, size, buffer) Stream_BaseCtor, BuffRStreamVtable, BuffRStream_InitBuffer(this, size, buffer), then status 6 (no source attached). es2_xref finds no reference to it. Identical to DBSIM's BuffRStream_CtorNoSource (0047c4fc) after normalisation.

entries.name: BuffRStream_Ctor
entries.description: BuffRStream constructor (vtable 0047aa34, RTTI name 'BuffRStream', 0x21 bytes): (this, source, size, buffer) Stream_BaseCtor, installs the vtable, BuffRStream_InitBuffer(this, size, buffer) and BuffRStream_SetSource(this, source). Volume_LoadVolume builds one with no buffer of its own.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0045003c; RTTI at vtable-0xc

entries.name: BuffRStream_Dtor
entries.description: BuffRStream vtable 0047aa34 slot 0 (stream, flags): decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, restores the vtable, BuffRStream_ReleaseSource, frees the buffer +0x14 when the stream owns it (+0x18), Stream_BaseDtor(stream, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: BuffRStream_InitBuffer
entries.description: (stream, size, buffer): clears +8, +0x10, +0x19 and +0x1d, stores size at +0xc and whether buffer is null at +0x18 (the stream owns it), and the buffer at +0x14 -- Mem_HeapAlloc(size) when none was passed.

entries.name: BuffRStream_SetSource
entries.description: (stream, source): when source differs from the current one (+8) first runs BuffRStream_ReleaseSource(stream); stores source at +8 and its vtable +4 answer at +0x10, clears +0x19 and +0x1d, then BuffRStream_SyncStatus(stream).

entries.name: BuffRStream_ReleaseSource
entries.description: (stream): when a source is attached (+8): calls the stream's own vtable +0x10, seeks the source (its vtable +8) to the position recorded at attach (+0x10) plus +0x1d, clears +8 and sets status 6. BuffRStream_SetSource runs it before attaching a different source.

entries.name: BuffRStream_GetCapabilities
entries.description: BuffRStream slot +0xc (stream, query): query 0 answers 0xd (the stream type), 2 and 3 answer 1, anything else 0.

entries.name: BuffRStream_GetPosition
entries.description: BuffRStream slot +4: the source position the buffer starts at (+0x10) plus the cursor in it (+0x1d), while attached; else 0.

entries.name: BuffRStream_SetPosition
entries.description: BuffRStream slot +8 (stream, pos): clears an end-of-data status (2); with status 0, a position inside the buffered window (+0x10 to +0x10 plus the filled count +0x19) only moves the cursor +0x1d; any other goes to 004502bc(stream, pos).

entries.name: BuffRStream_Flush
entries.description: BuffRStream slot +0x10: returns whether a source is attached (status other than 6). BuffRStream_ReleaseSource calls it before detaching.

entries.name: BuffRStream_Read
entries.description: BuffRStream slot +0x18 (stream, count, dst), with status 0: copies from the buffer +0x14 at the cursor +0x1d; while the request runs past the filled count +0x19 it copies what is left, moves the window on to its end with 004502bc and carries on, returning 0 when that fails.

entries.name: BuffRStream_Write
entries.description: BuffRStream slot +0x14: sets status 4 and returns 0.

entries.name: BuffRStream_FillAt
entries.description: (stream, pos): seeks the source (+8, its vtable +8) to pos and reads a buffer's worth (+0xc) into the buffer +0x14 with Stream_ReadCopy3; a short read at the source's end of data keeps what came (the count at +0x19), or sets status 2 when nothing did. On success the window starts at pos (+0x10) with the cursor +0x1d at 0 and it returns 1; a failed seek or read returns BuffRStream_SyncStatus. BuffRStream_SetPosition and BuffRStream_Read call it.

entries.name: BuffRStream_SyncStatus
entries.description: (stream): sets the status word +4 to 6 (no source attached) when the source +8 is null, else to the source's Stream_GetStatus. Returns 0. BuffRStream_SetSource ends with it.

entries.name: Stream_GetStatus
entries.description: Returns a stream's status word at +4. Stream status codes at +4 seen in these classes: 0 ok, 1 I/O error, 2 end of data, 3 close failed, 4 write to a read-only stream, 5 no file, 6 filter stream not attached.

entries.name: Stream_ReadCopy3
entries.description: (stream, count, buffer): calls the stream's read slot (vtable +0x18); a copy of Stream_Read in the BuffRStream unit. BuffRStream_FillAt reads through it.

entries.name: Str_TrimLeft
entries.description: (s): skips the leading characters whose signed value is below 0x21 (control characters and space, and bytes 0x80-0xff, which MOVSX makes negative), stopping at the NUL, copies the rest down to s, terminates it and returns s. No reference found by es2_xref. Identical after normalisation to DBSIM's Str_TrimLeft (0047d024).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile and disassembly at 004503f4; es2_naming diff

entries.name: Str_TrimRight
entries.description: (s): cuts s after its last character above a space (code > 0x20), dropping trailing blanks and control characters; returns s. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 0047d058.

entries.name: Path_Split
entries.description: (path, drive, dir, name, ext): clears each non-null output, then splits path: a leading 'X:' into drive, everything up to and including the last backslash into dir, then the name up to the first '.' into name and the rest, dot included, into ext (all of it into name when there is no dot). Volume_FindEntry splits its lookup path with it.

entries.name: Str_Concat4
entries.description: (a, b, c, d, out): concatenates the non-null strings a to d into out, or into the static buffer 0048e057 when out is null, and returns it. Volume_FindEntry builds its names with it.

entries.name: Math_Atan2Bam
entries.description: VSHELL's copy of DBSIM's Math_Atan2Bam (0047d220): atan2(y=param_2, x=param_1) in BAM.

entries.name: Math_AsinBam
entries.description: Arcsine of a Q14 sine as a binary angle: below 0xe00 * 4 the coarse table at 0047ac5c, above it the fine table at 004793dc, the sign restored at the end. HGrid_BuildCircleSpans calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Math_AsinBam (0047d940).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00450684; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0047d940

entries.name: DotProductVec3Short
entries.description: a.x*b.x + a.y*b.y + a.z*b.z of two int16 triples, unscaled. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's DotProductVec3Short.

entries.name: DotProductVec3Int
entries.description: (a, b): the int32 dot product a.x*b.x + a.y*b.y + a.z*b.z. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's DotProductVec3Int.

entries.name: Math_DivMod64
entries.description: (out{quotient, remainder}, int64 *n, d): IDIV of n by d, storing n / d and n % d as two int32s; returns out. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Math_DivMod64.

entries.name: Math_FastMagnitude2D
entries.description: (dx, dy): max(|dx|,|dy|) + min(|dx|,|dy|)/2, the octagonal estimate. TSBSPPart_RenderNode calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Math_FastMagnitude2D (0047dd40).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0045085c; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0047dd40

entries.name: Math_FastMagnitude3D
entries.description: VSHELL's copy of DBSIM's Math_FastMagnitude3D: L + M*0.34375 + S*0.25.

entries.name: Transform_TransposeRotation
entries.description: Transposes a transform's rotation in place (swaps +2/+4, +8/+0xc, +0xa/+0xe), which inverts a pure rotation.

entries.name: Math_Mul32To64
entries.description: (out int64, a, b): IMUL into EDX:EAX, stores the 64-bit product a * b and returns out. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Math_Mul32To64.

entries.name: Math_ISqrt
entries.description: (n) -> floor(sqrt(n)) for unsigned n, bit by bit: BSR for the top bit, then trial additions of halving powers of two against the running square. 0 for 0. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Math_ISqrt (0047de90).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00450970; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0047de90

entries.name: Math_CosBam
