entries.description: ANSequence vtable 0047f720 slot +0x28, (seq, frame, target, flag): 1 when frame < target, or frame == target and flag is 0; otherwise 0. AnimThread_FindTransition asks it of a transition's destination sequence for forward play, through ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetDir, with the thread's +0x1c as the flag. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ANSequence_FrameShortOfTarget (00478680).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0046301c and 00465836; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 00478680

entries.name: ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetBackward
entries.description: ANSequence vtable 0047f720 slot +0x2c, ANSequence_FrameShortOfTarget's mirror for backward play: 1 when frame > target, or frame == target and flag is 0. ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetDir calls it when the thread plays backward. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetBackward (004786ac).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00463048 and 00465836; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 004786ac

entries.name: ANCyclicSequence_NextFrame
entries.description: ANCyclicSequence vtable 0047f6e4 slot +0x20 (sequence, frame): frame + 1 while frame is below the frame count +0xa less 1, else 0: it wraps. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ANCyclicSequence_NextFrame (004786d8).

entries.name: ANCyclicSequence_PrevFrame
entries.description: ANCyclicSequence vtable 0047f6e4 slot +0x24 (sequence, frame): frame - 1, or the frame count +0xa less 1 at frame 0: it wraps. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ANCyclicSequence_PrevFrame (004786f8).

entries.name: ANCyclicSequence_FrameShortOfTarget_Always
entries.description: ANCyclicSequence vtable 0047f6e4 slot +0x28: returns 1 whatever its arguments, where ANSequence_FrameShortOfTarget compares them. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ANCyclicSequence_FrameShortOfTarget_Always (00478714).

entries.name: ANCyclicSequence_FrameShortOfTargetBackward_Always
entries.description: ANCyclicSequence vtable 0047f6e4 slot +0x2c: returns 1 whatever its arguments, where ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetBackward compares them. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ANCyclicSequence_FrameShortOfTargetBackward_Always (00478720).

entries.name: ANShapeInstance_Ctor
entries.description: ANShapeInstance constructor (vtable 0047f420, RTTI 'ANShapeInstance', 0x42 bytes): (inst, shape) TSShapeInstance_Ctor, its own vtable, ten cleared dwords at +0x1a; then from the shape's animation list (+0x2a): the default-transform count (+0x16) into +0xc, a byte array of that many flags at +0xe (all set to 1), 12-byte entries at +0x12 copied from the list's transforms (+0x12) by each default transform index (+0x18), and that many 32-byte Transforms at +0x16 (Transform_Ctor); then 004634a4(inst) and 00465778(+0x16).

entries.name: ANShapeInstance_Dtor
entries.description: ANShapeInstance vtable 0047f420 slot +0x18 (inst, flags): decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, restores the vtable, frees +0xe, +0x12 and +0x16, TSShapeInstance_Dtor(inst, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: ShapeInst_CountThreads
entries.description: (shapeInst): returns how many of the ten thread slots from shapeInst+0x1a are filled, counting up to the first null. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_CountThreads (004788a4).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00463210; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 004788a4

entries.name: ShapeInst_SortThreadsByPriority
entries.description: (shapeInst): bubble-sorts the filled thread slots at shapeInst+0x1a by AnimThread_SequencePriority. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_SortThreadsByPriority (004788c4).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00463230; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 004788c4

entries.name: ShapeInst_RegisterThread
entries.description: (shapeInst, thread): stores thread in the first empty of the ten slots at shapeInst+0x1a and re-sorts them with ShapeInst_SortThreadsByPriority; returns 1, or 0 when all ten are taken. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_RegisterThread (00478930).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0046329c; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 00478930

entries.name: ShapeInst_RemoveThread
entries.description: (shapeInst, thread): finds thread in the ten slots at shapeInst+0x1a, shifts the slots after it down by one and zeroes the tenth; returns 1, or 0 when thread is not registered. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_RemoveThread (00478964).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 004632d0; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 00478964

entries.name: AnimThread_StepAll
entries.description: (shapeInst, dt): AnimThread_Advance on every thread, last slot first over ShapeInst_CountThreads slots, then ShapeInst_SortThreadsByPriority, then, when there is a first thread, AnimThread_ReadRootTransform of it into world slot 0 (shapeInst+0x16). ShapeInstance_StepAnimation calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_StepAll (004789a0).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0046330c; compared with DBSIM 004789a0

entries.name: ShapeInst_EvalAllNodeLocals
entries.description: (shapeInst): AnimThread_EvalNodeLocals on every thread, last first, with the local-transform array (+0x12) and the dirty flags (+0xe). ShapeInstance_StepAnimation calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_EvalAllNodeLocals (004789f4).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00463360; compared with DBSIM 004789f4

entries.name: ShapeInst_ReadRootTransform
entries.description: (shapeInst, out): AnimThread_ReadRootTransform of the first thread into out (through AnimThread_ReadRootTransform_Thunk), or Transform_Reset(out) when the instance has none. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_ReadRootTransform (00478a30).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0046339c; compared with DBSIM 00478a30

entries.name: ShapeInst_SeedRootTransform
entries.description: (shapeInst, transform): when the instance has a thread, AnimThread_WriteRootTransform(first thread, transform) and copies the 0x20-byte transform into world slot 0 (shapeInst+0x16). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_SeedRootTransform (00478a70).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 004633c4; compared with DBSIM 00478a70

entries.name: ShapeInst_ComposeChildTransform
entries.description: (local, parentWorld, out): expands the 12-byte local record (Euler shorts, then translation shorts widened) with Transform_FromEulerTranslation and concatenates it onto the parent's world transform into out. ShapeInst_BuildWorldTransforms calls it for a node with a parent. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_ComposeChildTransform (00478ab8).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00463410; compared with DBSIM 00478ab8

entries.name: ShapeInst_ExpandRootTransform
entries.description: (local, out): expands one 12-byte local record into a 0x20-byte transform with no parent: Transform_FromEulerTranslation over the three Euler shorts and the three translation shorts widened to ints. ShapeInst_BuildWorldTransforms calls it for a root node. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_ExpandRootTransform (00478b10).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00463468; compared with DBSIM 00478b10

entries.name: ShapeInst_BuildWorldTransforms
entries.description: (shapeInst): walks the shape's relation list ({parent, node} short pairs at animList+0xc, count at +0xa) and rebuilds each node's world transform (+0x16, stride 0x20) whose local is dirty (flag bit 0 at +0xe) or whose parent was rebuilt (bit 1): ShapeInst_ExpandRootTransform for parent -1, else ShapeInst_ComposeChildTransform; marks the node bit 1, then clears every flag. ANShapeInstance_Ctor and ShapeInstance_StepAnimation call it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_BuildWorldTransforms (00478b58).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 004634a4; compared with DBSIM 00478b58

entries.name: ShapeInstance_StepAnimation
entries.description: (shapeInst, dt): AnimThread_StepAll, ShapeInst_EvalAllNodeLocals, ShapeInst_BuildWorldTransforms. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInstance_StepAnimation (00478c2c).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0046357c; compared with DBSIM 00478c2c

entries.name: ShapeInst_PushModelTransform
entries.description: (shapeInst, scratch, root): saves Raster_GetModelTransform, concatenates root onto it into scratch, installs scratch with Raster_SetModelTransform and returns the saved pointer. ANShapeInstance_Render brackets TSShapeInstance_Render with it and ShapeInst_PopModelTransform. DBSIM's copy is 00478c54.

entries.name: ShapeInst_PopModelTransform
entries.description: (shapeInst, saved): Raster_SetModelTransform(saved) when saved is non-null, restoring what ShapeInst_PushModelTransform replaced. DBSIM's copy is 00478c84.

entries.name: ANShapeInstance_Render
entries.description: ANShapeInstance vtable 0047f420 slot +0x1c: builds a local Transform, 004635a4(inst, local, +0x16), installs the instance's transforms +0x16 as its shape's transform array (shape +0x18), TSShapeInstance_Render(inst), then 004635d0(inst, the 004635a4 result).

entries.name: ANShape_Render
entries.description: ANShape vtable 0047f684 slot +0x1c: does nothing. An animated shape is drawn through its ANShapeInstance (ANShapeInstance_Render), not by itself.

entries.name: TSShapeInstance_GetShape
entries.description: (inst): returns the shape at +4. ANShapeInstance_Ctor and ANShapeInstance_Render reach the ANShape through it.

entries.name: AnimThread_ReadRootTransform_Thunk
entries.description: (thread, out): AnimThread_ReadRootTransform(thread, out). ShapeInst_ReadRootTransform calls it.

entries.name: Raster_GetModelTransform
entries.description: Returns 005d7fa4, the model transform Raster_SetModelTransform installed. ShapeInst_PushModelTransform saves it.

entries.name: AN_RegisterClassItems
entries.description: Static initialiser: ClassItem_RegisterBucket(0047f750, [0047f780]), the AN class-item table (ANSequence, ANCyclicSequence, ANShape and the rest). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AN_RegisterClassItems (004912d0).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0046370c; the table address from VshellANSequenceVtable's GetClassTag slot note

entries.name: ANSequence_Construct
entries.description: The load function VSHELL's AN class-item table (0047f750) registers for tag 0x1e0001 'ANSequence': 0x1a bytes from the arena, the ClassItem, TSBase and ANSequence vtables (0047f720 last), then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: ANSequence_GetClassTag
entries.description: ANSequence vtable 0047f720 slot 0: returns 0x1e0001, ANSequence_Construct's tag.

entries.name: ANSequence_GetStreamSize
entries.description: ANSequence slot +4: 10 + 6 per frame (+0xa) + 2 per part (+0x10) + 2 per frame per part. ANCyclicSequence inherits it.

entries.name: ANSequence_GetMemorySize
entries.description: ANSequence slot +8: the same sum with base 0x1a. ANCyclicSequence inherits it.

entries.name: ANSequence_ReadFromStream
entries.description: ANSequence slot +0xc (sequence, stream): the tick +4, priority +6, GM +8 and frame count +0xa; the frame count's 6-byte frames into an arena array at +0xc; the part count +0x10 and its int16 part list at +0x12; then a frames-by-parts int16 transform-index table at +0x16 (Stream_ReadWordsCopy). Names from ANSequence_DebugPrint's labels. ANCyclicSequence inherits it.

entries.name: ANSequence_WriteToStream
entries.description: ANSequence slot +0x10 (sequence, stream): writes what ANSequence_ReadFromStream reads, in the same order.

entries.name: ANSequence_DebugPrint
entries.description: ANSequence slot +0x14 (sequence, verbose, indent): VshellClassItem_DebugPrintType, then when verbose 'tick %3d priority %d GM %d' (+4, +6, +8), the frames (words 0, 2 and 1 of each 6-byte entry under 'tick, 1st transition, transition...'), the 'Part List' and the 'Transform Index List' part by part.

entries.name: ANCyclicSequence_Construct
entries.description: The load function the AN class-item table registers for tag 0x1e0004 'ANCyclicSequence': 0x1a bytes from the arena, the vtable chain through ANSequence to ANCyclicSequence's 0047f6e4, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: ANCyclicSequence_GetClassTag
entries.description: ANCyclicSequence vtable 0047f6e4 slot 0: returns 0x1e0004, ANCyclicSequence_Construct's tag.

entries.name: ANAnimList_Construct
entries.description: The load function the AN class-item table registers for tag 0x1e0002 'ANAnimList': 0x22 bytes from the arena, the ClassItem, TSBase and ANAnimList vtables (0047f6b8 last), then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: ANAnimList_GetClassTag
entries.description: ANAnimList vtable 0047f6b8 slot 0: returns 0x1e0002, ANAnimList_Construct's tag.

entries.name: ANAnimList_GetStreamSize
entries.description: ANAnimList slot +4: 10 for the five counts + 8 per transition (+0x1c) + 12 per transform (+0x10) + 2 per default transform (+0x16) + 4 per relation (+0xa), plus ClassItem_ItemTotalSize of each sequence (+4 of them at +6).

entries.name: ANAnimList_GetMemorySize
entries.description: ANAnimList slot +8: the same sum with base 0x22, plus each sequence's GetMemorySize.

entries.name: ANAnimList_ReadFromStream
entries.description: ANAnimList slot +0xc (list, stream): the sequence count +4 and that many sequences loaded with VshellClassItem_LoadItem into an arena array at +6; the transition count +0x1c and its 8-byte entries at +0x1e; the transform count +0x10 and its 12-byte entries at +0x12; the default-transform count +0x16 and its int16 indexes at +0x18; the relation count +0xa and its 4-byte entries at +0xc. Names from ANAnimList_DebugPrint's labels.

entries.name: ANAnimList_WriteToStream
entries.description: ANAnimList slot +0x10 (list, stream): writes what ANAnimList_ReadFromStream reads, the sequences through ClassItem_StoreItem.

entries.name: ANAnimList_DebugPrint
entries.description: ANAnimList slot +0x14 (list, verbose, indent): VshellClassItem_DebugPrintType, then when verbose 'Sequence Count %d' and each sequence's DebugPrint; 'Transitions (tick, destSequence, ...)' four int16s per entry; 'Transforms (rx ry rz tx ty tz)'; 'Default Transforms'; 'Relations (parent, destination)'.

entries.name: ANShape_Construct
entries.description: The load function the AN class-item table registers for tag 0x1e0003 'ANShape': 0x2e bytes from the arena, TSShape_Ctor, ANShape's vtable 0047f684, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: ANShape_GetClassTag
entries.description: ANShape vtable 0047f684 slot 0: returns 0x1e0003, ANShape_Construct's tag.

entries.name: ANShape_GetStreamSize
entries.description: ANShape slot +4: TSShape_GetStreamSize plus ClassItem_ItemTotalSize of the animation list at +0x2a.

entries.name: ANShape_GetMemorySize
entries.description: ANShape slot +8: the animation list's GetMemorySize + TSShape_GetMemorySize + 4.

entries.name: ANShape_ReadFromStream
entries.description: ANShape slot +0xc (shape, stream): TSShape_ReadFromStream, then one more class item, the shape's ANAnimList, into +0x2a (VshellClassItem_LoadItem(stream, 0)).

entries.name: ANShape_WriteToStream
entries.description: ANShape slot +0x10 (shape, stream): TSShape_WriteToStream, then ClassItem_StoreItem(+0x2a, stream, 0).

entries.name: ANShape_DebugPrint
entries.description: ANShape slot +0x14 (shape, verbose, indent): TSShape_DebugPrint, then when verbose the animation list's own DebugPrint with verbose - 1 and indent + 1.

entries.name: TSPartBase_Dtor
entries.description: TSPartBase vtable 0047f0f8 slot +0x18 (part, flags): decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, TSBase_Dtor(part, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: Stream_ReadWord
entries.description: (stream, dst): reads 2 bytes through the stream's read slot (vtable +0x18). GLFont_ReadFromStream reads its int16 fields with it.

entries.name: Stream_WriteWord
entries.description: (stream, value): writes the low 2 bytes of its value argument through the stream's write slot (vtable +0x14). GLFont_WriteToStream writes its int16 fields with it.

entries.name: Stream_ReadWordsCopy
entries.description: (stream, count, dst): reads count * 2 bytes through the stream's read slot (vtable +0x18); a second copy of Stream_ReadWords. TSBSPPart's, TSDetailPart's and ANSequence's reads call it.

entries.name: Stream_WriteWordsCopy
entries.description: (stream, count, src): writes count * 2 bytes through the stream's write slot (vtable +0x14); a second copy of Stream_WriteWords.

entries.name: maybe_Point3SPair_Ctor
entries.description: (p): maybe_Point3S_Ctor on p and p+6, returns p: the element constructor of a 12-byte record of two int16 triples. Rtl_VectorNew sites found by es2_xref: ANShapeInstance_Ctor (PUSH at 00463115) for its +0x12 array of the anim list's default-transform count, and ANAnimList_ReadFromStream (00463f67) for the transforms at +0x12, both element size 0xc. Identical after normalisation to DBSIM's maybe_Point3SPair_Ctor (004921da).
entries.source: VSHELL disassembly at 00464764 and at its two PUSH sites

entries.name: ANShape_Dtor
entries.description: ANShape vtable 0047f684 slot +0x18 (shape, flags): decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, TSShape_Dtor(shape, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: ANAnimList_Dtor
entries.description: ANAnimList vtable 0047f6b8 slot +0x18 (list, flags): when list is set, decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, TSBase_Dtor(list, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set. Its arrays sit in the arena and are not freed here.

entries.name: ANCyclicSequence_Dtor
entries.description: ANCyclicSequence vtable 0047f6e4 slot +0x18 (sequence, flags): when set, decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr twice (its own level and ANSequence's), TSBase_Dtor(sequence, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: ANSequence_Dtor
entries.description: ANSequence vtable 0047f720 slot +0x18 (sequence, flags): when set, decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, TSBase_Dtor(sequence, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: AnimThread_Ctor
entries.description: (thread, animList): maybe_Point3S_Ctor on +0x22 and +0x28, Transform_Ctor on +0x2e, stores animList at +0, AnimThread_SetSequence(thread, 0, 0, 0), then Transform_Reset(+0x2e); returns thread. No caller found by es2_xref. DBSIM's AnimThread_Ctor (00478d3c) does the same with the transform reset inlined (memset of 0x20 bytes, 0x4000 at +0x2e, +0x34, +0x3e).

entries.name: AnimThread_SequencePriority
entries.description: (thread): returns the int16 at +6 of the sequence the thread is playing (shape->sequences[thread+4]), the sequence's priority. ShapeInst_SortThreadsByPriority orders by it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_SequencePriority (00478d80).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00464a40; es2_naming.py diff of 00463230 against DBSIM 004788c4

entries.name: AnimThread_ElapsedTicks
entries.description: (thread): the ticks played into the current sequence: the durations (+0 of each 6-byte frame record) of the frames from 0, stepping with the sequence's vtable +0x20, up to the current frame (+6), plus the intra-frame offset +0x1c.

entries.name: AnimThread_LoadFrameGroundMovement
entries.description: (thread, sequence, frame): when the sequence's ground-movement flag (+8) is set, AnimThread_LoadGroundTransform with the root node's transform index for the frame (+0x16 indices, frame * +0x10 parts); otherwise clears thread+0x20. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_LoadFrameGroundMovement (00478de8), which inlines the load.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00464aa8; compared with DBSIM 00478de8

entries.name: AnimThread_CommitGroundMovement
entries.description: (thread): when thread+0x20 is set, folds the frame's ground transform (translation +0x22, rotation +0x28) into the stored transform at +0x2e. AnimThread_Advance runs it on each frame passed forward. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_CommitGroundMovement (00478e60).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00464af4; compared with DBSIM 00478e60

entries.name: AnimThread_UncommitGroundMovement
entries.description: (thread): AnimThread_CommitGroundMovement with the ground transform inverted (Transform_InvertRigid), for backward play. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_UncommitGroundMovement (00478ee8).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00464b88; compared with DBSIM 00478ee8

entries.name: AnimThread_ReadRootTransform
entries.description: (thread, out): the stored transform (+0x2e) when there is no ground movement (+0x20 clear), otherwise the ground transform scaled by +0x1c / +0x1e (the fraction of the frame played) concatenated onto it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_ReadRootTransform (00478fa8).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00464c28; compared with DBSIM 00478fa8

entries.name: AnimThread_WriteRootTransform
entries.description: (thread, transform): the inverse of AnimThread_ReadRootTransform: stores transform at +0x2e, or the inverted scaled ground transform concatenated with it when +0x20 is set. ShapeInst_SeedRootTransform calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_WriteRootTransform (00479088).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00464d14; compared with DBSIM 00479088

entries.name: AnimThread_SetSequence
entries.description: (thread, sequence, frame, offset): cuts a thread straight to a sequence and frame: sequence at +4 and +8, frame at +6, the sequence's vtable +0x20 answer at +0xa, offset at +0x1c, the frame's duration at +0x1e, AnimThread_LoadFrameGroundMovement; then clears the target (+0x16 and +0x18 = -1, +0x1a = 0), sets +0xc = -1 and stores 1 (at target) in the flags at +0x50. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_SetSequence (004791a0).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00464e08; compared with DBSIM 004791a0

entries.name: AnimThread_SeekToPosition
entries.description: (thread, sequence, position): sums the sequence's frame durations, scales the Q14 position by total - 1 (FixedMulQ14_Thunk), walks the frames subtracting durations and AnimThread_SetSequence's the frame and remainder. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_SeekToPosition (00479238).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00464eac; compared with DBSIM 00479238

entries.name: AnimThread_FindTransition
entries.description: (thread): walks the current sequence's frames from the current frame (+6) when playing backward (rate +0x4e < 0) or the next frame (+0xa) otherwise, stepping with the sequence's vtable +0x24 or +0x20 until it laps, and takes the first transition (AnimThread_FrameTransitionFirst/Count) into the target sequence +0x16 that ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetDir accepts, storing its fields at +0xe..+0x14 with the frame it leaves in +0xc; +0xc = -1 when none does. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_FindTransition (004792c8), with the transition-table reads and the direction test out of line.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00464f38; compared with DBSIM 004792c8

entries.name: AnimThread_SetTarget
entries.description: (thread, sequence, frame, flags): stores the target at +0x16/+0x18/+0x1a and clears the at-target bit (+0x50 bit 0); runs AnimThread_FindTransition unless the target is -1 or is already the current sequence and frame with no offset, in which case it sets the bit and +0xc = -1. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_SetTarget (00479570).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00465168; compared with DBSIM 00479570

entries.name: AnimThread_SetPlaybackRate
entries.description: (thread, rate): stores rate at +0x4e and, when its sign flips, re-runs AnimThread_SetTarget with the current target. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_SetPlaybackRate (004795cc).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 004651c4; compared with DBSIM 004795cc

entries.name: AnimThread_Advance
entries.description: (thread, dt): unless parked at its target, advances the intra-frame offset by dt * rate (+0x4e) >> 8, crossing frames forward (AnimThread_CommitGroundMovement) or backward (AnimThread_UncommitGroundMovement), taking a found transition at its frame (AnimThread_LoadGroundTransform) and setting the at-target bit on reaching the target. AnimThread_StepAll calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_Advance (00479614).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0046520c; compared with DBSIM 00479614

entries.name: AnimThread_EvalNodeLocals
entries.description: (thread, locals, dirty): for each animated column of the playing sequence, the transform-pool index at (sequence, frame) and at (next sequence, next frame): equal indices copy the 12-byte record, different ones Anim_BlendKeyframeTransforms by offset/duration in Q10; marks the node dirty. ShapeInst_EvalAllNodeLocals calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_EvalNodeLocals (004799a4).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00465574; compared with DBSIM 004799a4

entries.name: Rtl_ReturnArgCopy
entries.description: Returns its argument unchanged -- a second copy of Rtl_ReturnArg (00468044), as in DBSIM. maybe_Point3S_Ctor calls it.

entries.name: maybe_Point3S_Ctor
entries.description: Rtl_ReturnArgCopy(p), then returns p: the VSHELL copy of DBSIM's maybe_Point3S_Ctor, the empty constructor of a 6-byte int16 triple. TSContext_Ctor and Light_TransformToModelSpace call it. The name is inferred from those sites.

entries.name: Point3I_FromPoint3S
entries.description: (dst, src): widens an int16 triple into an int32 triple: z at dst+8, then x and y through Point2I_FromPoint2S. Returns dst. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Point3I_FromPoint3S.

entries.name: Transform_InvertRigid
entries.description: Inverts a rigid transform in place: Transform_TransposeRotation, then the translation becomes the transposed rotation applied to -t.

entries.name: Transform_Concat_Thunk
entries.description: One-line forwarder to Transform_Concat with the same arguments.

entries.name: Point2I_FromPoint2S
entries.description: (dst, src): widens two int16s into two int32s. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Point2I_FromPoint2S.

entries.name: Transform_TransposeRotation_Thunk
entries.description: One-line forwarder to Transform_TransposeRotation.

entries.name: Transform_Reset
entries.description: (xf): memsets the 0x20-byte transform and stores 0x4000 at +0, +6 and +0x10, the identity; returns xf. 0045fa04 resets 005d7fa8 (Raster_SetModelTransform's identity), ANShapeInstance_Ctor its world slot 0 and ShapeInst_ReadRootTransform its output. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Transform_Reset (0048dd6c).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00465778; compared with DBSIM 0048dd6c

entries.name: AnimThread_LoadGroundTransform
entries.description: (thread, index): loads transform-pool record index (animList+0x12, stride 0xc) into the thread's ground translation (+0x22..+0x26, from the record's +6) and rotation (+0x28..+0x2c, from +0) and sets +0x20 = 1. AnimThread_LoadFrameGroundMovement and AnimThread_Advance call it; DBSIM inlines it.

entries.name: FixedMulQ14_Thunk
entries.description: (a, b): FixedMulQ14(a, b) on int16 arguments. AnimThread_SeekToPosition calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Math_Q14Multiply_Thunk (004929e1).

entries.name: AnimThread_FrameTransitionCount
entries.description: (animList, sequence, frame): the int16 at +2 of the frame's 6-byte record (sequence +0xc), the number of transitions leaving the frame. AnimThread_FindTransition calls it; DBSIM inlines it.

entries.name: AnimThread_FrameTransitionFirst
entries.description: (animList, sequence, frame): the int16 at +4 of the frame's 6-byte record, the index of its first transition in the 8-byte table at animList+0x1e. AnimThread_FindTransition calls it; DBSIM inlines it.

entries.name: ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetDir
entries.description: (seq, frame, target, flag, rate): the sequence's vtable +0x28 (ANSequence_FrameShortOfTarget) when rate is not negative, else +0x2c (ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetBackward). AnimThread_FindTransition calls it; DBSIM inlines the choice.

entries.name: Anim_BlendKeyframeTransforms
entries.description: (a, b, t, out): blends two 12-byte ANAnimList transform records (3 Euler shorts then 3 translation shorts) by a Q10 factor (0x400 is all b), the rotations along the shortest arc. 00465574 calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Anim_BlendKeyframeTransforms (00492600).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0046586c; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 00492600

entries.name: ShellRandom_Reset
entries.description: Cursors to 0x18/0x37 and the 112-byte seed table from 0047f7b4, byte-identical to DBSIM's.

entries.name: ShellRandom_Seed
entries.description: (state, n): ShellRandom_Reset then n steps. Startup passes GetTickCount() & 0x7f.

entries.name: ShellRandom_Next
entries.description: VSHELL's additive lagged Fibonacci step over a 56-entry int16 table, cursors at +0x70/+0x71 -- DBSIM's Math_RandomNext.

entries.name: ShellRandom_Below
entries.description: (state, n) -> (ShellRandom_Next & 0x7fff) % n.

entries.name: ShellRandom_ResetNoOp
entries.description: Empty body. ShellRandom_Reset's last call, as Math_RandomSeedNoOp is Math_RandomSeed's.

entries.name: ShellRandom_SeedNoOp
entries.description: Empty body. ShellRandom_Seed calls it after ShellRandom_Reset, before the discarded steps.

entries.name: Shell_TimerTicks
entries.description: (GetTickCount() - base) >> 4: the timer the map intro runs on, one tick 16 ms.

entries.name: Time_AdvanceCoarseTick
entries.description: Subtracts 0x10 from Shell_TimerTicks' base (005ddbcc), moving the 16 ms clock on by one tick. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Time_AdvanceCoarseTick (00467734).

entries.name: Time_InitSimClock
entries.description: 005ddbb8 = 005ddbba = 0x100, 005ddbc4 = 1000, 005ddbc6 = 005ddbbc = 005ddbbe = 1000 / 10 = 100 and 005ddbc0 = 100, then 005ddbc8 and Shell_TimerTicks' base 005ddbcc = GetTickCount(). DBSIM's copy, Time_InitSimClock (0046773c), divides by 8, so its unit is 125 ms where this one's is 100 ms.

entries.name: Time_ElapsedToQ8Clamped
entries.description: (unit, elapsed): (elapsed << 8) / unit clamped to [0x40, 0x1c2], returned in AX. Time_BeginSimTick computes both Q8 deltas through it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Time_ElapsedToQ8Clamped (00467790).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00465a8c; compared with DBSIM 00467790

entries.name: Time_BeginSimTick
entries.description: Spins until 2 ms have passed since 005ddbc8, stores the elapsed ms at 005ddbc0, sets 005ddbb8 = Time_ElapsedToQ8Clamped(005ddbbc, elapsed) and 005ddbba = Time_ElapsedToQ8Clamped(005ddbbe, elapsed), and advances 005ddbc8 by the elapsed time. DBSIM's copy, Time_BeginSimTick (004677bc), waits 40 ms.

entries.name: Math_IntegrateRateOverTick
entries.description: (rate): FixedMulQ8_Swapped(rate, 005ddbb8), clamped to +/-0x7fff. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Math_IntegrateRateOverTick (00467820).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00465b1c; compared with DBSIM 00467820

entries.name: Math_IntegrateRateOverTick2
entries.description: (rate): Math_IntegrateRateOverTick with the second Q8 delta, 005ddbba. DBSIM's copy is Math_IntegrateRateOverTick2 (00467858).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00465b50; compared with DBSIM 00467858

entries.name: Math_RateFromTickDelta
entries.description: (delta): Math_DivInt(delta << 8, 005ddbb8), the inverse of Math_IntegrateRateOverTick: the per-unit rate that yields delta this tick. DBSIM's copy is Math_RateFromTickDelta (00467890).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00465b84; compared with DBSIM 00467890

entries.name: Math_IntegrateRateWithRemainder
entries.description: (value, remainder): value = clamp(value * 005ddbb8 >> 8, +/-0x7fff) in place, and remainder = the low 8 bits of |value * delta| (Math_AbsShortSaturating) shifted left 2, or 0x3ff when the product overflows, with value's sign. DBSIM's copy is Math_IntegrateRateWithRemainder (004678a8).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00465ba4; compared with DBSIM 004678a8

entries.name: Timer_SetInt
entries.description: (rec, value): the int at rec+1 = Math_MulShortInt64(value, 005ddbc6 << 8). It sits where DBSIM has ActionTimer_SetDelay (004679c0), which stores value << 11 instead.

entries.name: Math_AbsShortSaturating
entries.description: (x): |x| for an int16, 0x7fff for -0x8000. Math_IntegrateRateWithRemainder calls it; DBSIM inlines it.

entries.name: FixedMulQ8_Swapped
entries.description: (a, b): FixedMulQ8(b, a). Math_IntegrateRateOverTick and Math_IntegrateRateOverTick2 call it; DBSIM calls Math_Q8Multiply directly.

entries.description: (a, b): a / b, signed. 00465b84 calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Math_DivInt (004929f8).

entries.name: Cpu_GetStackPointer
entries.description: MOV EAX,ESP; RET: returns ESP as it stands inside the call (the caller's ESP minus 4). One of three register getters after Math_MulShortInt64. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.description: MOV EAX,ES; RET: returns the ES selector. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Poly_ScanConvertEitherWinding
entries.description: (count, points, out): does nothing for count 0. For more than two points sums the shoelace cross products in 64 bits; a sum of zero or less (anticlockwise on screen, or degenerate) goes to Poly_ScanConvertReversed, otherwise, and for one or two points, straight to Poly_ScanConvert. Called by Poly_BuildSpanList.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 00465e0a and its two entry wrappers; DBSIM copies matched by byte comparison

entries.name: Poly_ScanConvertReversed
entries.description: (count, points, out): for more than two points copies the points in reverse order into a 100-int stack buffer (no bounds check) and scan-converts that with Poly_ScanConvert, so an anticlockwise polygon comes out clockwise; otherwise passes points through unchanged.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 00465e0a and its two entry wrappers; DBSIM copies matched by byte comparison

entries.name: Poly_ScanConvert
entries.description: (count, points, out): the int32 twin of Poly_ScanConvertToSpanRegion: scan-converts a convex, clockwise outline into {top, rows, then an int32 {x0, x1} pair per row} by the same rules (docs/retail/polygon-fill.md#scan-conversion). Called only through Poly_ScanConvertEitherWinding and Poly_ScanConvertReversed.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 00465e0a and its two entry wrappers; DBSIM copies matched by byte comparison

entries.name: ViewFrustum_DefaultCtor
entries.description: (frustum): maybe_Point3I_Ctor on +0xc, Rtl_VectorNew of six 0x10-byte planes from +0x18 (Plane_Ctor), then 0 at +0 and +4 and -1 at +8; returns frustum. No caller found by es2_xref. Identical after normalisation to DBSIM's ViewFrustum_DefaultCtor (00494858).

entries.name: ViewFrustum_Ctor
entries.description: (frustum, far, margin): constructs +0xc and the six 0x10-byte planes from +0x18 (Plane_Ctor), stores far at +4, margin at +0 and -1 at +8; returns frustum. Terrain_SetupVisibleRegion (0042956e) calls it, in the branch it takes when its third argument is 0, with far = grid+0x108 << grid+0x104 and margin = 1 << grid+0x104 (one cell). Identical after normalisation to DBSIM's ViewFrustum_Ctor (00494898).

entries.name: ViewFrustum_Build
entries.description: (frustum, view, far, margin): the VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ViewFrustum_Build (004948d8), statement for statement: the six planes built in view axes from far, margin, the view's perspective shift and the render context's rect and centre, rotated by the view's matrix (View_BuildTransform, Transform_RotatePoint_Thunk) and set with Plane_FromPointNormal. It reads the view position through LightFrame_GetPosition where DBSIM calls View_GetPosition; both return +4. Terrain_SetupVisibleRegion (0042956e) calls it in its third-argument-0 branch.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00467654; es2_naming diff against DBSIM 004948d8

entries.name: ViewFrustum_ClipPolygon
entries.description: (frustum, poly, out) -> bool: ViewFrustum_ClipGroundPolygon without the Z shift. No caller found by es2_xref. Identical after normalisation to DBSIM's ViewFrustum_ClipPolygon (00494ba8).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00467920; es2_naming diff against DBSIM 00494ba8

entries.name: ViewFrustum_ClipGroundPolygon
entries.description: (frustum, poly, lowZ, highZ, out) -> bool: copies the six planes, shifting each non-vertical one (Plane_IsVertical) along Z (Plane_ShiftAlongZ) by lowZ or -highZ by the sign of its Z component, moves poly to the eye (Poly3_SubtractOffset), cuts it against the enabled planes and moves the result back (Poly3_AddOffset); returns whether points are left. Terrain_SetupVisibleRegion (0042956e) calls it with grid +0x10c and +0x110 in its third-argument-0 branch and stores the result at grid+0x118. Matches DBSIM's ViewFrustum_ClipGroundPolygon (00494d4c) after normalisation up to the plane-copy loop's indexing.

entries.name: Poly3_SubtractOffset
entries.description: (in, offset, out): out = in with offset subtracted from each int32 {x, y, z} point; count copied. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Poly3_SubtractOffset (00494f98).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.description: (in, offset, out): out = in with offset added to each int32 {x, y, z} point; count copied. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Poly3_AddOffset (00494fe0).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: LightFrame_GetPosition
entries.description: (frame): returns frame+4, the int32 position. Light_TransformToModelSpace transforms it; 0045f811 calls it on the model frame (+0x1e) and 00467654 copies the three ints. The sibling of LightFrame_GetDirection.

entries.name: Transform_Ctor
entries.description: (transform): Transform_CtorRotation on it and maybe_Point3I_Ctor on its translation at +0x14; returns it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Transform_Ctor.

entries.name: View_GetPerspectiveShift
entries.description: (view) -> the dword at view + 0x1a. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's View_GetPerspectiveShift.

entries.name: View_GetRenderContext
entries.description: (view) -> the dword at view + 0x16. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's View_GetRenderContext.

entries.description: (view, out): 00467e23(out, view + 0x10, view + 4) -- the VSHELL copy of DBSIM's View_BuildTransform.

entries.description: (out, euler short[3], translation int[3]): stores the translation at out+0x14/+0x18/+0x1c and builds the rotation with BuildEulerRotationMatrixQ14_Thunk(out, euler); returns out. View_BuildTransform, the ShapeInst root and child expansions and the AnimThread ground-movement functions call it.

entries.description: (plane): maybe_Point3I_Ctor on the plane's leading normal; returns the plane. 004675d4, 00467614 and 00467ac4 pass it to Rtl_VectorNew for six 0x10-byte planes each. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Plane_Ctor (00495102).

entries.description: (a, b): exchanges the dwords at a and b. Every direct caller swaps the in and out point-list pointers after a Poly_SplitByPlane pass.

entries.name: Plane_IsVertical
entries.description: (plane) -> 1 when the normal's Z is 0 and X, Y are not both 0; 0 otherwise. 00467ac4 asks it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Plane_IsVertical (0049512a).

entries.name: HeightOffsetTable_Ctor
entries.description: VectorTable constructor (vtables ClassItem 0047f834, TSBase 0047f858, then VectorTable 0047f884; RTTI name 'VectorTable', 0x1c bytes): (table, count) stores count at +0xc, base 0 at +8 and step 100 at +4, a count-byte computed-flag array at +0x10, count int32 triples at +0x14 and eight at +0x18. HeightGrid_Ctor builds one with 0x100 at +0xd0.

entries.description: (table, base, step): stores base at table+8 and step at table+4. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's HeightOffsetTable_SetScale (004951dc). HeightGrid_FromBitmap and HeightGrid_Load call it.

entries.description: (table): memsets the per-height computed flags (table+0x10, length table+0xc) and writes the view-space image of (0, 0, 0x10000) under g_ModelToView into *(table+0x18). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's HeightOffsetTable_Reset (004951f0).

entries.name: HeightOffsetTable_Get
entries.description: (table, rawHeight): returns the 12-byte offset of a raw height byte at table+0x14 + rawHeight*12, filling it on first use (flag byte table+0x10[rawHeight]): each component of the up vector at *(table+0x18) times rawHeight*step(+4) + base(+8) through FixedMulQ16. HGrid's cell drawer 00429dac calls it four times. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's HeightOffsetTable_Get (00495240).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: Rtl_ReturnArg
entries.description: Returns its argument unchanged. Font_DrawGlyph, Font_DrawString and Gfx_FillEllipse call it.

entries.name: maybe_Point3I_Ctor
entries.description: Rtl_ReturnArg(p), then returns p. Called on uninitialised int32[3] locals before they are filled (Light_TransformToModelSpace, Gfx_FillEllipse), so it reads as Point3I's empty constructor; the name is inferred from those call sites.

entries.name: VectorTable_Dtor
entries.description: VectorTable vtable 0047f884 slot +0x18 (table, flags): decrements *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, TSBase_Dtor(table, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: Transform_RotatePoint_Thunk
entries.description: One-line forwarder to Transform_RotatePoint with the same arguments. TSPoly_FrontBackVisibilityTest calls it.

entries.name: Shell_PumpEvents
entries.description: Timer_Tick on the timer list at [g_WinTimer], then EventQueue_Pump on [g_EventQueue].

entries.name: WinEvents_Init
entries.description: Registers the six window-event classes' class-item bucket (0047f9f4, count [0047fa3c] = 6: WinEvent, WinMouseEvent, WinScrollEvent, WinKeyEvent, WinCommandEvent and WinTimerEvent, tags 0x5a0000-0x5a0005) with ClassItem_RegisterBucket, builds the event queue (0x20 bytes, EventQueue_Ctor) into g_EventQueue and the WinTimer (0x149 bytes, WinTimer_Ctor) into g_WinTimer, and zeroes Pointer_FracX and Pointer_FracY. Shell_Main calls it once, after the catalogs and before the display is built.

entries.name: Pointer_MoveTo
entries.description: (point): when the point lies inside the display root (Display_GetRoot, Window_ContainsPoint), posts a mouse move (WinMouseEvent, sub-code 0) at it for Display_Current to the event queue (EventQueue_Append on g_EventQueue), moves the system cursor there through the display's vtable +0x10 and zeroes Pointer_FracX and Pointer_FracY. WinConsumer_HandleEvent's cursor-key commands use it.

entries.name: Display_GetCursorPos
entries.description: (point): calls Display_Current's vtable +0x14 (WinWin95Display_GetCursorPos for the shell's display) with point.

entries.name: Display_NoOp

entries.name: Event_Post
entries.description: Queues an event. A mouse move is first scaled, accumulated and clamped to the display (with a hop to an adjacent display at an edge); every event gets the display at +0x18 before it is queued.

entries.name: Display_FindNeighbour
entries.description: (edge): the display beyond Display_Current's given edge, from the adjacency records {a, b, edge} at 005ddbe8 (count 0047f8ac): b for a record whose a is the current display and whose edge matches, a for one whose b is the current display and whose edge is the opposite (table 0047f8b8); 0 when none. Event_Post's pointer hop asks it.

entries.name: Display_HopTo
entries.description: (display, point): moves the pointer onto another display: runs slot +0x1c of the outgoing display's vtable (at +1), wraps point into the outgoing display's extents and rescales it to the new one's, makes display Display_Current, runs its +0x10 with the point and +0x18, and clears Pointer_FracX/Pointer_FracY. Event_Post calls it at an edge.

entries.name: EventQueue_Ctor
entries.description: (queue): the event queue and pointer state at g_EventQueue. PtrVector_Ctor(+0x11, 5), zeroes +1, +5, +9 and +0xd and the pointer lock +0x1f, and counts three class levels live (*Rtl_DtorCountPtr). It writes no vtable. EventQueue_Append, EventQueue_Pump and the Pointer_* functions work on the object.

entries.name: EventQueue_Append
entries.description: (queue, event): PtrVector_Append(queue+0x11, event); when that fails, counts Assert_CheckCount and Assert_Report (include\WHANDLER.H line 0x43). Event_Post and Pointer_MoveTo append to g_EventQueue with it.

entries.name: EventQueue_Pump
entries.description: Drains the event queue at handler+0x11. A mouse move (type 0x20, sub-code 0) re-runs Widget_HitTestTree from the display root and, when the answer changes, sends leave (0x10) to the old target and enter (8) to the new; any other event with no target goes to the current pointer target at handler+1. Then Event_Deliver.

entries.name: Pointer_SetTarget
entries.description: Pointer_Leave, then Pointer_Enter with the given widget: moves the pointer's target without a hit test.

entries.name: Pointer_Unlock
entries.description: Clears the pointer lock, +0x1f of the pointer state at g_EventQueue, and hit-tests again at the last position, sending a leave and an enter if the target changed. While the lock is set EventQueue_Pump skips the hit test and every mouse event goes to the current target; ESDialog_HandleEvent, SaveScreen_BeginRename (004377d2) and 0043bc0a set it.

entries.name: Widget_HitTestTree
entries.description: Widget_HitTestTree(handler, widget, point): null when the widget is hidden (+0x11 bit 2) or the point is outside it; otherwise tries its children in list order (newest first) recursively and returns the first hit, or the widget itself. The pointer's target on every mouse move.

entries.name: Pointer_Leave
entries.description: Sends a leave event (0x10) to the pointer's current target and clears it. The leave is what clears a pressed widget's +0x45, cancelling the click.

entries.name: Pointer_Enter
entries.description: Sets the pointer's target (hit-testing from the display root when passed null) and sends it an enter event (8); then sets the cursor from the first +0x35 up the parent chain.

entries.name: Event_Deliver
entries.description: Finds the receiver with Event_FindReceiver, discards the event when there is none, otherwise makes the point local (Event_ToLocal) and calls the receiver's vtable slot 0.

entries.name: Event_FindReceiver
entries.description: Walks from the event's target (+0x20) through Window_Parent to the first widget whose event mask +0x39 has the event type's bit; the result goes to event+0x1c. How a click on a Text reaches its parent.

entries.name: Event_ToLocal
entries.description: Subtracts the event target's absolute origin (+0x15, +0x19) from the event point (+0x10, +0x14).

entries.name: PtrVector_PopFront
entries.description: (vector): 0 when the count (+0) is 0; otherwise asserts it positive (d:\include\ptrarray.h line 0x60, PtrArray::operator[]), takes element 0 of the data at +10, removes it with PtrVector_RemoveAt(vector, 0) and returns it. EventQueue_Pump drains its queue (+0x11) with it.

entries.name: WinTimer_Ctor
entries.description: (timer): the WinTimer at g_WinTimer: zeroes its twenty 16-byte alarm records (+1), the alarm count +0x141, and stores GetTickCount at +0x145. WinTimer_InstallAlarm, WinTimer_RemoveAlarms and Timer_Tick work on the object.

entries.name: WinTimer_InstallAlarm
entries.description: Adds an alarm for a widget to the WinTimer's twenty-entry table at g_WinTimer (asserts 'WinTimer::installAlarm > too many' in code\wintimer.cpp). The edit field installs one at 500, 500 when it takes focus.

entries.name: WinTimer_RemoveAlarms
entries.description: Removes every WinTimer alarm installed for a widget.

entries.name: Timer_Remove
entries.description: (timers, index): removes a timer by moving the last record into its slot and decrementing the count at +0x141.

entries.name: Timer_Tick
entries.description: Advances a timer list by the GetTickCount delta since the last tick (stored at +0x145). Timers are 16-byte records from +1 (count at +0x141): target, remaining ms, period ms, id. An expired timer posts a WinTimerEvent (target at +0x20, id at +0x24) with Event_Post and reloads from its period; a timer with period 0 is then removed (Timer_Remove).

entries.name: Sos_BindLibrary
entries.description: Loads sos9503.dll (setting Sos_UsingSos9503) or sos32s03.dll by GetVersion, and fills the import slots by walking the descriptor array at 00480008 (stride 0x24: slot pointer, then the export name inline) with GetProcAddress; returns 0x390000 when the load fails.
