entries.name: Eh_InitExceptBlock
entries.description: Borland C++ exception-frame prologue: links the caller's frame record into the FS:[0] SEH chain. Called first by most VSHELL functions with a destructor-bearing local, the click thunks included; not part of any dispatch.

entries.name: Rtl_DefaultTerminate
entries.description: The RTL's default terminate handler, which Rtl_ExceptInit stores at +8 of the exception block: calls _abort (0046b672) and returns. Byte-identical to DBSIM's Rtl_DefaultTerminate (00496288) up to the call target.

entries.name: Rtl_SetTerminate
entries.description: Borland RTL set_terminate: (handler): returns the terminate handler at +8 of the thread's exception block (FS:[4] - 8) and stores handler there when it is not null. es2_xref finds no reference to it. Byte-identical to DBSIM's Rtl_SetTerminate (0049628e).

entries.name: Rtl_Terminate
entries.description: Borland RTL terminate: _flushall, calls the exception block's terminate handler (+8), then _abort. Byte-identical to DBSIM's Rtl_Terminate (004962b3).

entries.name: Rtl_DefaultUnexpected
entries.description: The RTL's default unexpected handler, which Rtl_ExceptInit stores at +0xc of the exception block: calls Rtl_Terminate.

entries.name: Rtl_SetUnexpected
entries.description: Borland RTL set_unexpected: (handler): returns the unexpected handler at +0xc of the thread's exception block (FS:[4] - 8) and stores handler there when it is not null. es2_xref finds no reference to it. Byte-identical to DBSIM's Rtl_SetUnexpected (00496309).

entries.name: Rtl_Unexpected
entries.description: Frameless: calls the handler at +0xc of the per-thread exception context (FS:[4] - 8, the block whose +8 Rtl_Terminate calls), then _abort. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Rtl_GetPolymorphicDtorCount
entries.description: Borland RTL helper (the RTL's __GetPolymorphicDTC; no name string for it in the image). Given an object and the offset of its vptr, returns the destructor count stored in the dynamic type's typeinfo: vptr, back by the offset-to-top at vptr[-4], then the typeinfo pointer at -0xc, field +0x20. Returns 0 for a null object. Every polymorphic delete runs '*Rtl_DtorCountPtr += Rtl_GetPolymorphicDtorCount(p, 0); p->vdtor(3)' to keep the exception handler's live-destructor count right.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile and disassembly; calling pattern in every polymorphic delete, e.g. VolRStream_Dtor

entries.name: Rtl_ExceptInit
entries.description: Borland RTL exception setup: (block): with block null, takes the exception-DLL info from the module's own __GetExceptDLLinfo export (GetProcAddress) when 0046c058 is set and the magic lies in 0x82727349-0x82727359, else from Rtl_GetExceptDllInfoInternal; with a block, points its +8 and +0xc at the RTL's 0046b274 and 0046b2ef. Stores the block at FS:[4] - 8, clears FS:[4] - 4 and the block's +4, and for a null block sets Rtl_DtorCountPtr to FS:[4] - 4. Byte-identical to DBSIM's 00496361.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: Rtl_GetExceptDllInfoInternal
entries.description: Borland RTL: (info): stores (the thread's exception block at FS:[4] - 8) + 0x24 at 00480e78 and fills info with the magic 0x82727349 and the address 00480e5c. The exported __GetExceptDLLinfo (00401074) tail-jumps to it, and Rtl_ExceptInit calls it when the module exports none in the magic range.

entries.name: maybe_Rtl_MathErr
entries.description: (e): for e+0 == 4 zeroes the double at +0x18 and returns 1; for 5 returns 1; otherwise 0. The startup data block after the Borland copyright at 0046c000 stores it at 0046c048, after the _INIT_/_EXIT_ table bounds (0046c02c-0046c038) and Shell_WinMain (0046c044), beside maybe_Rtl_MathErrL (0046c04c). The offsets and codes fit Borland's struct _exception (UNDERFLOW 4, TLOSS 5) and the RTL's default _matherr. Identical after normalisation to DBSIM's maybe_Rtl_MathErr (0049644c).

entries.name: maybe_Rtl_MathErrL
entries.description: (e): for e+0 == 4 zeroes the 10 bytes at +0x1c..+0x25 and returns 1; for 5 returns 1; otherwise 0. Stored at 0046c04c beside maybe_Rtl_MathErr: Borland's struct _exceptionl with a long double retval at +0x1c, the RTL's default _matherrl. Identical after normalisation to DBSIM's maybe_Rtl_MathErrL (00496478).

entries.name: Rtl_VectorDelete
entries.description: Borland RTL _vector_delete_ (named by its own error string 'Illegal mode in _vector_delete_' at 00480f50): (array, elemSize, count, mode, dtor). Takes the count from array[-1] when mode & 0x10, runs dtor(elem, 2) on each element from last to first under the mode & 7 calling convention, then frees the block with Mem_DeleteArray when mode & 8 and returns 0; otherwise returns the block start.

entries.name: Rtl_VectorNew
entries.description: Borland RTL _vector_new_ (named by its own error string 'Illegal mode in _vector_new_' at 00480f70): (mem, elemSize, count, mode, ctor). Allocates count*elemSize bytes with Mem_NewArray when mem is null, plus 4 when mode & 0x10, in which case the count is stored in that first dword. Runs ctor on each element in turn with the calling convention mode & 7 selects (1 and 5 push this, 2 pushes it callee-cleaned, 3 passes it in EAX). Returns the first element (past the count), or 0 when the allocation fails.

entries.name: Rtl_PureError
entries.description: The Borland RTL's pure-virtual-call handler: __ErrorExit("Pure virtual function called") (00480f90). Every pure slot of an abstract class's vtable points here: ClassItem's five, EventProducer's two, EventConsumer's, WinButton's +4, WinCursor's, WinDisplay's eight and Map's slot 0. DBSIM's copy is at 00496684.
entries.source: VSHELL disassembly at 0046b624; es2_naming.py vtables VSHELL

entries.name: Shell_QuitFlag
entries.description: Nonzero ends the shell's main loop in Shell_Main. The main menu's QUIT, VIEW DEMO and INSTANT ACTION set it, and so does launching a mission; Shell_RunFrames stops early on it.

entries.name: Shell_PresentEnabled
entries.description: Dword, 0 in the image. While it is 0, Display_RealizePalette does nothing and MainWndProc's WM_PAINT does not present the shell's bitmap (Display_PresentWhole), so a movie's window and palette are left alone. Shell_BuildScreensAndStart sets it once the intro is done (or at once on -X3, -X4 and -X6), Shell_Main sets it for -X3 and -X4 straight after the command-line parse, and MainMenu_OnCredits clears it round the credits movie.

entries.name: Shell_EggplantGiven
entries.description: Dword, 0 in the image; Shell_ParseCommandLine sets it for '-eggplant'. Shell_Main refuses to run while it is 0: 'You cannot run this exe directly', then the exit steps and PostQuitMessage.

entries.name: Shell_PerformanceNotePending
entries.description: Dword, 0 in the image. Shell_Main sets it when ShellOption_SkipSierraIni is clear and Sierra.ini's [Config] VideoSpeed reads below 1000; StartupAnim_OnTick then puts up the 'Performance Note' message box as the main menu comes up.

entries.name: Shell_MainLoopStarted
entries.description: Dword, 0 in the image. Shell_Main's main loop stores 1 in it every pass, straight after Movie_PlayQueue(1); es2_xref.py finds no other store among its ten references. All nine tab-strip handlers return at once while it is 0 -- before even the already-on-this-tab check -- so a tab press delivered before the loop's first pass reaches that point does nothing.

entries.name: Shell_PoolSize
entries.description: Dword 4,000,000 (0x3d0900) in the image: the size of the buffer Shell_Main allocates with Mem_NewArray and hands to Memory_Init as g_ShellPool's arena. Its two references are those two reads.

entries.name: Shell_HasFocus
entries.description: Dword, 1 in the image. MainWndProc clears it on WM_KILLFOCUS (and stops the sound) and sets it on WM_SETFOCUS. While it is 0, Shell_Main's main loop skips the whole of each pass but the message pump, counting Shell_UnfocusedPassCount; Shell_RunFrames' passes do nothing; and Movie_PlayQueue, after each movie, pumps messages until it is set again.

entries.name: Shell_CloseAllowed
entries.description: Set before the main loop and by the startup widget's hide, cleared by its show. WM_CLOSE and the display hotkeys are ignored while it is clear.

entries.name: Shell_UnfocusedPassCount
entries.description: Main-loop passes skipped while Shell_HasFocus is clear, printed to the mono debug monitor as 'hmm: %d' at column 0x3c, row 0. Shell_Main's two references are its only ones.

entries.name: QuitAlert_RepaintCounter
entries.description: Main-loop passes since QuitAlert (Alt+F4's QUIT alert) was last repainted: while the alert is shown (+0x11 bit 2 clear) each pass counts it, and above 50 it is zeroed and the alert repainted with Window_RepaintRecursive. Shell_Main's three references are its only ones.

entries.name: Str_SierraIniDefault
entries.description: The empty string: the default Shell_Main passes GetPrivateProfileStringA for Sierra.ini's [Config] VideoSpeed, so a missing key reads as atol('') = 0.
entries.source: VSHELL image at 0046c49d; Shell_Main disassembly at 004016ba

entries.name: Str_VolExtension
entries.description: '.vol', the extension Shell_Main hands VolRStream_SetGroup for the volume scan.

entries.name: Str_FormatString
entries.description: '%s', the sprintf format Shell_Main copies the disc-check path through.

entries.name: Str_DiscCheckMovie
entries.description: 'avi\\pt1.avi', the movie Shell_Main opens under the drive.cfg directory (Path_UnderDriveCfg) to tell that the disc is there; failing, 'Please insert ESII CD and restart'.

entries.name: g_VolumeGroup
entries.description: Pointer to the shell's VolumeGroup (volume pointers from +0, count byte at +0x78). VolRStream's constructors assert it is set; VolRStream_Open searches it with VolumeGroup_FindEntry.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_BufferSize
entries.description: The BuffRStream buffer size VolumeGroup_AddVolume hands Volume_LoadVolume for each volume file it opens. VolumeGroup_Ctor stores 0x400 and VolumeGroup_SetBufferSize stores its clamped argument.

entries.name: ClassItem_ProbeBucketCount
entries.description: Number of buckets in ClassItem_ProbeBuckets (004812e8). ClassItem_RegisterProbeBucket increments it; ClassItem_PeekTypeTag and VshellClassItem_ReadTypeTag try the probe loaders for an unregistered tag when it is non-zero.

entries.name: ClassItem_ProbeHeaderSize
entries.description: Header length, tag included, that ClassItem_PeekTypeTag and VshellClassItem_ReadTypeTag read before trying the probe loaders: the tag goes to ClassItem_ProbeHeader (00481338) and this value less 8 more bytes (0 when it is 8 or less) to 00481340. ClassItem_RegisterProbeBucket raises it.

entries.name: ArenaStack_Depth
entries.description: Depth of the arena stack: ArenaStack_Push and ArenaStack_PushAlloc increment it (asserting it stays below 5), ArenaStack_Pop decrements it; ArenaStack_Current points at entry depth of ArenaStack_Entries.

entries.name: Key_VkTable
entries.description: MainWndProc's 0x54 dword table of virtual-key codes: a key's position in it is its set-1 scancode, the key code VSHELL's keyboard works in. Punctuation VKs are absent, so those keys send nothing.

entries.name: Mouse_ScaleX
entries.description: Q16 factor (header int16 +2 << 16) / client width, set by Mouse_RecomputeScale; 0 until it first runs, which is what makes Mouse_DispatchEvent run it. DBSIM's 004a2de4 is the 16.15 equivalent.

entries.name: Mouse_ScaleY
entries.description: Q16 factor (header int16 +0 << 16) / client height, Mouse_ScaleX's twin. DBSIM's 004a2de8 is the 16.15 equivalent.

entries.name: EsTextBinHandle
entries.description: bin\estext.bin, 342 entries; every shell caption and label is fetched through WeaponsBin_LookupName with this handle. Dump at tools/analysis_out/ESTEXT_STRINGS.txt.

entries.name: ShellFont2HandleA
entries.description: The first of the two copies of dfn\\font2.dfn EsGlobal_Init loads; ShellFont2HandleB is the second. The save screen gives its buttons this one.

entries.name: ShellFont2HandleB
entries.description: The second of the two copies of dfn\\font2.dfn EsGlobal_Init loads. The save screen gives its title, slot rows and readouts this one.

entries.name: ShellButtonFontHandle
entries.description: dfn\black.dfn, the font every tab caption is drawn in.

entries.name: CurrentPaletteHandle
entries.description: The palette object Shell_InstallPalette last loaded.

entries.name: ShellBackdropBitmap
entries.description: dbm\bay2a_84.dbm. Written exactly once, by esglobal.cpp's init, and all eight screen builders texture their root widget with this one handle -- so the shell has a single backdrop and the screens that install arming.dpl cover it rather than replacing it.

entries.name: maybe_PaletteDirtyFlag
entries.description: Set by Shell_InstallPalette, tested and cleared by Shell_CommitPalette. Only those two touch it.

entries.name: PaletteNameTable
entries.description: 20 char* to dpl\*.dpl, indexed by Shell_InstallPalette. 0 intr_pt1, 1 palette, 2 arming, 3 cam_er, 4 cam_moon, 5-9 br_w1..br_w5, 10-14 db_w1..db_w5, 15-19 alph/delt/omic/brav/luna. Read out of the data segment; the three per-stage runs are what show the campaign stage counts from 1 at runtime.

entries.name: Key_CommandFilter
entries.description: The key codes that are commands rather than characters: Esc, Backspace, Tab, Enter, the editing cluster and the arrows, and their releases (| 0x80).

entries.name: Key_CommandTable
entries.description: Command code by key code; 0xff sends none. Backspace 1, left arrow 4, Enter 0x0a on the press.

entries.name: Key_CharTable
entries.description: Character by scancode, unshifted; letters are upper case.

entries.name: Key_CharTableShifted
entries.description: Character by scancode with Shift down; differs from Key_CharTable only on the digit row and the punctuation.

entries.name: Input_EventTime
entries.description: DWORD GetTickCount stamp. Shell_Main, Mouse_QueueRecord, Keyboard_PostEvents and 00408f3e set it as they handle input, and Mouse_QueueRecord copies it into each queued record. Input_SetEventTime stores it directly.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0040dd72 and its writers

entries.name: HercTypeIdTable
entries.description: Nine int16 searched by Herc_TypeToIndex to map a chassis type to its catalog index. Retail contents are 0-8 in order.

entries.name: HercCapacityTable
entries.description: Hardpoint capacity per chassis index: 3, 5, 5, 8, 9, 9, 10, 4, 7. Diverges from herc_inf.dat +0x06 for the Raptor II, where this table wins.

entries.name: WeaponClassTable
entries.description: Thirty int16 searched by Weapon_ClassIndexForId: weapon catalog ids 0-18 then 22-32, omitting the three Bull weapons.

entries.name: HercComponentGroupTable
entries.description: Six groups of up to three int16, each -1 terminated, partitioning the 13 external component indices exactly once: {0,1} {2,4} {3,5} {6} {7,9,11} {8,10,12}. The granularity the repair bay and scrap valuation price externals at.

entries.name: ArmoryQueueFreeSlots
entries.description: Free weapon-build workspace slots, 0-5. Printed as "Workspace Available:", and 5 minus it as "Workspace In Use:". Save block 2 opens with this value.

entries.name: ArmoryQueueSlots
entries.description: Five int16, one weapon catalog id per build-queue slot, 0 for empty. The rest of save block 2.

entries.name: WeaponGrant_UnitIds
entries.description: 22 int16 weapon ids, one per campaign-flag slot 0x15-0x2a, the weapon Armory_GrantCampaignWeapons adds flag[s] units of. Its loop runs to slot 0x31, reading seven more words past the table that are not weapon ids.

entries.name: WeaponGrant_UnlockValues
entries.description: 33 int16, one per weapon id: the campaign-flag value that unlocks the weapon. Read only where WeaponGrant_UnlockSlots is not -1.

entries.name: WeaponGrant_UnlockSlots
entries.description: 33 int16, one per weapon id: the campaign-flag slot whose value unlocks the weapon, -1 for none. Eight are set: ATC75 0x34, ATC100 0x35, L400 0x32, L500 0x33, TARG 0x39, SHLD 0x38, TURB 0x3a, ENRG 0x3b.

entries.name: CareerDat_StageCount
entries.description: int16: the stage count LoadCareerDat reads first from gam\career.dat; the length of CareerDat_Stages.

entries.name: CareerDat_Stages
entries.description: Pointer to LoadCareerDat's Rtl_VectorNew array of CareerDat_StageCount 8-byte stage records (CareerStage_ElementCtor): campaign index int16 +0, mission count int16 +2, mission-name pointer array +4, filled by CareerDat_ReadStage.

entries.name: CampaignStage
entries.description: The player's campaign stage, first half of the career position pair. Counts from 1 at runtime where the save stores it from 0: the briefing, debrief and theater palette runs are all reached as stage plus a constant, and the campaign map's Earth-to-Moon switch and the location-art table's fourth entry both fall at stage 5.

entries.name: CampaignMissionInStage
entries.description: Mission within the stage, second half of the career position pair. Zero is what makes the mission tab open on the campaign map rather than a briefing.

entries.name: RepairTargetTable
entries.description: Six int16 repair targets by level: 100, 89, 79, 59, 29, 0.

entries.name: RepairLevelTable
entries.description: Six int16 condition-band floors by repair level: 90, 80, 60, 30, 1, 0.

entries.name: EventBase_ClassItems
entries.description: EventBase's class-item bucket: one 12-byte entry {tag 0x500000, load function EventBase_Construct, name 'EventBase' at 00470d50}, with its count, 1, at 00470d4c. EventHandler_Ctor registers it with ClassItem_RegisterBucket.

entries.name: Avi_StopRequested
entries.description: Avi_Play's loop condition: cleared before playback, and the movie ends when a mouse button down in the window procedure, or Esc or Space, sets it.

entries.name: Avi_Playing
entries.description: 1 while Avi_Play has a movie on screen, 0 otherwise; Avi_Play is its only writer. WinButton_HandleEvent and ESButtonBitmap_HandleEvent ignore mouse events while it is set, and the window procedure drops button messages (after a press has ended the movie) and the options hotkeys.

entries.name: MovieQueue_WriteIndex
entries.description: Movie_Enqueue's slot in MovieQueue_Entries, modulo 10.

entries.name: MovieQueue_ReadIndex
entries.description: Movie_PlayQueue's slot in MovieQueue_Entries, modulo 10.

entries.name: MovieQueue_Running
entries.description: 1 from the start of a Movie_PlayQueue run until the next call finds the ring empty; Movie_PlayQueue is its only writer. WinButton_HandleEvent and ESButtonBitmap_HandleEvent ignore mouse events while it is set.

entries.name: Movie_FileTable
entries.description: 86 char* avi\ paths indexed by movie id, unchecked: pt1-hc4 for 0-0x43, then intr_pt1, intr_pt2, c1-c5, alph_th, delt_th, omic_th, brav_th, luna, transm3, end1a, death, victory, credits, dropship for 0x44-0x55.

entries.name: MovieQueue_EmptyRect
entries.description: Four int32s (00470fcc-00470fd8), 0 in the image and set to 0 again by Avi_StaticInit: the rect MovieQueueEntry_ElementCtor gives each new MovieQueue_Entries entry and Movie_PlayQueue copies back into an entry it frees.
entries.source: VSHELL disassembly at 0041e224 and 0041eac4; Movie_PlayQueue decompile

entries.name: MovieQueue_IntroSkipped
entries.description: Set by a mouse button down (MainWndProc) or Esc/Space (Avi_Play) while MovieQueue_PlayingIntro is set; Movie_PlayQueue then skips any further intro part. No store clearing it found (three stores, each 1).

entries.name: MovieQueue_PlayingIntro
entries.description: Set by Movie_PlayQueue for the entry being played when it is 0x44 or 0x45 (the intro), cleared for any other.

entries.name: maybe_g_DepthBufferEnabled
entries.description: The VSHELL counterpart of DBSIM's maybe_g_DepthBufferEnabled (0049f270). When non-zero, both textured rasterizers run Raster_DepthTestSpan per row and, when the clip-span table DAT_0047e92c is set, draw its runs through the ...Clipped spans (TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA also stores the view depth in vertex +8 and adds edge flag 8, which TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB always does), and CellWalk_Polygon walks near to far. 0 in the image; every absolute-address operand found is a read.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA/B and CellWalk_Polygon; docs/retail/polygon-fill.md

entries.name: g_PerspectiveUseQuadraticFit
entries.description: VSHELL's counterpart of DBSIM's g_PerspectiveUseQuadraticFit (0049f278): when non-zero, TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB takes each row's starting u and v, and its last partial run's end, from Raster_BuildEdgeTables' quadratic fit instead of dividing. The hgrid cell callback 00429dac sets it per cell to (DAT_0047223c < the value it passes 00420279).
entries.source: VSHELL disassembly: writer 0042a9df in 00429dac, readers 00420f3b and 004211b1 in TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB

entries.name: g_TexturedPolyUseBitmapBrush
entries.description: Selects how TSTexture4Poly_Render fills a textured poly; both ways sample the frame. 0: the frame descriptor at g_ActiveBitmapArray[1] gives the UV corners, and the 3D positions go to TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA or B (g_TexturedPolyPerspective). Non-zero: the frame's bitmap comes from the DBA's pointer list (+8), and a type-7 bitmap brush {7, count, uvs, bitmap, remap row} is installed at the context's +0x22c with the UVs the bitmap's extent inset by 3 on each side and the remap row ((DAT_0047e9ac - 1) * shade & ~0xff) + DAT_0047e9a8 (0 while DAT_0047e9ac is 0); the vertices are projected (Poly_ProjectShapeVertices), near-plane clipped with the UVs when needed (Poly_ClipRingToNearPlaneWithUV) and filled through PolyFill_FillThenOutline, and the default brush PolyFill_FillBrush is restored after. The runtime condition that sets this flag is not determined.

entries.name: g_ShadeMode
entries.description: Shading mode, 0-2. At 2 Terrain_FillCellUntextured fills with per-vertex shades (Poly_ClipRingToNearPlaneWithShade, a mode-1 brush) and TSTexture4Poly_Render takes its mode-2 path; it is also the span mode TSTexture4Poly_Render hands the rasterizer. ShellMap_PaintRelief sets 2 around its paint and restores it; the cell drawer 00429dac branches on 1 and 2. DBSIM's counterpart is 004aab30.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile: the 20 references es2_naming.py callers lists

entries.name: g_TexturedPolyPerspective
entries.description: Selects TSTexture4Poly_Render's textured fill: 0 TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA (u and v linear in screen space), non-zero TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB (perspective-correct). The VSHELL counterpart of DBSIM's g_TexturedPolyPerspective (0049f274).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of TSTexture4Poly_Render; disassembly read at 00422fbf

entries.name: Map_CameraOrientation
entries.description: Three int16s, {0xc000, 0, 0} after Map_StaticInit: the orientation Map_Ctor passes TSCamera_Ctor for the map's 3Space camera.

entries.name: g_RasterVisibilityRange
entries.description: int32, 100000 in the image: the far limit Raster_SetDepthFadeFromDistance clamps a depth to and measures against. Raster_SetVisibilityRange (0042026c) writes it; Terrain_DrawCellRowRun passes that function grid+0x108 << cellShift per cell. The VSHELL counterpart of DBSIM's DAT_004a08c4.

entries.name: g_RasterDepthFadeOffset
entries.description: int32: the depth-slice offset Raster_SetDepthFadeFromDistance writes and the textured fills (TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA, TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB, TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeEdgePerspective) add to each ramp row before the << 8. 0 in the image. The VSHELL counterpart of DBSIM's DAT_004a08c8.

entries.name: g_TSDetailPartSizeScaleQ10
entries.description: Q10 factor TSDetailPart_Render scales a part's projected size by before comparing it with the part's thresholds; 1024 in the image. Written by TSDetailPart_SetSizeScale. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's g_TSDetailPartSizeScaleQ10 (004a1034).

entries.name: g_TSDetailPartBias
entries.description: The level index TSDetailPart_Render starts its walk from and subtracts again when indexing the parts; 0 in the image. Written by TSDetailPart_SetBias. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's g_TSDetailPartBias (004a1038).

entries.name: ShellMap_DfnPanelPtr
entries.description: Global holding the loaded MAP.DFN panel object. Exhaustive address-xref search found only 2 referencing functions in all of VSHELL.EXE -- ShellMap_EnsureResourcesLoaded (the loader) and ShellMap_ReleaseResources (destructor call only). The parsed contents are never read back anywhere in VSHELL -- this specific load is dead/vestigial (the format's real, live consumer is DBSIM's cockpit font system, see ColorSchemePanels_LoadAll).

entries.name: Music_MciDeviceId
entries.description: MCI device id of the open cdaudio device, or -1 when closed. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Music_MciDeviceId.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: Sos_MasterVolume
entries.description: Master volume, 0-100 (100 in the image), multiplied into every digital voice's volume by Sos_ApplyVolume and the voice start at 0042d96f. Sos_SetMasterVolume writes it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Sos_MasterVolume.

entries.name: Sos_LastError
entries.description: The last SOS result the backend stored: the driver open (Sos_OpenDrivers) and Sos_ShutdownDrivers write their SOS calls' results here. Read by Sos_GetLastError. The VSHELL counterpart of DBSIM's Sos_LastError.

entries.name: Sos_DigiDriverOpen
entries.description: int16: set to 1 when Sos_OpenDrivers has opened the digital driver, 0 when Sos_InitDriver fails; Sos_OpenDrivers skips the digital bring-up while it is set. DBSIM's is 004a0e6c.

entries.name: Sos_MidiDriverOpen
entries.description: int16: set to 1 when Sos_OpenDrivers has opened the MIDI driver, 0 when Sos_MidiInitDriver fails; Sos_OpenDrivers skips the MIDI detection and bring-up while it is set. DBSIM's is 004a0e6e.

entries.name: ShellSound_Manager
entries.description: The shell's SFX manager (0x4c bytes), or null under -s.

entries.name: ShellSound_MusicVolume
entries.description: The music's volume, 0-100; 0 in the image and written only by the two fades.

entries.name: ShellSound_Running
entries.description: 1 between ShellSound_Start and ShellSound_Stop; the click sounds play only while it is set.

entries.name: InstantAction_Active
entries.description: Set by INSTANT ACTION's handler; MsnGen_BuildPlayerHerc gives the player the mission's own machine while it is set.

entries.name: InsertCdPanel_Continue
entries.description: Dword flag: InsertCdPanel_OnContinue sets it to 1; Movie_PlayQueue's insert-CD wait runs Shell_RunFrames until it or Shell_QuitFlag is set, then clears it and retries the movie.

entries.name: RepairSelectedColumn
entries.description: Column of the repair screen's current selection: 0 the chassis picture, 1 the internal list.

entries.name: RepairSelectedCategory
entries.description: The selection's condition-array category, as Repair_HotspotCategory returns it.

entries.name: RepairSelectedRow
entries.description: Row of the repair screen's current selection.

entries.name: RepairSelectedIndex
entries.description: The selection's index within its category, as Repair_HotspotIndex returns it. With RepairSelectedCategory this is a HercStatus_Get argument pair.

entries.name: maybe_SaveScreen_EditMode
entries.description: The slot rename's state: 0 idle, 2 while a rename is live (SaveScreen_SelectSlot refuses to move the selection), 1 only transiently inside the SAVE handler before SaveScreen_BeginRename sets 2. ACCEPT and CANCEL write 0.

entries.name: SaveScreen_SelectedSlot
entries.description: Which save slot the list has selected. Parked at 10 on leaving the screen, which is past every row, so both SAVE and RESTORE test it against 10 before anything else.

entries.name: SaveScreen_RowCharSet
entries.description: The save screen rows' permitted-character set: ^, the digits, both alphabets and the space.

entries.name: CurrentTabIndex
entries.description: Which tab screen is up, 0-7, or 0xffff after a strip refresh. Every tab handler returns early when it already holds its own index, so clicking the tab you are on is a no-op.

entries.name: RegistrationSkillChoice
entries.description: The skill (and so the campaign difficulty) the registration screen is showing, 0-3. Stepped modulo 4 by SaveRegistration_StepSkill and Registration_StepSkill, printed as estext.bin 0x35 + value, and passed to Game_NewCareer as the new player pilot's +0x25.

entries.name: ArmingSelectedHardpoint
entries.description: Which hardpoint the arming screen has selected.

entries.name: Squad_RosterClickFlag
entries.description: Set by the eight roster-row thunks around their Squad_SelectBay call; while set, the crew arm also assigns the bay to the selected row's pilot.

entries.name: DamageLevelBands
entries.description: Five int16, {89, 79, 59, 29, 0}, walked by Repair_DamageLevel with a strictly-greater test. Partitions identically to Repair_LevelForCondition's {90, 80, 60, 30, 1, 0} tested with <=.

entries.name: DamageLevelColors
entries.description: Six int16 palette entries, {14, 13, 12, 11, 10, 39}, indexed by damage level. Six colours against only four damage words in estext.bin, which is the retail overrun recorded in KNOWN_ISSUES.md.

entries.name: Arming_RowWeapons
entries.description: The 27 weapon ids the WEAPONS screen's inventory rows list: arm_weap.dat's 26 in file order, then None (0).

entries.name: Arming_GuidanceButtonsUp
entries.description: Whether the five guidance buttons are shown.

entries.name: Arming_FitArmed
entries.description: Set by each inventory row's thunk for the length of its Arming_SelectRow call; Arming_FitSelected fits only while it is set.

entries.name: Arming_LitRow
entries.description: The WEAPONS screen's lit inventory row, -1 in the image.

entries.name: Arming_ShownGuidance
entries.description: The guidance kind whose picture Arming_ShowGuidance last put up, -1 in the image; reset only by a row whose weapon takes no guidance.

entries.name: Arming_LitGuidance
entries.description: The guidance kind whose button Arming_ShowGuidance last lit, 0 in the image.

entries.name: CrewSelectedRow
entries.description: The crew screen's selected row, 0-3 (int16). The same 4-byte stride continues at 004776e0 as the row pilot pointers for rows 1-3.

entries.name: MissionLocationDbaTable
entries.description: Four char* -- dba\alph2.dba, dba\delt1.dba, dba\omic1.dba, dba\brav1.dba -- indexed by campaign stage minus one. Stage 5 branches to the lunar cutscene before the lookup, which is one of the three facts showing the stage counts from 1.

entries.name: Armory_LitRow
entries.description: The armory's lit row, 0-25, or -1 (0xffff in the image). Written by Armory_ClickRow and Armory_RightClickRow, reset by Armory_Leave.

entries.name: PracticeScreen_SelectedRow
entries.description: int16, the lit practice row; -1 in the image. Also the stage-0 mission a training career starts on (Career_SeedPosition); MsnGen_BuildPlayerHerc uses the mission's own machine while it is below 4.

entries.name: PracticeScreen_RowChassis
entries.description: int16 per practice row, read as the low byte at row*2: 0,0,1,8,4,2,7,3 for rows 0-7, then 5,7,3 for INSTANT ACTION's rows 8-10. Written into prefs option 0x28 by PracticeScreen_SelectRow.

entries.name: GLFont_Vtable
entries.description: GLFont's 7-slot vtable (RTTI 'GLFont', 0x32 bytes, base GLBase): GLFont_GetClassTag, GLFont_GetStreamSize, GLFont_GetMemorySize, GLFont_ReadFromStream, GLFont_WriteToStream, VshellClassItem_DebugPrintType, GLFont_Dtor. The class-item interface only: the font's drawing is Font_DrawString and Font_DrawGlyph, which read the fields directly.

entries.name: Raster_ClipBlock
entries.description: Pointer to the installed clip block: mode at +0x204 (2 = clip to the region list), region count at +0, region pointers from +4. Driver3_BlitClippedRegion, Driver3_SpanCopyRegion and Driver3_SpanFillRegion read it.

entries.name: Raster_RowTable
entries.description: Pointer to the draw surface's row table: the surface base at +0 and one row offset per row from +4, so row y starts at [+0] + [+4 + 4y]. Raster driver 3's span, pixel, line and rect routines address the screen through it.

entries.name: Raster_Stride
entries.description: The draw surface's row stride in bytes: Driver3_FillSpans, Driver3_FillRect and Driver3_DrawLine step rows by it, and Driver3_GrabClipped bounds x by it when clipRect is null.

entries.name: Raster_Height
entries.description: The draw surface's row count: Driver3_GrabClipped bounds y by it when clipRect is null.

entries.name: g_RasterColourRamps
entries.description: Table of 8-byte records {int16 *entries at +0, int16 length at +4}, indexed by ramp number; Raster_SetColourRamps writes a run of them. The fill routines read entry ((shade * length) >> 7) & ~1 bytes into a ramp's entry list. The VSHELL counterpart of DBSIM's g_RasterColourRamps (004a4fbd).
entries.source: VSHELL disassembly at 00457a48; decompile readers of 0047dd39/0047dd3d

entries.name: g_RasterRoutines
entries.description: The installed raster routine table: RasterDriver_InstallRoutines copies the selected driver's 0047e5d0 (36) dwords here; slot n is at 0047e540 + 4n, called by the Gfx_ and Raster_ wrappers. The VSHELL counterpart of DBSIM's g_RasterRoutines (004a57c4).
entries.source: RasterDriver_InstallRoutines known_symbols entry; es2_xref of the slot addresses

entries.name: g_RasterRoutines_Driver3
entries.description: Raster driver 3's 36-entry routine table, the one RasterDriver_FindRoutineTable's {id, table} list at 0047e5d4 gives for id 3. Slots: 0 Driver3_FillSpans, 1 Driver3_RemapSpans, 2 Driver3_FillRect, 3 Driver3_RemapRect (0045a944), 4 Raster_GetPixel, 5 Raster_PutPixel, 6 Driver3_RemapPixel, 7 Driver3_Slot7NoOp, 8 Driver3_Slot8ReturnsZero, 9 Driver3_Slot9ReturnZero, 10 Driver3_Slot10ReturnZero, 11 Driver3_OpenDisplay, 12 Driver3_CloseDisplay, 13 Driver3_LoadPalette, 14 Driver3_ReadPalette, 15 Driver3_SetOrigin, 16-18 Driver3_Slot16NoOp..Driver3_Slot18NoOp, 19 Driver3_CopySpans, 20 Driver3_CopyRect (0045a99f), 21 Driver3_SpanRead, 22 Driver3_SpanCopy, 23 Driver3_SpanCopyRegion, 24 Driver3_SpanFill, 25 Driver3_SpanFillRegion, 26 Driver3_BlitClipped, 27 Driver3_GrabClipped, 28 Driver3_BlitClippedRegion, 29 Driver3_BlitScaled (0045b180), 30 Driver3_Slot30NoOp, 31 Driver3_Slot31NoOp, 32 Driver3_Slot32NoOp, 33 Raster_FillBitmapPolygon, 34 Driver3_DrawLine, 35 Driver3_ClearSurface (0045aada). The VSHELL counterpart of DBSIM's g_RasterRoutines_Driver3 (004a5884).

entries.name: g_DepthBufferFrameTag
entries.description: Byte tag DepthBuffer_ClearWrappedRows and DepthBuffer_ClearWrappedRowSpans decrement after resetting the rows r with (r + tag) & 0xff == 0 to 0xffffffff. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's g_DepthBufferFrameTag (004a5b04).

entries.name: g_DepthBufferWidth
entries.description: Width in pixels of g_DepthBuffer, stored by DepthBuffer_Alloc; the row stride of the helpers at DepthBuffer_ClearWrappedRows (0045bab0)-0045bc1c. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's g_DepthBufferWidth (004a5b08).

entries.name: g_DepthBufferHeight
entries.description: Height in rows of g_DepthBuffer, stored by DepthBuffer_Alloc; the row limit of the helpers at DepthBuffer_ClearWrappedRows (0045bab0)-0045bc1c. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's g_DepthBufferHeight (004a5b0c).

entries.name: ShadeRampTable
entries.description: 256-byte-aligned base of the shade-ramp rows, set by ShadeRamp_Allocate (the one write a text search of the disassembly finds, 0045d60b). Raster_SpanTexturedShaded, Raster_SpanTexturedGouraud and the two quadratic spans add (accumulator >> 16) * 0x100 to it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShadeRampTable (004a09b0).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0045d5c8 and disassembly reads of 0047e890

entries.name: AtlasPage_Root
entries.description: Pointer to the first 0x808-byte atlas page, allocated and AtlasPage_Init'ed as page 1 by AtlasPage_StaticInit; BitmapArray_PackToAtlas places every frame starting from it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AtlasPage_Root (004a08cc), which starts at page 0.

entries.name: ShadeRamp_Ready
entries.description: Word flag: ShadeRamp_Allocate sets it to 1 once ShadeRamp_Bitmap's pixels are allocated and skips its work while it is set; ShadeRamp_Free clears it; AtlasPage_LoadFromFile reads its file while it is set and returns 0 while it is clear.

entries.name: g_TSTexture4PolyVtable
entries.description: TSTexture4Poly's vtable (RTTI 'TSTexture4Poly'), the one TSTexture4Poly_Construct stamps last. Slot +0x1c, TSTexture4Poly_Render, is what TSGroup_RenderPolys's per-item dispatch calls for a TSTexture4Poly; a TSBitmapPart draws through its own TSBitmapPart_Render, so the two do not share one render mechanism. See docs/retail/formats/dts-texture-binding.md.

entries.name: g_TSSolidPolyVtable
entries.description: TSSolidPoly's real, fully-constructed vtable (found via TSSolidPoly_Construct's final vtable-pointer stamp). Slot +0x1c (TSSolidPoly_Render, TSSolidPoly_Render) is what TSGroup_RenderPolys's per-poly dispatch (*(*polyPtr)+0x1c) calls for a TSSolidPoly, mirroring TSTexture4Poly's g_TSTexture4PolyVtable +0x1c slot exactly.

entries.name: g_TSObjectTypeRegistry
entries.description: 18-entry, 12-byte-stride table: {tag:uint32 matching a DTS chunk header's on-disk [subtype:u16][supertype:u16] bytes, constructorFnPtr, nameStringPtr}. Every tag matches a known DTS chunk tag (e.g. 0x0014000f = TSTexture4Poly) and sits beside its name string ("TSPoly", "TSGroup", etc.). This is the DTS-tree node factory VSHELL's and DBSIM's shared ThreeSpace engine uses to construct the right C++ class per on-disk chunk tag -- the reliable way to find any TS*/AN* class's real constructor (and from there its real vtable) when RTTI type-name strings have zero code references, as they often do in this binary (also seen for .BND's MECH string). Tag 0x0e is registered here but has no known retail .DTS chunk. See docs/retail/formats/dts-texture-binding.md.

entries.name: Display_Current
entries.description: The display the pointer is on. Display_GetRoot reads its root widget at +5; Display_HopTo replaces it when the pointer crosses into a neighbour.

entries.name: WinBase_ConnectionCount
entries.description: Number of display-adjacency records at WinBase_Connections; WinBase_Connect increments it and Display_FindNeighbour walks that many.
entries.source: VSHELL capstone disassembly at 004683d4; Display_FindNeighbour description

entries.name: Sos_BindRefCount
entries.description: Sos_BindLibrary's refcount; Sos_UnbindLibrary frees the library when it reaches 0. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Sos_BindRefCount.

entries.name: MissionScreenView
entries.description: Which face the mission tab is showing: 0 the campaign map, 1 the briefing, 4 the debrief. Selects that view's palette and its screen content.

entries.name: ShellRandom_MapState
entries.description: A ShellRandom state block (seed table and cursors) the briefing map's height-grid loader draws on: HeightGrid_FromBitmap (at 00428f43) and HeightGrid_Load (at 004294b7) pass it to ShellRandom_Next for their & 0xfff material rolls. Shell_StaticInit resets it with ShellRandom_Reset.

Byte Shell_Main sets to 1 after DriveCfg_Read and the mono clear, before EsGlobal_Init(0). es2_xref.py finds no other reference to it or to 004810d0-004810e3 (positive control: Shell_TopWindow and Shell_Dispatcher hit), so what reads it is open.

entries.name: Shell_TopWindow
entries.description: The shell's top-level window: an ESWindow (0x45 bytes, no handler) Shell_Main builds over the display root's rect, parented to the root, and shows after Shell_BuildScreensAndStart. ServiceBay_BuildScreen builds the frame's root (ShellRootWidget) over its rect as its child, and the palette scope is parented to it too. Shell_Main deletes it on the way out.

entries.name: Shell_RootCursor
entries.description: The first of the two ShellCursor objects Shell_Main builds around GetCursor() (the arrow): given to the display root's +0x35 and installed through the display's Display_SetCursor slot.

entries.name: Shell_HotspotCursor
entries.description: The second ShellCursor Shell_Main builds around GetCursor(); Hotspots_BuildOverlay gives it to every arming hotspot's +0x35.

entries.name: Shell_Display
entries.description: The shell's WinWin95Display (0x65d bytes), which Shell_Main builds and begins painting on the display root (vtable slot 0). The main loop flushes its dirty list (DirtyList_Flush) each pass, as Shell_RunFrames does.

entries.name: Shell_Dispatcher
entries.description: The input dispatcher Dispatcher_RunQueue drains, a static object built by the vshell.cpp static initialiser at 00401e4c (constructor 0041da18) and destroyed by 00401e86. Shell_Main builds the WinConsumer, WinMouseProducer and WinKeyboardProducer with it as their owner, and the main loop and Shell_RunFrames run its queue each pass with masks 0xffff.

entries.name: ArenaStack_Current
entries.description: Pointer to the current 12-byte {base, capacity, used} arena, ArenaStack_Entries (0048137c) + ArenaStack_Depth*12, set by ArenaStack_Push, ArenaStack_PushAlloc and ArenaStack_Pop. The 3Space readers and part constructors pass it to Arena_Alloc / Arena_Alloc2 (78 references in the disassembly).

entries.name: VshellClassItem_RegistryBuckets
entries.description: Base of VSHELL's ClassItem registry bucket array (pairs of {int* entries, int count}, 8 bytes/bucket). Runtime-populated by static initializers -- reads as zero-length in the static image.

entries.name: ClassItem_ProbeBuckets
entries.description: Array of 8-byte {entries, count} buckets of 12-byte {id, loadFn, headerSize} class-item entries: ClassItem_RegisterProbeBucket appends, VshellClassItem_TryEveryLoader walks them. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ClassItem_ProbeBuckets (006c5958).

entries.name: ClassItem_ProbeHeader
entries.description: Buffer holding an unrecognised class item's 8-byte type tag followed by up to ClassItem_ProbeHeaderSize - 8 further header bytes (from 00481340), filled by ClassItem_PeekTypeTag and VshellClassItem_ReadTypeTag and passed by VshellClassItem_TryEveryLoader to each probe loader.

entries.name: ClassItem_CurrentFrame
entries.description: Pointer to the frame of the class item being read ({+0 type tag, +4 start, +8 end, ...}); VshellClassItem_LoadItem points it at its own and restores the previous one, ClassItem_CloseItem reads the end. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ClassItem_CurrentFrame.

entries.name: ArenaStack_Entries
entries.description: The arena stack's 12-byte {base, capacity, used} entries, indexed by ArenaStack_Depth (0046d1fc); ArenaStack_Current points into it.

entries.name: KeyListenerTable
entries.description: Ten 12-byte key-listener slots {enabled, wantedCodes, callback}: KeyListener_Register and KeyListener_RegisterCopy fill the first free one, KeyListener_Unregister and KeyListener_UnregisterCallback clear them, and MainWndProc reads it at 00404e18. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's KeyListenerTable (006bb93c).

entries.name: Shell_MessageCaption
entries.description: 0x20-byte buffer for a message box's caption, string 1000 (LoadStringA): Shell_WinMain fills it for its window-creation failure box, Shell_ConfirmBox for its OK/Cancel box.

entries.name: Shell_MessageText
entries.description: 0x80-byte buffer for a message box's text (LoadStringA): Shell_WinMain loads string 1001 into it, Shell_ConfirmBox its stringId argument.

entries.name: MouseListenerTable
entries.description: Ten 12-byte mouse-listener slots {enabled, eventMask, callback}: MouseListener_Register fills the first free one, MouseListener_Unregister clears one and Mouse_DispatchEvent calls them. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c5f5c.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: MouseDriver_State
entries.description: The mouse driver's {int x, int y, int16 buttons} record in canvas space, written by Mouse_DispatchEvent and returned by MouseDriver_GetState. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c5fd4.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: Mouse_ClientRect
entries.description: RECT the main window's client area is read into by Mouse_RecomputeScale and Mouse_WarpCursorToPoint (right at 0048180a, bottom at 0048180e: the client width and height).

entries.name: DVJoystick_JoyInfo
entries.description: Two 16-byte JOYINFO records {wXpos, wYpos, wZpos, wButtons}, joysticks 0 and 1, filled by DVJoystick_PollButtons and read by DVJoystick_ReadAxes (kind 3 the first, kind 4 the second) and DVJoystick_ReadAxesDigital.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile and disassembly; class from the src32\dv_jy.cpp assert strings at 0046d6b0 and 0046d6f8

entries.name: MainWindow_Handle
entries.description: The shell's HWND, stored by Shell_CreateMainWindow. Shell_Main takes its DC for the 256-colour check. The VSHELL counterpart of DBSIM's MainWindow_Handle (004d3694).

entries.name: Display_FullScreen
entries.description: Dword, nonzero while the shell runs full screen through DirectDraw: Display_ToggleFullScreen sets and clears it, Display_LeaveFullScreen tests it, and Display_PresentRect, Display_RealizePalette, Shell_BlankScreen and the screen builders branch on it.

entries.name: ShellSwitch_M
entries.description: Byte, 1 under '-m' (Shell_ParseCommandLine), 0 from EsGlobal_Init(0). The usage text calls -m 'Disables mouse', but Shell_Main builds the WinMouseProducer regardless; the one reader es2_xref.py finds is the argv builder at 0042f2e8, which nothing found reaches, where it adds '-m' to a DBSIM command line.

entries.name: Shell_KeyboardEnabled
entries.description: Byte, 1 from EsGlobal_Init(0), cleared by '-k'. Shell_Main builds the WinKeyboardProducer only while it is set.

entries.name: Shell_SoundEnabled
entries.description: Cleared by -s (and by -v and -?); gates the sound manager's creation and ESButtonFont_HandleEvent's press sound.

entries.name: Shell_MusicOptionCopy
entries.description: Byte: prefs.cfg option 0 (MUSIC) as EsGlobal_Init(0) copies it. Its one reader is Shell_MonoPrintAudioOptions.

entries.name: Shell_SoundsOptionCopy
entries.description: Byte: prefs.cfg option 1 (SOUNDS) as EsGlobal_Init(0) copies it. Its one reader is Shell_MonoPrintAudioOptions; the click sounds test ShellOption_Sounds itself.

entries.name: Shell_MoviesEnabled
entries.description: Byte, 1 from EsGlobal_Init(0), cleared by '-a'. While it is 0 Movie_Enqueue takes nothing and Movie_PlayQueue plays nothing.

entries.name: Shell_PilotMessageOptionCopy
entries.description: Dword: prefs.cfg option 2 (PILOT MESSAGE: 0 text only, 1 voice only, 2 both) as EsGlobal_Init(0) copies it. Its one reader is Shell_MonoPrintAudioOptions.

entries.name: Shell_Language
entries.description: Dword: the shell's language, 0 English, 1 French, 2 German. EsGlobal_Init(0) copies prefs.cfg option 43 (ShellOption_Language) into it, then Shell_ParseCommandLine's -f and -g store 1 and 2 and any other -e... 3. WeaponsBin_Open prefixes every .BIN it opens with the folder it picks.

entries.name: Shell_StartupCode
entries.description: Int16: the state the shell was started in, the -X<n> code. Shell_Main copies it from Shell_GetExitCode straight after the parse (overwriting the 3 that -r stores) and zeroes the exit code; 3 and 4 set Shell_PresentEnabled at once, 0 and 1 run the 256-colour check, and Shell_BuildScreensAndStart dispatches on 3, 4 and 6.

entries.name: ShellSwitch_L
entries.description: Int16, 1 from EsGlobal_Init(0), cleared by '-l'. Its one reader es2_xref.py finds is the argv builder at 0042f2e8, which nothing found reaches, and which does nothing while it is 0.

entries.name: ShellSwitch_D
entries.description: Int16, 0 from EsGlobal_Init(0), which is its only store es2_xref.py finds. The argv builder at 0042f2e8, which nothing found reaches, appends '-D' when it is non-zero.

entries.name: Shell_MissionPickerEnabled
entries.description: Byte, 0 from EsGlobal_Init(0), set by '-@'. While it is set the developer's mission-name dialog (00412ce1) stays up instead of being dismissed through its Use Default button.

entries.name: DriveCfg_Directory
entries.description: The first token of data\drive.cfg plus a trailing backslash, written by DriveCfg_Read. Shell_Main passes it to VolRStream_SetGroup as the second directory the volume scan searches, and Path_UnderDriveCfg puts it in front of the movie paths, the startup check for avi\pt1.avi and the on-line manual. The VSHELL counterpart of DBSIM's DriveCfg_Directory (004d2890).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of DriveCfg_Read, Shell_Main and Path_UnderDriveCfg; es2_xref.py --binary VSHELL 004822d5

entries.description: Byte EsGlobal_Init(1) sets to 1 straight after seeding the shell generator, whose 0x72-byte state at 00482325 ends just before it. es2_xref.py finds no other reference, so what reads it is open.

entries.name: g_ShellPool
entries.description: The src\mymem.cpp pool behind Mem_New / Mem_NewArray, a 0x14-byte Memory object: The pool object (e.g. 0048239c): +0 base, +4 byte size, +8 free-list head, +0xc free bytes, +0x10 lowest free bytes seen. Every block starts with an 8-byte header: an allocated block holds 'KLBA' (0x41424c4b) at +0 and its size including the header at +4, the caller's data at +8; a free block holds the next free block at +0, its size at +4 and 'KLBF' (0x46424c4b) at +8. Initialised by Memory_Init at 00401576.

entries.name: WinKeyboardProducer_Instance
entries.description: The WinKeyboardProducer, stored by WinKeyboardProducer_Ctor; Keyboard_OnCommandKey queues command keys into it.

entries.name: Path_ConcatBuffer
entries.description: Static buffer Path_Concat builds and returns its result in: the 0x20 bytes before ShellOptions (004824b8).

entries.name: ShellOptions
entries.description: VSHELL's copy of the 54-byte data\prefs.cfg option array -- the same file, layout, shadow and handler-table design DBSIM uses. Options 0x25-0x29 are the practice missions screen's five parameters.

entries.name: ShellOption_Sounds
entries.description: prefs.cfg option 1, SOUNDS: gates the shell's click sounds.

entries.name: ShellOption_PilotMessage
entries.description: prefs.cfg option 2, the simulator's PILOT MESSAGE: 0 text only, 1 voice only, 2 both. Cases 2 and 3 of PreferencesScreen_ToggleAudioOption cycle it.

entries.name: ShellOption_GameResolution
entries.description: prefs.cfg option 4. The PREFERENCES screen row Game Resolution: 0 = High Res (640x480), 1 = Low Res (320x240). DBSIM's VideoMode_Configure freads the same byte out of the file and treats 1 as 320x240 and everything else as hi-res.

entries.name: ShellOption_ShellMusicTrack
entries.description: prefs.cfg option 5. Selects the shell's background music: non-zero loads hmi/shell1.wav, zero hmi/shell2.wav. Read only there; DBSIM never reads it.

entries.name: ShellOption_DisplayMode
entries.description: prefs.cfg option 6. The PREFERENCES screen row Display Mode: 0 = Window, 1 = Full Screen. DBSIM reads the same byte in VideoMode_Configure and writes it back at shutdown when the live state differs.

entries.name: ShellOption_CampaignMode
entries.description: prefs.cfg option 42. Seeds CampaignModeFlag (0048260c) in Shell_InitGameState, so campaign-versus-training survives a restart.

entries.name: ShellOption_Language
entries.description: prefs.cfg option 43. The LANG0.VOL folder: 0 eng, 1 fre, 2 ger. Copied into Shell_Language by the shell's global init and read there by WeaponsBin_Open, which prefixes every .BIN it opens with that folder.

entries.name: ShellOption_RepairMode
entries.description: prefs.cfg option 44. The PREFERENCES screen row Repair Options, three ways -- 0 'AutoRepair All Hercs', 1 'Manually Repair My Herc', 2 'Manually Repair All Hercs' (estext.bin 0x113-0x115). Repair_Enter also prints it as the repair screen's mode readout, but branches only on 0 and 1.

entries.name: ShellOption_WeaponsBuildMode
entries.description: prefs.cfg option 45. The PREFERENCES screen row Weapons Building -- 0 AutoBuild Weapons, 1 Manually Build Weapons (estext.bin 0x111/0x112).

entries.name: ShellOption_MissionHercExtra
entries.description: prefs.cfg option 46. Which of stage 0's three demo missions the next INSTANT ACTION plays: InstantAction_SelectDemo selects practice row option+8 and steps the option mod 3. The row's chassis goes into option 40.

entries.name: ShellOption_SkipSierraIni
entries.description: prefs.cfg option 47. Non-zero skips Shell_Main's startup read of Sierra.ini; Shell_Main sets it after the read and saves, so the read happens on one run. v1.10's shipped DATA\\PREFS.CFG has it 0.

entries.name: ShellOptionsShadow
entries.description: Load-time shadow of ShellOptions; ShellOptions_Commit fires each changed option's handler against it.

entries.name: ShellOptionHandlers
entries.description: Per-option handler table, parallel to ShellOptions.

entries.name: maybe_HasGameInProgress
entries.description: The save screen's SAVE button is enabled only on this and a real row being selected, so it reads as whether there is a game to write out. Nothing that sets it has been traced.

entries.name: CampaignModeFlag
entries.description: 1 for a campaign, 0 for training. Selects which autosave slot 10 resolves to (GAME_R vs GAME_T) and gates salvage awards at debrief.

entries.name: SaveSlotTable
entries.description: 12 save slots, 94-byte (0x5e) stride: filename at +0x00 (13 bytes), display label at +0x0d (80 bytes), in-use byte at +0x5d. Slots 10 and 11 are the RESUME and TRAINING autosaves.

entries.name: MainMenu_CurrentGameInUse
entries.description: Not a global of its own: the in-use byte (+0x5d) of slot 10's entry in the 0x5e-byte slot table at 00482610. MainMenu_Show gates CONTINUE GAME on it.

entries.name: SquadPositionsInPlay
entries.description: The player structure's leading int16: squad positions in play, the player's counted as 0. Bounds the auto-repair (0040e862) and player.mec export (0040f1e4) loops; Squad_UpdateOnStrength puts a member on strength only below it; the crew screen lights the rows below it.

entries.name: PlayerPilotRecord
entries.description: The player's own 59-byte pilot record, same shape as a squadmate's. Its name buffer is at +0x04, which is why the copies in Stats_StageCurrentGame start four bytes into the record.

entries.name: PlayerPilotSkill
entries.description: The player pilot record's +0x25 (record base 00482a7c). Chosen once at registration, never advanced, saved with the career, and copied into script.dat's header as the mission difficulty.

entries.name: Hangar_BayRecords
entries.description: The hangar: eight bay record pointers at +0..+0x1c, the occupied count int16 +0x20, an int16 +0x22 and Hangar_DebriefScrapCount at +0x24. Game_StaticInit builds it with Hangar_Ctor.

entries.name: SelectedBaySlot
entries.description: Which of the eight HERC bay slots is selected, 0-7, or -1 for none. Indexes the bay pointer array at 00482ac3 and the per-slot widget arrays.

entries.name: Hangar_DebriefScrapCount
entries.description: int16 at +0x24 of the hangar at 00482ac3: machines the debrief scrapped. HercsDat_Clear zeroes it at every hangar load, Herc_SettleAfterMission adds one per scrap (INC at 00410d21), and Game_ProcessMissionResults copies it into campaign flag 8 (0040eef6), which the mission's .ENG debrief loss line tests.

entries.name: Debrief_PilotsLost
entries.description: int16: Squad_ProgressAll's count of pilots lost, the player included when at 0 condition, stored at 0040eea9. Game_ProcessMissionResults copies it into campaign flag 9 and hands it to Debrief_WriteReport as the Losses figure.

entries.name: CareerSalvage
entries.description: The career salvage pool, int32 -- the game's single currency, held in kilograms; printed in tons by the crew and Herc Construction screens and in kilograms by the repair detail panel and armory readout. Seeded to rand(0..10)*1000 + 100000, credited from results.dat, debited by repairs and armory purchases. Immediately precedes the campaign flag array in memory and in the save file.

entries.name: maybe_CampaignFlagArray
entries.description: The campaign flag store: 1000 int16 compared against by the .MSN condition/trigger opcode system (switch 0x119-0x11e: ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=). Confirmed campaign-persistent by three independent serializers that each move exactly 2000 bytes of it: the save file writes it after the salvage pool (FUN_0040e37b/FUN_0040e4f2), FUN_0040e9cb writes it to data\mission.var before a mission and FUN_0040ea59 reads it back at debrief, where slot 0 is overwritten with the mission outcome. DBSIM's counterpart is DAT_004a9ef4. The 'maybe_' prefix is stale; rename to CampaignFlagArray on the next Ghidra pass.

entries.name: Squad_Rosters
entries.description: Three squads of twelve 0x3b-byte pilot records (0x2c4 bytes per squad), the name at +4 of each. Squad_TakeMember hands records out of it and Squad_FindPilotByName searches it.

entries.name: HercInfoTable
entries.description: gam\herc_inf.dat in memory: 9 records of 16 bytes. int16 each of chassis type, mass in tons, top speed in kph, hardpoints, price in tons, an unread field, build time in missions, and the availability flag. Stride and the +0x08 price offset confirmed via raw disassembly in Herc_ScrapValue (shl edx,4 then movsx ecx,word [edx+0x00483b5c] at 00413b93), not decompiler pointer math. The flag array is save block 7.

entries.name: WeaponsDat_RecordArray
entries.description: In-memory WEAPONS.DAT record array, 29 bytes/record. Stride confirmed via IMUL EDX,EDX,0x1d in raw disassembly (Armory_ScrapValueTons), not decompiler pointer-math (which mis-implied 116 bytes).

entries.name: WeaponsDat_RankTable
entries.description: One int16 per weapon id, read from weapons.dat after each record into an array parallel to WeaponsDat_RecordArray. Sorts the catalog: ranks 1-28 are a permutation over the ordinary weapons, NONE and the three Bull weapons hold 99, and MFAC holds 0.

entries.name: maybe_WeaponsBinFileHandle
entries.description: weapons.bin's stream/file handle, referenced alongside WeaponsDat_RecordArray in the WEAPONS.DAT loading call chain.

entries.name: Career_MissionStrTable
entries.description: The string table (StringTable_Ctor) Career_BuildBriefingText and Career_BuildDebriefText load data\mission.str into and free again; Career_StaticInit constructs it and Career_StaticDtor destroys it.

entries.name: HercExternalGroupValues
entries.description: Per-chassis unit values for the six external component groups, 9 rows of 33 int16. Expanded at load from damage.dat percentages against herc_inf.dat prices through FixedMulQ10.

entries.name: HercInternalValues
entries.description: Per-chassis unit values for the nine internal components. Column 13 of the same 9x33 int16 table as HercExternalGroupValues.

entries.name: WeaponScrapValues
entries.description: Per-weapon scrap value, 33 int16, expanded from damage.dat. The source column is the weapon's weapons.dat price times 100 for all thirty non-Bull ids, with the Bull trio zeroed.

entries.name: ArmoryLayout_BayPartsA
entries.description: Nine 0x1a-byte records, one per chassis (HercDisp_StaticInit): the first of the two leading records LoadArmoryLayouts reads from each arm_*.dat (int16 +0, 8 bytes +2, 8 bytes +0xa, int16 +0x12, 2 bytes +0x16). Squad_BuildBayPictures sets its +0 part into SquadSlotPictureWidgets.

entries.name: ArmoryLayout_BayPartsB
entries.description: Nine 0x1a-byte records, one per chassis (HercDisp_StaticInit): the second leading record LoadArmoryLayouts reads from each arm_*.dat, same fields as ArmoryLayout_BayPartsA. Squad_BuildBayPictures sets its +0 part into SquadSlotPictureWidgets.

entries.name: RepairLayout_InternalsParts
entries.description: Nine 0x1a-byte records, one per chassis (HercDisp_StaticInit): the record LoadRepairLayouts reads from each rpr_*.dat after its counted body records (int16 +0, 8 bytes +2, int16 +0x12, 2 bytes +0x16). Repair_BuildDiagrams sets its +0 part into RepairInternalsPictures.

entries.name: Avi_PaletteHandle
entries.description: The HPALETTE Avi_Play hands each movie; 0 until Avi_BuildPalette runs, which Movie_PlayQueue's startup call (argument 0) skips. Also stored at 0041deea by maybe_Avi_BuildIndexPalette (0041dea8, a 236-entry palette), for which es2_xref finds no reference.

entries.name: MovieQueue_Entries
entries.description: Ten 0x1c-byte movie entries: int16 id at +0 (0xffff for a free entry), a four-int rect at +2, int16 palette index at +0x12 (0xffff for none), the location-tab flag at +0x14 and a callback at +0x18. Written by Movie_Enqueue, played and freed by Movie_PlayQueue.

entries.name: Raster_ShadeLevels
entries.description: int32, Raster_SetShadeRampDimensions' first argument (DBSIM's shadeLevels); read by the textured-polygon rasterizers and Raster_SetDepthFadeFromDistance (00420279). 0 in the image.

entries.name: Raster_DepthSlices
entries.description: int32, Raster_SetShadeRampDimensions' second argument (DBSIM's depthSlices); Raster_SetDepthFadeFromDistance (00420279) scales its fade by it minus 1. 0 in the image.

entries.name: Raster_ReciprocalTable
entries.description: int32 Q16 reciprocals 0x10000 / n, indexed by n (entries 1-0x289), filled by Raster_SetShadeRampDimensions. Read by TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA, TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB, TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeEdgePerspective (00421292) and Raster_BuildEdgeTables (for an edge height below 0x280; taller edges divide).
entries.source: grep of VSHELL_disasm_full.txt for 0x485788; Raster_BuildEdgeTables disassembly at 0045c9b2

entries.name: Raster_VertexBuffer
entries.description: Ten 0x28-byte vertex records Raster_StaticInit builds and the textured fills (TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA, TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB, TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeEdgePerspective) write per vertex: +0 screen x, +4 screen y, +8 depth, +0xc u, +0x10 v, +0x14 1/z (perspective fills), +0x18 ramp row, +0x1c view-space position. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_VertexBuffer (004d4df8).

entries.name: g_TSTransformStates
entries.description: 52 TSTransformStates of 0x110 bytes, built by TSTransformState_StaticInit and deleted by TSTransformState_StaticDtor; ShapeRender_BindNodeTransforms runs Raster_SaveState on slot 0. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's g_TSTransformStates (006b7bf4).

entries.name: g_ShellMapReliefBitmap
entries.description: The static GLBitmap (0x1a bytes) the briefing map's relief is drawn into: ShellMap_StaticInit constructs it, ShellMap_BuildRelief stores its address at map+0x3c1, ShellMap_PaintRelief stretches it, ShellMap_StaticDtor destroys it.

entries.name: g_TerrainTextureFrames
entries.description: Pointer to the 0x14-byte frame descriptors {x0, y0, x1, y1, atlas page} Terrain_BindTextureBank builds for the terrain bank and Terrain_ResolveCellTexture indexes by a material's frame. 0 in the image.

entries.name: g_TerrainViewerPos
entries.description: int32 {x, y, z} viewer position Terrain_FaceVisibilityTest measures from; 0042b019 shifts its x and y by the grid's cell shift. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's g_TerrainViewerPos.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: HGrid_CellCorners
entries.description: Four Point3Is (HGrid_StaticInit): Terrain_DrawCellRowRun's view-space corners of the current cell, (cx, cy), (cx, cy+1), (cx+1, cy+1), (cx+1, cy), each raised by its HeightOffsetTable_Get offset.

entries.name: HGrid_CellPolyA
entries.description: Four Point3Is (HGrid_StaticInit): the first polygon Terrain_DrawCellRowRun draws for a cell, the whole quad or its first triangle; its UVs are at 0048a36c.

entries.name: HGrid_CellPolyB
entries.description: Three Point3Is (HGrid_StaticInit): the second triangle Terrain_DrawCellRowRun draws for a split cell; its UVs are at 0048a38c.

entries.name: HeightGrid_DrawCellRecord
entries.description: 3-byte static record {cell x, cell y, the cell's +0x17 count after the increment} HeightGrid_PickDrawCell fills and returns. The VSHELL counterpart of DBSIM's 006b50dc.

entries.name: Terrain_CellSurfaceHit
entries.description: int32[3] world point Terrain_CellSurfaceIntersect writes through Math_PlaneSegmentIntersect and returns. The VSHELL counterpart of DBSIM's DAT_006b50e0.

entries.name: HGrid_SpanFirstRow
entries.description: First row HGrid_RowSpans holds a span for; HGrid_BuildCircleSpans starts it at the grid's row count and HGrid_SpanAddCell lowers it.

entries.name: HGrid_SpanLastRow
entries.description: Last row HGrid_RowSpans holds a span for; HGrid_BuildCircleSpans starts it at 0 and HGrid_SpanAddCell raises it.

entries.name: HGrid_RowSpans
entries.description: 256 per-row cell spans, int16 {minX, maxX} each (0x400 bytes), that HGrid_BuildCircleSpans resets to 0xffff and HGrid_SpanAddCell widens.

entries.name: Music_NotifyWindow
entries.description: The window handle Sos_InitBackend was given, used as MCI_PLAY's dwCallback by Music_PlayTrack and Music_ResumeAt. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Music_NotifyWindow.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: Music_TrackLength
entries.description: The MSF length Music_GetTrackLength last returned, the MCI_TO of Music_PlayTrack and Music_ResumeAt. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Music_TrackLength.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: Sos_DriverHandle
entries.description: int16 SOS digital driver handle: Sos_OpenDrivers passes its address to Sos_InitDriver as the out-parameter and hands it to Sos_SetActiveWindow. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Sos_DriverHandle.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: Sos_MidiDriverHandle
entries.description: int16 SOS MIDI driver handle Sos_OpenDrivers gets from Sos_MidiInitDriver and passes to Sos_MidiSetInsData for the two banks.

entries.name: ShellSound_PressSample
entries.description: Sample handle of hmi\gm_69.wav.

entries.name: ShellSound_MusicSample
entries.description: Sample handle of the shell music track.

entries.name: ShellSound_TabClickSample
entries.description: Sample handle of hmi\bptlt2.wav.

entries.name: ShellSound_SwitchSample
entries.description: Sample handle of hmi\lswitch2.wav.

entries.name: SaveSlotSummaryTable
entries.description: Eleven 67-byte (0x43) staging records, one per save slot: a 59-byte pilot record, then int32 salvage in kilograms, int16 campaign stage and int16 mission within the stage. What the save screen's detail panel prints.

entries.name: StartupAnimWidget
entries.description: The startup sequence widget MainMenu_BuildScreen builds over the whole window, frames dbm\bay2a_80 to bay2a_84, the last twice.

entries.name: QuitAlert
entries.description: The Alt+F4 QUIT alert widget QuitAlert_Build creates.

entries.name: InsertCdPanel
entries.description: The insert-CD panel's Window (over the root window's rect), built and hidden by InsertCdPanel_Build, shown by Movie_PlayQueue when a non-intro movie will not open, hidden by InsertCdPanel_OnContinue.

entries.name: InsertCdAlert
entries.description: The insert-CD panel's ESAlert (estext 0x153 'Insert CD into CD Drive'), parent of its Continue (0048d110) and Quit (0048d114) buttons. Built by InsertCdPanel_Build.

entries.name: RepairInternalsPictures
entries.description: Eight Grid widgets, one per bay, the internals damage pictures Repair_BuildScreen builds over {0x10, 0x2f, 0xe0, 0x12f} and Repair_BuildDiagrams fills. Repair_SwapDiagram shows the selected bay's in place of its SquadSlotPictureWidgets entry while the internals list is selected.

entries.name: RepairContentPanel
entries.description: The repair screen's content TitledPanel {0xf1, 0x2b, 0x278, 0x1d9} (estext 0x3d 'REPAIR', handler Repair_OnContentPanelNoOp), built by Repair_BuildScreen; parent of the external list (RepairExternalList (0048d13c)).

entries.name: RepairExternalList
entries.description: The repair screen's external list TitledPanel {4, 0x1a, 0xe5, 0x105} in RepairContentPanel (estext 0x3e 'External', +0x65 = 0, handler Repair_OnExternalListNoOp), built by Repair_BuildScreen.

entries.name: RepairHotspotHandlers
entries.description: Twenty-five thunks in one table, filled by 00431f3c: sixteen for column 0 (the rects over the chassis picture) then nine for column 1 (the internal-component list). Each calls Repair_SelectHotspot with its own (column, row).

entries.name: RepairSnapshotSalvage
entries.description: Repair_Snapshot's copy of CareerSalvage, which Repair_OnCancel writes back.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of Repair_Snapshot and Repair_OnCancel

entries.name: RepairSnapshotStatus
entries.description: 66-byte HERC status block: Repair_Snapshot copies the selected machine's into it (HercList_CopySelectedStatus) when a bay is selected, and Repair_OnCancel copies it back over the selected machine. Repair_StaticInit (00434eab) sets every condition to 100 at startup.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_Root
entries.description: The preferences screen's root image panel, built by PreferencesScreen_Build, shown by PreferencesScreen_Enter and hidden by PreferencesScreen_Hide.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_Panel
entries.description: The preferences screen's content TitledPanel (0x103 PREFERENCES), parent of its five boxes and of Cancel and Accept; built by PreferencesScreen_Build, shown by PreferencesScreen_Enter and hidden by PreferencesScreen_Hide.

entries.name: FullScreenAlert_Window
entries.description: The Window holding the preferences screen's full-screen ESAlert (FullScreenAlert (0048d2e0), estext 0x126 'Alert!'), built and hidden by PreferencesScreen_Build, shown by PreferencesScreen_OnFullScreen while windowed and hidden by FullScreenAlert_OnAccept.

entries.name: FullScreenAlert
entries.description: The full-screen ESAlert {0x68, 199, 0x226, 0x117} (estext 0x126 'Alert!') in FullScreenAlert_Window: the line 0x127 and the ACCEPT button (FullScreenAlert_OnAccept). Built by PreferencesScreen_Build.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_HighResCheck
entries.description: The High Res (640x480) checkbox (an ESRadioButton, handler PreferencesScreen_OnHighRes), stored by PreferencesScreen_Build at 00435cd9.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_LowResCheck
entries.description: The Low Res (320x240) checkbox (an ESRadioButton, handler PreferencesScreen_OnLowRes), stored by PreferencesScreen_Build at 00435d6f.

entries.name: PreferencesScreen_ManualBuildCheck
entries.description: The Manually Build Weapons checkbox (an ESRadioButton, handler PreferencesScreen_OnManualBuild), stored by PreferencesScreen_Build at 0043669f.

entries.name: SaveScreen_ExitTarget
entries.description: Where the EXIT button returns to: 0 rebuilds the main menu, 8 installs palette case 8 and refreshes the tab strip. Tab 1's handler writes 8 before entering.

entries.name: SaveScreen_RowHandlers
entries.description: Ten dwords, 0048d37c-0048d3a0: the save slot rows' click handlers SaveScreen_OnRow0..9, which SaveScreen_BuildScreen writes (004387c9-00438823) and then passes, indexed by row, to each row's constructor.

entries.name: ShellRootWidget
entries.description: The backdrop-textured root every shell screen parents to.

entries.name: PaletteScopeWidget
entries.description: The shell's palette scope, {0, 0x1e, 0x27f, 0x1df} -- the canvas below the tab strip.

entries.name: ShellPanelWidget
entries.description: The full-screen panel at {0, 0, 0x27f, 0x1df}; every widget on the tab strip is its child.

entries.name: TabStripMenuButton
entries.description: The square button at {7, 4, 0x17, 0x1b}, dba\online.dba frames 0 and 1.

entries.name: TabButtonMainMenu
entries.description: Tab 0, caption estext.bin 0x13.

entries.name: TabButtonSave
entries.description: Tab 1, caption estext.bin 0x14.

entries.name: TabButtonWeapons
entries.description: Tab 2, caption estext.bin 0x15.

entries.name: TabButtonRepair
entries.description: Tab 3, caption estext.bin 0x16. Gated off in the training campaign.

entries.name: TabButtonBuild
entries.description: Tab 4, caption estext.bin 0x17. Gated off in the training campaign.

entries.name: TabButtonArmory
entries.description: Tab 5, caption estext.bin 0x18. The builder clears its +0x49 at construction and the strip refresh rewrites it; gated off in the training campaign.

entries.name: TabButtonCrew
entries.description: Tab 6, caption estext.bin 0x19.

entries.name: TabButtonMission
entries.description: Tab 7, caption estext.bin 0x1a.

entries.name: SaveRegistration_CancelButton
entries.description: The second registration panel's CANCEL button (ESButtonFont, string 0x33, handler SaveRegistration_OnCancel, parent 0048d418), stored by SaveRegistration_BuildPanel at 0043b5d4.

entries.name: SquadSlotPictureWidgets
entries.description: Eight widgets, one per bay slot: the chassis picture each screen's hotspot overlay is parented to.

entries.name: Squad_InventoryPanel
entries.description: The Squad Inventory TitledPanel (ESTitle, string 0x64, handler Squad_OnInventoryPanelNoOp), stored by Squad_BuildRosterList at 0043cece, which then clears its +0x65.

entries.name: SquadSlotRowWidgets
