entries.name: g_AssertLogger
entries.description: The shell's assert logger, built by Assert_StaticInit with Assert_Ctor; every Assert_Report call passes it first. +4 is Assert_CheckCount, +8 maybe_Assert_BreakRequested, +0x10 the hook list Assert_AddHook pushes onto. DBSIM's counterpart is 006c574c.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of Assert_StaticInit, Assert_Report and Assert_AddHook

entries.name: Assert_CheckCount
entries.description: g_AssertLogger +4: incremented before every inline assert's test (352 sites), whether or not it fires. Its one reader es2_xref.py finds is the getter at 0044df84, which nothing found calls.

entries.name: maybe_Assert_BreakRequested
entries.description: g_AssertLogger +8. Each main-loop pass reports it as a severity-6 assert when it is non-zero (src\\vshell.cpp line 0x1de) -- Assert_Emit's 'Assert: break (Ctrl-C / Ctrl-Break)' and _exit(1). es2_xref.py finds no store: its three references are Shell_Main's two reads and the getter at 0044df8c. The name comes from severity 6's text.

entries.name: GLBitmap_UseCallerScratch
entries.description: Set by GLBitmap_SetScratchOverride. While non-zero GLBitmap_Decompress returns 0 without unpacking and the GLBitmap draws keep GLBitmap_UnpackScratch after drawing.

entries.name: GLBitmap_UnpackScratch
entries.description: The buffer a compressed GLBitmap is drawn from: GLBitmap_Decompress allocates it (Mem_NewArray) and unpacks into it, or GLBitmap_SetScratchOverride installs a caller's; the draws swap it in for the data pointer +0xe and free it afterwards unless GLBitmap_UseCallerScratch is set.

entries.name: BitmapPoly_CurrentRow
entries.description: The screen row Raster_FillBitmapPolygon is drawing: set to the top vertex's y and incremented per row; Raster_SpanBitmap draws that row and tests it against each mode-2 region. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c6000.

entries.name: BitmapPoly_BottomVertex
entries.description: Index of the bottom vertex of the polygon Raster_FillBitmapPolygon is walking; Raster_BitmapEdgeSetup stops there. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c6004.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: BitmapPoly_VertexCount
entries.description: Vertex count of the polygon Raster_FillBitmapPolygon is walking (its first argument), the wrap for Raster_BitmapEdgeSetup. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c6008.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: BitmapPoly_DestPoints
entries.description: Pointer to the destination polygon's int32 {x, y} points for Raster_FillBitmapPolygon's edge walk. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c600c.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: BitmapPoly_SourcePoints
entries.description: Pointer to the source quad's int32 {u, v} points for Raster_FillBitmapPolygon's edge walk. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c6010.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: RasterRightEdgeTable
entries.description: 0x1e0 rows of 0x28 bytes built by RasterEdgeTables_StaticInit, one per screen line from the polygon's top; Raster_BuildEdgeTables fills it with the right edge. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's RasterRightEdgeTable (006bbe14).

entries.name: RasterLeftEdgeTable
entries.description: 0x1e0 rows of 0x28 bytes built by RasterEdgeTables_StaticInit; Raster_BuildEdgeTables fills it with the left edge. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's RasterLeftEdgeTable (006c0914).

entries.name: EdgeFit_StartUVW
entries.description: int32 triple: Raster_BuildEdgeTables copies an edge's start vertex +0xc/+0x10/+0x14 here for its quadratic fit and divides it into EdgeFit_UV with Point3I_DivideXYByZ. Constructed by RasterEdgeTables_StaticInit.

entries.name: EdgeFit_MidUVW
entries.description: int32 triple: (EdgeFit_StartUVW + EdgeFit_EndUVW) >> 1 (Point3I_Add, Point3I_ShiftRight), divided into EdgeFit_MidUV. Constructed by RasterEdgeTables_StaticInit.

entries.name: EdgeFit_EndUVW
entries.description: int32 triple: the edge's end vertex +0xc/+0x10/+0x14, divided into EdgeFit_EndUV. Constructed by RasterEdgeTables_StaticInit.

entries.name: EdgeFit_UV
entries.description: int32 pair: the start's divided {x/z, y/z}, then the running value Raster_BuildEdgeTables stores into each row's +0x18/+0x1c and advances by EdgeFit_Step per row. Constructed by RasterEdgeTables_StaticInit.

entries.name: EdgeFit_MidUV
entries.description: int32 pair: EdgeFit_MidUVW divided by its z, the fit's middle sample. Constructed by RasterEdgeTables_StaticInit.

entries.name: EdgeFit_EndUV
entries.description: int32 pair: EdgeFit_EndUVW divided by its z, the fit's end sample. Constructed by RasterEdgeTables_StaticInit.

entries.name: EdgeFit_Step
entries.description: int32 pair: the fit's per-row first difference, ((end - start) - 2 * (start + end - 2 * mid)) * invRows plus EdgeFit_StepDelta, added to EdgeFit_UV each row and itself advanced by EdgeFit_StepDelta. Constructed by RasterEdgeTables_StaticInit.

entries.name: EdgeFit_StepDelta
entries.description: int32 pair: the fit's second difference, 2 * (start + end - 2 * mid) * invRows^2, doubled after its first use; added to EdgeFit_Step each row. Constructed by RasterEdgeTables_StaticInit.

entries.name: g_DepthBuffer
entries.description: The depth buffer: g_DepthBufferWidth * g_DepthBufferHeight dwords, allocated and zeroed by DepthBuffer_Alloc (the one write a text search of the disassembly finds). TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA and TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB index its rows for Raster_DepthTestSpan. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's g_DepthBuffer (006c6014).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0045d3f4 and reads at 00420740, 00420daa, 00421739

entries.name: g_BitmapAtlasCache
entries.description: The texture atlas: 256x256-byte pages, page p at +p*0x10000, that Bitmap_PlaceInAtlasPage fills and Raster_SpanTextured reads at page<<16 | v<<8 | u. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's maybe_g_BitmapAtlasCache.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: ShadeRamp_Bitmap
entries.description: A GLBitmap ShadeRamp_StaticInit constructs and ShadeRamp_StaticDtor destroys. ShadeRamp_Allocate fills its header (+4 rows, +6 cols, +8 = 8, +9 |= 0x10, +0xa size) and allocates its width * height pixels at +0xe; ShadeRamp_Free clears that pointer. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's maybe_ShadeRamp_Bitmap (006b4f88).

entries.name: ShadeRamp_Allocation
entries.description: The (rows + 1) * 0x100-byte Mem_NewArray block ShadeRamp_Allocate stores; ShadeRampTable is its next 256-byte boundary. ShadeRamp_Free deletes it.

entries.name: g_ModelToView
entries.description: The current model-to-view transform (0x20 bytes), built by Raster_SetModelTransform and applied by Raster_ModelToView.

entries.name: g_ViewToModel
entries.description: The inverse of g_ModelToView, built by Raster_SetModelTransform.

entries.name: g_EyeInModelSpace
entries.description: The viewpoint in current model space: the origin through g_ViewToModel, set by Raster_SetModelTransform.

entries.name: PolyFill_LineBrush
entries.description: The default line brush TSGroup_RenderPolys and TSBSPGroup_Render install at the render context's +0x228: +0 the brush mode, +4 the colour (PolyFill_LineColour). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c60d0.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile: TSGroup_RenderPolys and TSBSPGroup_Render install it; the +4 colour is what PolyFill_Fill compares

entries.name: PolyFill_LineColour
entries.description: +4 of PolyFill_LineBrush, the current polygon's line colour: PolyFill_Fill and PolyFill_FillThenOutline run an outline pass in it when it differs from PolyFill_FillColour. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c60d4.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: PolyFill_FillBrush
entries.description: The default fill brush TSGroup_RenderPolys and TSBSPGroup_Render install at the render context's +0x22c: +0 the brush mode, +4 the colour (PolyFill_FillColour), +0xc the per-vertex shade array the Gouraud renderers point it at. PolyFill_Fill's outline pass sets the mode to 4, the Gouraud renderers to 1 and TSAliasSolidPoly_Render to 0. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c60d8.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: PolyFill_FillColour
entries.description: +4 of PolyFill_FillBrush, the current polygon's fill colour: the TS poly renderers set it with PolyFill_LineColour from the surface record, and PolyFill_Fill's outline pass copies the line colour into it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c60dc.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: g_ActiveBitmapArray
entries.description: Process-wide 'currently active DBA bitmap-array' context. TSShape_Render and TSShapeInstance_Render swap it to the shape's bound DBA (TSShape_GetBoundBitmapArray, shape+0x26) for the duration of the draw, then restore it. TSBitmapPart_Render indexes into this global by the part's bitmap tag, not anything owned by the poly's shape. It is a two-field context, not a bare DBA pointer: *g_ActiveBitmapArray (offset +0 of what it points to) is the DBA object (its +4 = frame count, +8 = frame pointer table, per TSBase::getBitmapPtr's assert), while g_ActiveBitmapArray[1] (offset +4 of the global's own stored value, NOT of the nested DBA object) points at a separate 20-byte-stride per-frame UV/texture-descriptor table -- see TSTexture4Poly_Render (00422af5). The builder of that second table is open. See docs/retail/formats/dts-texture-binding.md.

entries.name: Poly_SequentialIndices
entries.description: 32 uint16 vertex indices 0, 1, 2, ... that Light_ResetSystem numbers: the index list TSGroup_RenderPolys uses for a group with none of its own and Terrain_FillCellUntextured for its polygon. DBSIM's is 006c60ec.

entries.name: Light_ActiveCount
entries.description: Number of entries in Light_ActiveList. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c612c.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: Light_ActiveList
entries.description: The active light list, light object pointers that Light_ComputeShadeForNormal walks. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c6130.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: Poly_RingCount
entries.description: uint16 vertex count of the current polygon ring, from the poly's +8 in the TS poly renderers. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c6968.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: Poly_RingFirst
entries.description: uint16 index of the current ring's first entry in Poly_RingIndices, from the poly's +0xa. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c696a.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: Poly_ViewVertices
entries.description: Pointer to the int32 {x, y, z} vertices (12 bytes each) the ring's indices select: Poly_ProjectViewVertices projects them as view-space points and copies them to Poly_ViewCache; Terrain_FillCellUntextured points it at its caller's vertices.

entries.name: Poly_RingIndices
entries.description: Pointer to the uint16 vertex-index list the current ring indexes from Poly_RingFirst. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006c6976.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: g_ActiveSurfaceRecords
entries.description: Global pointer, set from the active TSGroup's own +0x18 field by TSGroup_RenderPolys and TSBSPGroup_Render for the duration of one group's poly walk (save/swap/restore, the same shape as g_ActiveBitmapArray). Points at a flat int32[] where surface index k occupies 4 consecutive int32 slots (Front, FrontLine, Back, BackLine) -- a TSGroup surface entry's 8-short, 16-byte on-disk layout, which is why the file stores a group's surface count as surfaceCount*4. TSTexture4Poly_Render indexes it at byte offset field*4 (front) and field*4+8 (back) with the poly's surface field, which lands on one surface's Front/Back slots because that field holds surfaceIndex*4. See docs/retail/formats/dts-texture-binding.md.

entries.name: Poly_VertexState
entries.description: One byte per vertex: 0 not yet projected, 1 nearer than the near plane, 2 projected (its screen point in Poly_ScreenCache). The ring clips branch on it.

entries.name: Poly_ViewCache
entries.description: Per-vertex cache of view-space points, int32 {x, y, z} (12 bytes each) indexed by vertex: the near-plane clips interpolate crossings from it.

entries.name: Poly_ScreenCache
entries.description: Per-vertex cache of projected screen points, int32 {x, y} (8 bytes each) indexed by vertex, valid where Poly_VertexState is 2.

entries.name: Poly_ScreenPoints
entries.description: The screen-point list: int32 {x, y} pairs that Poly_ProjectShapeVertices and Poly_ProjectViewVertices fill and the near-plane clips rebuild, and PolyFill_Fill / PolyFill_FillThenOutline fill. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006cbb86.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: Poly_ScreenPointCount
entries.description: uint16 count of Poly_ScreenPoints. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's 006cbc86.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile; es2_naming.py match/diff against the DBSIM function named in the description

entries.name: g_EventQueue
entries.description: Pointer to the event queue and pointer state WinEvents_Init builds (EventQueue_Ctor): the queue at +0x11 that Event_Post and Pointer_MoveTo append to and Shell_PumpEvents drains (EventQueue_Pump), and the pointer lock at +0x1f.

entries.name: g_WinTimer
entries.description: Pointer to the WinTimer WinEvents_Init builds (WinTimer_Ctor): twenty alarms that WinTimer_InstallAlarm adds and Shell_PumpEvents ticks (Timer_Tick).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of WinEvents_Init and Shell_PumpEvents

entries.name: WinBase_Connections
entries.description: Display-adjacency records {display a, display b, edge}, 12 bytes each, WinBase_ConnectionCount of them: WinBase_Connect appends, Display_FindNeighbour searches.
entries.source: VSHELL capstone disassembly at 004683d4; Display_FindNeighbour description

entries.name: Pointer_FracX
entries.description: The pointer's sub-pixel x remainder in 1/256 pixel: Event_Post adds the display's x scale (+9) times a mouse move's dx, moves the pointer by the whole part (>> 8) and keeps the rest (% 0x100). WinEvents_Init, Pointer_MoveTo and Display_HopTo zero it. Pointer_FracY is its y twin.

entries.name: Pointer_FracY
entries.description: The pointer's sub-pixel y remainder, Pointer_FracX's twin, from the display's y scale (+0xd).

entries.name: g_Mono
entries.description: The shell's DarkMono debug-monitor object: +0 device handle for DARKMONO.VXD, +4 a flag set/cleared by 0046a5e0/0046a5ef. Built by Mono_StaticInit; Mono_Printf and its siblings write to it.

entries.name: Sos_UsingSos9503
entries.description: int16: Sos_BindLibrary sets 1 when it loads sos9503.dll (GetVersion below 0x80000000, or a major version above 3) and 0 when it loads sos32s03.dll. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Sos_UsingSos9503.

entries.name: Rtl_DtorCountPtr
entries.description: Pointer to the Borland exception handler's live-destructor count, the dword just below the stack top in the thread block (FS:[4] - 4), stored by the entry point (00401045) and by the RTL's thread setup (0046b3e2). Every constructor level adds one to *it and every destructor level takes one off, and every polymorphic delete adds Rtl_GetPolymorphicDtorCount first. DBSIM's counterpart is 006cbf74.
